name: Nummela BackYard Ultra
description: Nummela Backyard Ultra is an ultramarathon running event in which competitors run 6.706-kilometre loops within an hour for as long as multiple runners are able to continue. The race is unique because it has no predetermined finish time or distance, and the winner is the person who runs one more loop than the others. The event is held at Polku Hotel in Vihti and offers a challenge for runners who value perseverance and endurance. The race originated in the United States and is also known as “Just one more Loop.”
course_highlights: A 6.706-kilometre route to be completed in under an hour
The race continues for as long as multiple runners can complete a loop within an hour
There are often separate daytime and nighttime routes; the nighttime route is less technical
additional: The race uses a start bell that rings every hour. Runners must be in the designated area when the bell rings. Timing may be done on paper or electronically, and timing services are provided by Juha Seppälä (info@nubu.fi). The race ends when only one runner completes a loop within the one-hour time limit. The event is held at Polku Hotel in Vihti and offers the opportunity to take part in an ultramarathon and follow the runners’ progress via GPS.

name: Ambla SK SV suusatajate seeriajooks+kepikõnd
description: Ambla SK SV suusatajate seeriajooks+kepikõnd on mitmeetapiline jooksu- ja kepikõnnisari, mis toimub Kangrumäel Järva maakonnas. Võistlus koosneb viiest etapist, kus neli esimest on eraldistardiga ja viimane ühisstardiga jooks. Arvesse läheb nelja parima etapi tulemus ning osalejatele on vanusegruppide kaupa auhinnad. Võistlus on mõeldud suusakeppidega jooksjatele ning vajadusel on võimalik suusakeppe laenutada. Sarja läbinuile on eriauhinnad.
course_highlights: Viis etappi, millest neli eraldistardiga ja viimane ühisstardiga
Võistlus toimub Kangrumäel Järva maakonnas
Võistlusarvestus ainult suusakeppidega jooksjate vahel
additional: Võistlusarvestust peetakse ainult suusakeppidega jooksjate vahel. Vajadusel on võimalik suusakeppide laenutus. Igale viie etapi läbinud jooksjale või kepikõndijale eriauhind. Vanusegrupid alates 6. eluaastast kuni 55+ aastani. Punktiarvestus: I koht 30p, II koht 27p, III koht 25p, jne. Võrdsete punktide korral otsustab koht viimasel etapil. Viies etapp on kavandatud 8. novembril 2026 algusega kell 12.00. Sarja arvestusse läheb nelja parema etapi tulemus.

name: Night Trail Run (Sollentuna) — Hundtrail / 5 km & 10 km
description: Night Trail Run is a nighttime trail race focused on the experience and the magic of darkness. Dog trail is a special class where you can share the evening with your dog on 5 km or 10 km, and the courses are designed for a memorable evening in the forest. The event emphasizes safety in the dark - the courses are reflective marked and headlamps are mandatory. All proceeds go to youth sports in Attunda Orienteering Club.
course_highlights: Reflective marked courses
Free start time 18:00 - 19:30 (10 km until 19:00)
Two distances for dog handlers: 5 km and 10 km
additional: Free start time between 18:00 - 19:30 (10 km can start until 19:00). The courses are reflectively marked and headlamps are mandatory. The event is for runners who want to run together with their dog (5 and 10 km). Free start time between 18:00 - 19:30 (10 km until 19:00); courses with reflectors; headlamp required.

name: 53. Saaremaa kolme päeva jooks
description: Saaremaa kolme päeva jooks on traditsiooniline jooksuvõistlus Kuressaares, mis kutsub osalema kõiki jooksusõpru. Võistlus hõlmab mitmeid distantsivalikuid ja vanusegruppe, pakkudes võimalust nii noortele kui täiskasvanutele. Registreerimine toimub kohapeal ning osavõtumaks on taskukohane, mis teeb selle ürituse ligipääsetavaks laiale osalejate ringile. Võistlus on osa suuremast jooksusarjast, kus arvestatakse ka hooaja kokkuvõtteid ja autasustamist.
course_highlights: Mitmed distantsid ja vanusegrupid
Võistlus toimub Kuressaare linnas ja selle ümbruses
Osalejatele on tagatud elektrooniline ajavõtt ja korraldus
additional: Registreerimine toimub kohapeal, soovitatav tulla vähemalt 15 minutit enne starti. Elektrooniline ajavõtt toimub kiipidega, mis on kinnitatud korduvkasutatava rinnanumbri taha. Rinnanumbrid ja joogitopsid on korduvkasutatavad ning palutakse pärast jooksu tagastada. Võistluse lõpus saavad kõik osalejad diplomi ja magusa ampsu. Registreeruda saab individuaalselt, paaris või võistkonnana. Korraldaja veebilehel on saadaval info majutuse, transpordi ja toitlustuse kohta.

name: Saaremaa Kolme Päeva Jooks
description: Saaremaa Kolme Päeva Jooks on traditsiooniline jooksuvõistlus, mis toimub Iide külas. Võistlus koosneb kolmest etapist, kus osalejad saavad nautida Saaremaa kaunist loodust ja mitmekesist maastikku. Võistlus on avatud erinevatele vanusegruppidele ning pakub sõbralikku ja toetavat atmosfääri kõigile jooksuhuvilistele. Osalejatele on tagatud elektrooniline ajavõtt, korduvkasutatavad rinnanumbrid ja joogitopsid ning pärast jooksu magus amps ja jook.
course_highlights: Kolmepäevane jooksuvõistlus Saaremaa maalilises looduses
Korduvkasutatavad rinnanumbrid koos ajavõtukiibiga
Finišis magus amps ja joogipunktid
additional: Ajavõtt toimub kiipidega, mis on rinnanumbri taga ja tuleb peale võistlust tagastada. Osavõtumaks sisaldab korraldust, elektroonilist ajavõttu, finišis jooki, kommi ja diplomit. Korduvkasutatavad joogitopsid ja rinnanumbrid aitavad vähendada prügi. Kõik osalejad saavad pärast jooksu diplomi ja auhinnad vanusegruppide kolmele kiiremale. Võistlusel on individuaalne ja võistkondlik arvestus. Korraldaja veebilehel on info majutuse, transpordi ja toitlustuse kohta.

name: Solvalla Trail
description: Solvalla Trail is a trail running event where the SAUL Finnish Championships are being held for the first time. All age groups compete on the 10-kilometre course, with a choice of 10 or 20 kilometres; participants in the longer race complete the loop twice. The route winds through varied terrain, mostly along narrow trails, and features impressive rocky cliffs, stunning coastal scenery and beautiful forests. The highlight of the course is an almost 75-metre climb to the top of Swinghill.

images.alt_text: Solvalla Trailin reittikartta Nuuksiossa.  Reitti näkyy kartalla sinisenä.
Solvalla Trailin reitti kartalla. Vanha reittikuva.

name: Hiidenkierros

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Perhemaksu sisältää osallistumisoikeuden maksimissaan 4 henkilölle, joista maksimissaan kaksi henkilöä voi valita aikuisten matkan (8, 15 tai 25 km)

description: Hiidenkierros is a trail running event held in the Neitvuori area of Mikkeli. The routes pass through beautiful lake scenery and along technical trails, offering runners varied terrain such as rocky outcrops and the shores of forest ponds. The event headquarters are at the idyllic Hiidenmaa farm, creating a unique atmosphere. The event is suitable for runners of all levels and also offers a 4 km distance for children.
course_highlights: Neitvuori rises 100 metres straight up from Lake Saimaa
The route features many technical trail sections and beautiful lake views
Several lean-to shelters and campfire sites serve as aid stations
additional: The race office and café are open from 9:00 to 18:00. Registration at the race office is open from 9:00 to 10:30; on-site registration is also available. A guided group warm-up starts at 10:40. Timing chips are worn on both feet. There are aid stations along the route with energy drink and energy chews. There is a toilet at the event headquarters, but no indoor facilities or washing facilities. Food and drinks are available at the race café. The route is well marked with wooden signs and plastic tape. The longer routes include a two-way trail section where runners must keep to the right. route and registration information, family and children’s routes, online shop

name: Hellasloppet
description: Hellasloppet is a family-friendly running event at Hellasgården in Nacka that invites runners of all ages and levels. The races go through the Hellas area past lakes and over hills on lovely running trails and roads, offering short courses for children as well as longer options for recreational runners. For the youngest participants, there is a relatively flat course, and the event is arranged as a pleasant day with music, refreshments, and award ceremonies. It is emphasized as a local and friendly family race with plenty of parking and cycling options.
course_highlights: The course runs through the Hellas area past lakes and over hills
Beautiful running trails and sections on roads - mixed terrain
Three-stage format: 400 m (MICA race), 1,400 m, and 5 km
additional: Location: Hellasgården, Ältavägen 101, Nacka; bus from Slussen is indicated as a transportation option. There is ample parking and bicycle parking at the start area. Award ceremonies are held continuously and the catering will be open. The MICA race (400 m) is part of Hellasloppet. Distances include 400 m, 1,400 m, 5 km, and 7.5 km, as well as a 1.5 km walking loop. Bus from Slussen to Hellasgården; plenty of parking around the start area and space to park bikes at the start; catering opens.

name: Växjö Marathon
description: Welcome to the 32nd edition of Växjö Marathon, presented by VLK. The race runs eight laps around Växjösjön on what the organizers call "Sweden's fastest course." The course is very flat (elevation change approx. 3 m) and mostly paved with about 300 meters of fine gravel; each lap is measured in August 2024. There is also a relay race and a children's race, and the course is marked with lead cyclists and flag marshals.
course_highlights: Eight laps around Växjösjön
Very flat course, elevation change approx. 3 m
Mostly asphalt with ~300 m fine gravel; marked with lead cyclists and flag marshals
additional: The course is not closed, which means runners share the paths with pedestrians and cyclists; motor traffic occurs at three points along the course. Each lap is measured (August 2024). There is an option to participate in a relay as a team, and the event also includes a children's race for 2026. The relay consists of four runners each running two laps; the course is open to pedestrians and cyclists and shares space with them as well as motor traffic at three locations.

name: Uppsala Marathon (inkl. DM i marathon)
price_range: Maraton: 825 kr; Halvmaraton: 625 kr; Stafett (4 deltagare): 1800 kr
description: Uppsala Marathon is an urban and nature marathon that runs through historic Uppsala with start and finish at Uppsala Castle. The race combines city pulse in central Uppsala with scenic views along Ekoln, Fyrisån, and the mounds in Gamla Uppsala. The event offers a marathon, half marathon, and relay for four-person teams, and also serves as the district championship (DM) in marathon. The race is spectator-friendly and targets both competitive runners and recreational runners.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Uppsala Castle; passes Carolina Rediviva and central shopping streets
The route goes along the shores of Ekoln and Fyrisån and out to the mounds in Gamla Uppsala
Flat, fast single-loop course consisting of half asphalt and half hard-packed gravel
additional: Start and finish at Uppsala Castle. The start area opens at 07:00; bib number pickup from October 1 to 16 at Löplabbet (Dragarbrunns Torg 4 - 6) and on race day October 17 from 07:30 (lasts 45 minutes before the start). Registration is accepted via RaceID and Epassi can be used as payment. Maximum participants: Marathon 1500, Half Marathon 2500, Marathon relay 150 teams. Anyone registering by September 15, 2026, will have their name on the bib. Age limit 17 years for marathon/half marathon (born 2009 or earlier). Award ceremony at the finish area at 13:00. Food and non-alcoholic drinks are available at the finish area; relay teams receive a finisher’s shirt and medal. Recommended to use public transport or bike (bus stops Slottsbacken or Blåsenhus, buses 2 and 7); parking is available within walking distance. DM medals in Marathon and Half Marathon; medal ceremony the Tuesday after the race; age limit 17 years for marathon/half marathon; Epassi payment, transfer via RaceID, start times, transportation and parking, baggage drop, changing/shower, insurance, and prizes; registration opens until October 12, 2026, with the possibility of closing earlier if maximum capacity is reached.

name: Jönköping 10K/5K
description: Jönköping 10K/5K is a pleasant race in central Jönköping suitable for both elite runners and enthusiastic amateurs. The races, starting at Lillsjöplan, take place on a completely flat and measured course, making it ideal for personal bests and seedings. Both 5 km (1 lap) and 10 km (2 laps) options are offered, and the organizers emphasize a good atmosphere with pacemakers for 40, 45, and 50 minutes on the 10K. Group registration offers a 10% discount when three runners sign up together, and there are options for group registration for larger parties.
course_highlights: Completely flat course in central Jönköping, starting at Lillsjöplan
5 km = 1 lap, 10 km = 2 laps
The course is measured by the Swedish Athletics Federation and seedings are based on it
additional: Start at Lillsjöplan. 5K run in one lap, 10K in two laps. Pacemakers with flags for 40, 45, and 50 minutes on the 10K. Register up to 5 runners at the same time via the regular registration; for more runners, group registration is available. Group registration (three people) offers a 10% discount and the chance to win prizes. No start certificates are sent out. The course and profile are presented on the map/course profile page. Date and start time: October 17, 2026, start at 11:00 at Lillsjöplan; 5K in one lap, 10K in two laps; refreshment stations with UMARA sports drinks and water; baggage drop-off at start/finish; proximity to parking garages; start list and pacer information; limited baggage drop-off and on-site start certificate pickup.

name: XC-race Linköping
description: Linköping XC Race is an annual cross-country race organized by Linköpings OK at Vidingsjön, Linköping. The race offers a marked 5 km trail in varied terrain, including forest paths and marshes, and is suitable for both recreational runners and competitive categories. Participants can choose between 5 km, 10 km for men and women, as well as a recreational class of 5 km, with the 10 km races run twice. The event is known for its challenging and muddy terrain, with start and finish at Vidingsjö Sports Center.
course_highlights: Varied terrain with forest paths and marshes
Distance options for both recreational and competitive runners
Start and finish at Vidingsjö Sports Center
additional: Muddy and challenging terrain, registration via website with payment by card or Swish on site, parking at Vidingsjön and LOK-gården.

name: Night Trail Run 30 km
description: Night Trail Run in October offers evening trail runs focusing on the experience of how light and darkness meet. You can choose 5 km, 10 km, or 30 km with start and finish at Väsby gård in Sollentuna. For the 30 km, you navigate with a downloadable GPS route and map, and the race has energy stations along the way. Welcome to register - all proceeds go to youth sports in Attunda Orienteering Club.
course_highlights: Night trail run in the glow of headlamps with course marked with reflectors
30 km run with GPS route and map, featuring two energy stations
The final part of the 30 km follows the same reflector-marked course as the 5/10 km
additional: For 5 km and 10 km, there is free start time within specified windows (18:00 - 19:30 for 5 km; 18:00 - 19:00 for 10 km). For the 30 km, you receive a GPS route and map in advance, the race has two energy stations and a maximum time of 4 hours 30 minutes; the last part follows the reflector course. Start and finish are at Väsby gård in Sollentuna, the organizer requests participants to finish by 20:30, and registration is open until one hour before each start. The 30 km starts at 16:00 on October 17, 2026. For 5 km, free start is between 18:00 - 19:30, and for 10 km between 18:00 - 19:00; the course follows the reflector course to the finish.

name: Stockholms Brantaste
description: Stockholms Brantaste is an intense uphill race in Hammarbybacken scheduled for October 17, 2026. The race is just over 3 - 3.5 km long with steep inclines and over 200 meters of elevation gain, suitable for both experienced runners and beginners looking to challenge themselves. The finish line is at the top of the hill with a beautiful view of the city. The children's races Brantaste Mini and Brantaste Minsta are also offered, but registration for these may be closed at certain times.
course_highlights: Approximately 3 - 3.5 km with over 200 meters of elevation
Up and down the steep slopes of Hammarbyhöjden; finish at the top with a view of the city
Intensive uphill focus (finish line services, water stations along the course)
additional: Start bibs are sent via email (usually about 2 weeks before the race or sooner if registering late). Number bib distribution takes place at the event area Hammarby Fabriksväg (details in the information text) and opens from 09:30 according to participant information. The bib contains a chip and should be worn unfolded at 45 - 90°; attach with safety pins (bring about 4) and write name/phone number and medical info on the back. The race includes timing, a medal, and water stations; in the children's races, water is available at the finish and medals are awarded. Registration for Brantaste Mini and Brantaste Minsta may be closed at certain times. Free uphill training sessions in Hammarbybacken are available before the race day.

name: Rönninge Backyard Run 2026
location: Rönninge, Salem Municipality, Stockholm County, Sweden

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Anmälan sker på plats och kostar 50 kr.

description: Rönninge Backyard Run is a lap race in Toredal where each lap is 6.706 meters, and the format is built around hourly starts: the first lap starts at 09:00, followed by a new start every full hour up to a total of 12 laps. Participants must complete a lap in under one hour to start the next; the one who completes the most laps (and is fastest on the last lap) wins in the women's and men's categories. The race suits both competitive runners and those who want to challenge their endurance on a technical but easy-to-run trail in the scenic Garnudden. A smaller MiniBackyard is offered for children/beginners with on-site registration and their own start time in the afternoon.
course_highlights: A lap length of 6.706 km with start/finish at Bubblan in Toredal
Surface approximately 80% asphalt and 20% gravel, partly along the promenade around Garnudden
Several longer inclines and a concluding downhill run as well as a flat asphalt stretch towards the finish
additional: Registration for Rönninge Backyard Run opens March 1, 2026. Rönninge 6h (June 6, 2026) starts at 10:00 and runs until 16:00; registration via RaceID (link on the page). MiniBackyard starts at 14:00, registration on site. Registration for the main race is personal and binding; cancellations must be made via info@lopklubb.se no later than October 1 with an administrative fee of 45 SEK. The race features hourly starts: lap 1 at 09:00, lap 2 at 10:00, etc.; the final start at 20:00. Laps are registered with a chip (in the 6-hour race). Coffee and snacks are served at 20:00 after the last lap. The race: 6706 meters per lap; up to 12 laps over twelve hours; first start at 09:00, last start at 20:00; surface approximately 80% asphalt/gravel; women's and men's categories. Mini Backyard is organized by KIF Toredal with a fee of 50 SEK on site.

name: Trail Kuršių Nerija
distance_verbose: 50 km, Maratonas, 30 km, Pusmaratonas, 10 km, 5 km, 1 km
description: Trail Kursiu Nerija (#TKN) is an unforgettable running adventure with incredible views and plenty of sand! This race takes place on the Curonian Spit and offers a range of distances—from 1 km to 104 km—so everyone can find a challenge that suits them.

images.alt_text: Bėgikas bėga per Trail Kuršių Nerija lenktynes.
Bėgikai miško takeliu, Kuršių Nerijos kraštovaizdis.
Bėgikas bėga taku per mišką ir smėlį. Aplink medžiai ir pilki debesys.

name: Graužikai - Kelmė Race
description: The “Graužikai–Kelmė” V. Rimkus Memorial Run took place on October 28, 2023, in Kelmė, marking the 50th anniversary of this traditional event. This year, more than 200 runners from across Lithuania and guests from Ukraine took part. Vitalij Kuznetsov was the fastest in the 8 km race. The fastest woman was Aurika Balsytė, who is from Kelmė District. There was also a 1.8 km race, in which Lukas Mikavičius performed best, and a 200 m race for young children.

images.alt_text: Bėgimo startas su S-Sportas logotipu, dalyviai bėga pro starto liniją.
Bėgikų grupė su medaliais po lenktynių.
Bėgikų grupė su medaliais ir trofėjais.
Bėgikų grupė su Ukrainos vėliava prieš arba po bėgimo.

name: Pagarbos bėgimas IN MEMORIAM
location: Vingio parko estrada, M. K. Čiurlionio gatvė, Vilnius
description: On October 19 at 10:00, the 10th annual “In Memoriam” tribute and charity run will take place in Vingis Park, Vilnius, honoring those who sacrificed their lives for our freedom. The event brings together a community committed to remembering and commemorating these heroes. Participants in the 10 km race will compete for awards in the Open Lithuanian Armed Forces Championship. There will also be non-competitive 1 km and 4 km options to run, walk or roll; no winners or prize-winners will be selected.

images.alt_text: Lietuvos kariuomenės kariai su vėliavomis renginyje "In Memoriam", skirtame kariams atminti.
„IN MEMORIAM“ bėgimo reklama su data ir organizacijų logotipais.
"IN MEMORIAM" bėgimo reklama su bėgančio žmogaus siluetu ir informacija apie renginį.

name: Backyard Ultra Pasaulio čempionatas
description: The Backyard Ultra World Championship is a unique off-road running event where runners must complete a 6.7 km loop every hour until only one runner remains. The race takes place on hilly, off-road courses that demand endurance and determination. It tests both physical and mental stamina, and there is always only one winner. Trailo Kalvė organizes the event with special attention to course quality and the participant experience, inviting runners to test themselves and push their limits.
course_highlights: Off-road courses through hilly terrain
A 6.7 km loop every hour
The race continues until only one runner remains
additional: The race takes place during the cold season, most often on Sundays. Participants receive a Trailo Kalvė running headband when they register for the first time that season. Medals are awarded only for exceptional achievements, not at every stage. Around 15 athletes will take part in the event; courses range from 5 km to 60 km; free training sessions are offered; medals and souvenirs are given away; the event aims to break records for completing 100 miles in 24 hours; it has been organized since 2022.

name: XII Pagarbos/Paramos bėgimas „IN MEMORIAM“, skirtas šiais metais mirusiems kariams atminti
organizer: Lietuvos didžiosios kunigaikštienės Birutės karininkų šeimų moterų organizacija
price_range: bilieto kaina – Jūsų pasirinkta paramos suma
description: The “In Memoriam” Run of Remembrance and Support in Vilnius is a significant event dedicated to honoring Lithuanian Armed Forces service members who died this year and supporting their families. Held in Vingis Park, it features non-competitive 1 km and 4 km distances, as well as the open 10 km Lithuanian Armed Forces Running Championship. The run began as a heartfelt initiative to remember a young officer and has become an important annual civic and patriotic tradition. It is organized by the LDK Birutė Association of Women from Officers’ Families together with the Ministry of National Defence and the Lithuanian Armed Forces.
course_highlights: Courses in Vingis Park, Vilnius
Non-competitive 1 km and 4 km distances
Open 10 km Lithuanian Armed Forces Running Championship
additional: The event is patronized by the Commander of the Lithuanian Armed Forces, General Raimundas Vaikšnoras. Participants can run, walk, or roll the 1 km and 4 km distances; there is no competition, and no winners or prizewinners are selected for these distances. The event also includes a 10 km race with competitive elements. Support for the families of deceased service members is collected via Paysera, a bank account, and PayPal. The event honors the service members, and donated funds go to their families; it takes place in autumn.

name: Trail Kursiu Nerija #TKN
description: Trail Kuršių Nerija #TKN is a wonderful trail run in the Curonian Spit, Lithuania, offering a range of distances from a 1 km children’s course to an extreme 104 km. The event delights participants with its unique views, sandy trails, and the option to run or walk at their own pace. It’s a great opportunity to experience the beauty of nature and spend active time with family or friends. The event welcomes all running abilities and age groups.
course_highlights: Nature trails with plenty of sand
Distances ranging from 1 km for children to 104 km for extreme runners
Invaluable views of the Curonian Spit
additional: The 10 km course has 76 m of elevation gain and is limited to 400 participants. The children’s 1 km course is limited to 200 participants and includes a run with an entertainer in a heated tent. Participants in the 10 km course must bring an ID document and a charged mobile phone or watch with the course GPX file. After the finish, participants are offered showers, a massage, porridge, tea, a national park ticket, and outdoor games for children. The event centre has a warm tent and a luggage storage area. The TKN AFTER PARTY runs until 01:30; the last ferry to Klaipėda departs at 02:20. The event offers various distances, including children’s races and ultramarathons, with aid stations, GPX tracking, medals, and post-race events. Registration closes in mid-September.

name: Bėgimas Graužikai-Kelmė

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 8 km distancijai taikomas 5,- Eur startinis mokestis

description: The Graužikai–Kelmė Run is a traditional run in Kelmė District, held in memory of Vaidotas Rimkus. The event takes place in October and aims to promote running and athletics in Lithuania, encourage a healthy lifestyle, and increase activity among district residents. It attracts runners of all ages, who can choose from several distances, including the 8 km main race. Participants are awarded cups, medals, and commemorative prizes.
course_highlights: The 8 km race starts in Graužikai
A 1.8 km race for girls and boys near the Kelmė Regional Museum
A 200 m children’s race near the museum
additional: The event starts at 12:30, with different distances and start times. Participants should arrive at the Kelmė Regional Museum by 11:30; transport to the start leaves at 12:15. The 200 m children’s race does not require registration. Participants must provide a doctor’s certificate confirming their health status. Winners and runners-up in various age groups receive awards, and everyone who completes a distance receives a commemorative medal. The event will take place at the Kelmė Regional Museum, with registration open until October 16. Participants’ age groups and prizes.

name: Coconaut Pomerania ULTRA Trail
description: Coconaut Pomerania ULTRA Trail is a trail-running series held on the hilly trails of Pomerania and Kashubia, with the event base at KJ Barłomino. The event offers five distances: 100 km, 65 km, 42 km, 21 km and 11 km, providing a range of challenges for trail runners. It showcases the beauty of the Kashubian landscape and regional attractions, and participants can look forward to excellent aid stations along the course. The event is supported by the #AktywnaWieś programme and organised by the Pomerania Sports Association.
course_highlights: Hilly trails of Pomerania and Kashubia
Beautiful Kashubian landscapes
Excellent aid stations along the course
additional: The event offers five distances: 100 km, 65 km, 42 km, 21 km and 11 km, as well as the Junior Trail run of up to 1 km. The races take place at KJ Barłomino. The event promotes regional trails and tourist attractions in Pomerania and is supported by the #AktywnaWieś programme. The event is supported by Coconaut and features courses at various difficulty levels, an attractive base in Barłomino and beautiful views of Kashubia.

name: Pomerania Ultra-Trail®
description: Pomerania Ultra-Trail® is a series of trail races held on the hilly trails of Pomerania and Kashubia, with the event base at KJ Barłomino. The event offers five distances: 100 km, 65 km, 42 km, 21 km, and 11 km, providing a range of challenges for trail runners. The races showcase the beauty of the Kashubian landscape and regional attractions, and participants can expect well-stocked aid stations along the course. The event is supported by the #AktywnaWieś programme and organised by the Pomerania Sports Association.
course_highlights: Hilly trails of Pomerania and Kashubia
Beautiful Kashubian landscapes
Well-stocked aid stations along the course
additional: The event takes place at KJ Barłomino. Five distances are available: 100 km, 65 km, 42 km, 21 km, and 11 km, as well as a Junior race of up to 1 km. The organiser is the Pomerania Sports Association. The event promotes long-distance trail running and Nordic walking. It is supported by the #AktywnaWieś programme. The event features multiple distances, routes through the beautiful Kashubian landscape, support from #AktywnaWieś, and a base at KJ Barłomino.

name: Krusensterni jooks
location: Purila bus stop, Purila, Rapla County, Estonia

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Õpilastele, pensionäridele ja Purila ning Hagudi elanikele - 4€

description: Krusensterni Jooks on traditsiooniline jooksuvõistlus, mis toimub Purila bussipeatusest startides ja Hagudi mõisas finišeerides. Jooksu pikkus on 4,2 km ning see sobib nii õpilastele, pensionäridele kui ka täiskasvanutele. Võistlusel autasustatakse parimaid mehi ja naisi ning eriauhindu saavad veteraniklassi sportlased, noorim ja vanim lõpetaja ning suurim pere. Osavõtt toimub omal riisikol ning kõigile lõpetajatele pakutakse vett, maiustust ja kuuma teed.
course_highlights: 4,2 km pikkune rada Purila bussipeatusest Hagudi mõisani
Rada sobib jooksjatele ja kepikõndijatele
Finišis ootab osalejaid vesi, maiustus ja kuum tee
additional: Registreerimine toimub Purila bussipeatuse juures alates 12:00 kuni 12:30 ning ka internetis. Osavõtumaks tuleb tasuda MTÜ Rapla Jooksuklubi Swedbanki arveldusarvele. Autasustamine toimub kell 14:00. Võistlusel on auhinnad kolmele paremale mehele ja naisele ning parimatele veteranidele. Kohapeal saab registreeruda Purila bussipeatuses kell 12.00 - 12.30 või internetis. Osavõtutasu on õpilastele, pensionäridele ning Purila ja Hagudi elanikele 4 €, täiskasvanutele 8 €. Kõik lõpetajad saavad vett, maiustuse ja kuuma teed; autasustamine algab kell 14.00.

name: Kaarinan Syysmaraton
description: Kaarina Autumn Marathon is a running event offering several distances for different age groups, including marathon, half marathon, and 10 km races, open to both men and women. The races take place on an approximately 10.5-kilometre loop through beautiful, flat terrain in Kaarina and Piikkiö. A children’s run is also held, with the youngest children running an approximately 150-metre loop and older children an approximately 500-metre loop. All participants receive a medal, and the children’s run is free with no advance registration required.

name: Kankaanpää Maraton
description: Kankaanpää Marathon is a versatile running event offering races over various distances, including the marathon, half marathon, and shorter distances. The event takes place in Kankaanpää and is known for its beautiful scenery and well-maintained courses. Participants can enjoy running surrounded by nature, and the event attracts both recreational and competitive runners. To celebrate its 20th anniversary, the event returns to Niinisalo School, Kievarinkatu 3.

images.alt_text: Kankaanpään maratonin juoksijoita metsätiellä. Hyvä kuva kilpailun tunnelmasta.
Kankaanpään maratonin osallistujia juoksemassa. Hyvä kuva kilpailusta.
Kankaanpään maratonin juoksijoita. Hyvä kuva kilpailusta.

name: Pukinmaki Run Helsinki 18.10.2026
description: Pukinmäki Run is an annual running event held in the Pukinmäki district of Helsinki, offering distances of 1 km for children, 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon. The route is flat and fast, mainly on asphalt and outdoor trails, and loops around the boundaries of Pukinmäki. The event is open to runners of all ages and abilities, offering the chance to enjoy exercise and beautiful nature together with others. The event centre is located at Pukinmäki Sports Park, where refreshments and snacks are available.
course_highlights: Flat road and outdoor trail route, approximately 85% asphalt
Only 4.9 metres of elevation gain, making for a fast course
The route loops around the boundaries of the Pukinmäki district
additional: Advance registration closes on 13.10.2026 at 21:00. Late registration is available on Saturday 17.10 from 14:00 to 16:00 and on Sunday 18.10 at the race office. Bib collection begins on Sunday 18.10 at 11:00. The children's 400 m and 1 km races start at 14:20. The race lasts 3 hours; the course closes at 17:00. The event centre is located at Pukinmäki Sports Park, Kenttätie 3, Helsinki. The route is mainly asphalt, and the event offers refreshments and snacks. Participants can travel to the event by car, train, bus or plane. Registration opens well ahead of the event.

name: Täby Halvmarathon
description: Täby Half Marathon is an easy-to-run and fast half marathon in a scenic environment with start and finish at Näsby Castle. The course offers coastal views along Värtan’s shoreline, a scenic loop around Rönningesjön, and a finish back at the sea with a view towards Bogesundslandet. The race is measured and organized by Täby IS Athletics, and suits runners who want to end the season on a fast and beautiful course. In previous years, the race has been very popular with limited spots, so the organizer encourages early registration.
course_highlights: First approximately 5 km along Värtan’s shoreline with sea views
Scenic loop around Rönningesjön passing Ängsholmsbadet and Skavlötens outdoor recreation area
Approximately 125 meters of elevation; about 2/3 asphalt and 1/3 gravel
additional: Start and finish at Näsby Castle. Little Täby Marathon for children aged 5 - 11 years (1.2 km) with start times at 10:00 (born 2017 - 2020) and 10:15 (born 2014 - 2016). Sports drinks from partner Umara are served at water stations. The maximum time for the half marathon is 2 hours and 45 minutes. Bib number distribution: Stadium in Täby Centrum from Wednesday before the race and pickup at the start area from 09:00 to 10:45 on race day. The course has approximately 125 meters of elevation and consists of about 2/3 asphalt and 1/3 gravel; water stations along the course with Umara; previous capacity approximately 1500 participants.

name: Täljemilen
description: Enhörna IF presents Täljemilen - perhaps the fastest controlled measured 10K run this autumn at Geneta Sports Field in Södertälje. The course runs entirely on bicycle and pedestrian paths and is fully asphalted, making the race very fast and suitable for those aiming for a personal best. Water stations are available at 5 km and at the finish line. Instead of medals, the organizer donates a sum to the Children's Cancer Foundation for each registered runner; prizes are awarded to the top 3 in both women's and men's categories, and there will also be a raffle of approximately 20 prizes.
course_highlights: Controlled measured course (approved by a course measurer from the Swedish Athletics Federation)
100% asphalt on bicycle and pedestrian paths - very fast course
Water station at 5 km and at the finish line
additional: Changing rooms are available on site but the organizer recommends that participants come dressed. Late registration on the day of the race is possible if the race is not fully booked. The organizer forgoes medals and instead donates an amount to the Children's Cancer Foundation per registered runner. Prizes are awarded to the top 3 in both women's and men's categories, and approximately 20 prizes will be raffled among all participants. Names and images from the race day may be published on the club's website and social media. Contact information: Henrik Kvarnlöt 073-0400790 and Peter Ness 070-3791299. Last registration date is October 15; late registration on site if spots are available; water at 5 km and at the finish; no medal will be awarded this year; approximately 20 prizes will be raffled among all participants; contact details are provided in the event page text.

name: Påsksmällen

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description:
Män och kvinnor öppen klass Landsväg 5 km 12:30 300:-
Män och kvinnor öppen klass Landsväg 10 km 12:30 300:-

description: Easter Run is a classic road and trail race organized by Enhörna IF in Södertälje. The race starts and ends at Enhörna Outdoor Recreation Area and offers several categories for children, youth, and adults. It is a well-established event with a long tradition, where participants can enjoy a varied and scenic course. The event is open to everyone and follows the competition rules of the Swedish Athletics Association.
course_highlights: Combination of road and trail running
Start and finish at Enhörna Outdoor Recreation Area (sports ground)
Multiple distances and categories for children, youth, and adults
additional: Late registration on site is possible up to 60 minutes before each start with an additional fee of 100 SEK for adult categories and 50 SEK for youth categories. Start times for youth categories are 11:00, 11:10, and 11:35, and for adult categories at 12:30. By registering, participants agree to the publication of their name and any photos on the website and social media. Road and trail running, different distances for children, youth, and adults, registration by April 4, late registration on site up to 60 minutes before the start.

name: XVII Półmaraton Ziemi Puckiej
location: Stadion Miejski w Pucku, Puck, Puck County, Poland
description: The 17th Puck Land Half Marathon is a well-known running event in Pomerania, returning in 2026 in a refreshed format under the STONE TRI & RUN banner. The event takes place on an updated course in an autumn setting, making it an ideal way to round off the running season. It features a half marathon, a 5 km run, and a 5 km Nordic walking event, all with individual starts. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively in the beautiful Kashubian region and experience the sporting atmosphere of the Puck Running Triad.
course_highlights: Updated half-marathon course through the scenic Kashubian region
Autumn conditions that are ideal for runners
Final event in the Puck Running Triad
additional: The event features three competitions: a half marathon, a 5 km run, and a 5 km Nordic walking event, all with individual starts. The organizers ensure the courses are professionally prepared, clearly marked, and secured. The event is part of the STONE TRI & RUN series, which promotes an active lifestyle and a family-friendly sporting atmosphere in Kashubia. Asphalt course; start and finish at the Municipal Stadium in Puck; final event in the Puck Running Triad; registration from 12 December 2025 to 12 October 2026.

name: Pukinmaki Run 1/2 Maraton 10k 5k
description: Pukinmäki Run is an annual running event held in the Pukinmäki district of Helsinki. The officially measured distances are 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon, as well as a 1 km children’s race. The route follows the borders of Pukinmäki and is a flat road course, with approximately 85% asphalt, 10% compacted crushed stone and 5% running track. The course is fast to run, with an elevation difference of just 4.9 metres.

images.alt_text: Kartta Pukinmäki Run -reitistä, jossa näkyy reitti ja maamerkit.

name: Emili jookseb
description: Emili jookseb on sügisesel ajal Kadrioru pargis toimuv rõõmsameelne koolipere jooksuüritus, kus osalevad nii õpilased, õpetajad kui ka lapsevanemad. Ürituse fookus on liikumisrõõmul ja üksteise toetamisel, mitte kiirusel. See traditsiooniline sündmus loob ühtehoidvustunnet ja pakub kogukonnale meeldivaid liikumishetki värskes õhus. Esimene jooks toimus kuldsete lehtede keskel ja oli inspireeriv algus koolivaheajale.
course_highlights: Sügiseselt kirev Kadrioru park
Värske õhk ja kuldsed lehed
Rõõmus ja toetav meeleolu
additional: Üritusel osales kogu koolipere, kaasa arvatud lapsevanemad, rõhutades kogukonna ühtekuuluvust. Jooksu eesmärk on liikumisrõõm ja üksteise innustamine, mitte võistluslik kiirus. Traditsioon jätkub kevadise "Emili veereb!" üritusega. Üritus toob kokku õpilased, õpetajad ja lapsevanemad ning väärtustab liikumisrõõmu ja üksteise innustamist.

name: 3. Holstre-Polli ööjooks
location: Holstre-Polli Sports Centre, Holstre, Viljandi County, Estonia
description: 3. Holstre-Polli ööjooks toimub Holstre-Polli Spordikeskuse tervise- ja suusaradadel Viljandimaal. See öine jooks pakub osalejatele võimalust kogeda metsikut loodust ja rahu, mis ümbritseb spordikeskust. Üritus on osa Holstre-Polli Spordikeskuse spordisündmuste sarjast ning sobib nii kogenud jooksjatele kui ka harrastajatele. Osalejatel on võimalik nautida unikaalset öist jooksukogemust kauni looduse keskel.
course_highlights: Jooks Holstre-Polli Spordikeskuse tervise- ja suusaradadel
Öine jooksukogemus metsikus looduses
15 km kaugusel Viljandist, rahulik ja tasakaalustav keskkond
additional: Pealamp on kõigile osalejatele kohustuslik. Osalejate arv on piiratud: laste jooksul 70 ning põhijooksul ja kepikõnnil kokku 140 kohta; kohapeal saab registreeruda vabade kohtade olemasolul.

name: Halloween Hike
description: Halloween Hike 2024 gives children the chance to enjoy Halloween without scary elements. The event takes place at Memphis Boo-tanic Garden and offers a safe alternative to traditional door-to-door trick-or-treating. Participants can enjoy craft activities, not-so-scary characters, and treats. Costumes are encouraged, and this year the garden has introduced timed entry, so it’s a good idea to buy tickets in advance.

images.alt_text: Memphis Botanic Gardenin kaunis puutarhamaisema, jossa on punainen silta ja rauhoittava lampi.
Halloween-aiheinen kuva, jossa on paljon kurpitsoita. Sopii juoksutapahtuman mainokseen.

name: Helsinki Halloween Run
description: Helsinki Halloween Run 2025 takes place on 25.10.2025 in Kalasatama, Helsinki! The event also includes a race for children, Kids Run Helsinki Halloween, with distances of approximately 450 m (for children under 7) and 900 m (for older children). Schedule: 16.00 Race office opens, 17.45 Kids Run 450 m, 18.00 Kids Run 900 m, and 18.30 start of the 5 km and 10 km races. Prizes will be awarded for the best costumes during the event, and a photo wall will be available for capturing the costumes.

name: Mustavuori Vertical
description: Mustavuori Vertical takes over the Mustavuori Ski Resort in Tampere on 28 October 2023! Participants climb the slope by walking, Nordic walking, jogging, bounding or even running. What makes the event special is that each ascent starts together at the bottom. The race is designed to be a challenging, communal experience, where the winner is the one who lasts the longest.

images.alt_text: Mustavuori Vertical -juoksukilpailu yöllä, juoksijoita ja liekkejä.
Mustavuori Vertical -juoksijat nousevat ylös mäkeä sauvojen kanssa.
Mustavuori Vertical -juoksija nousee mäkeä pimeässä, otsalamppu päässä ja sauvat mukana.
Mustavuori Vertical -kilpailun mainoskuva, jossa mies ja kilpailun nimi.

name: Yxbacken Extreme Challenge by E2C
location: Yxbackens slalombacke, Norrköpings kommun, Östergötland, Sweden
description: Yxbacken Extreme Challenge by E2C is a hill race held in Norrköping's own ski slope. The race is described as challenging - in 2024, five tough laps were completed in the hill - and it caters both to competitive runners and families through a separate children's race. E2C is the title partner, and the event combines competition, children's activities, and subsequent prize and photo ceremonies.
course_highlights: Run in Norrköping's ski slope (Yxbacken)
Consisted of five challenging laps in 2024
Children's race "Lilla Yxbackenloppet" introduced in 2024
additional: The 2024 race was held on October 19, and E2C was the title partner for the fourth year. The 2024 children's race had approximately 50 participating children who received medals at the finish line; the winners received wreaths at the award ceremony. Photographer Magnus Media took pictures published on the race's Facebook page. About 300 participants in the first edition; in 2023, the event was photographed by Magnus Andersson (Magnusmedia.nu); the children's race Lilla Yxbackenloppet by E2C was added in 2024.

name: Stockholm: ALL OUT
description: All Out Dubstep is a long-standing and influential club night in Stockholm that has shaped the city's club music scene for nearly two decades. With a unique mix of subbass, mutated garage, hip hop, electro, and techno, the residents create an atmosphere that spans from Kingston to London. The event also celebrates birthdays with a broad lineup of DJs and artists playing everything from dancehall to Afro and Samba. It is a party for everyone who loves club music and the vibrant energy of the dance floor.
course_highlights: Deep subbass and mutated garage as a foundation
Mix of hip hop, electro, and techno with influences from Kingston and London
Wide musical styles from dancehall to Afro and Samba
additional: Free entry between 15:00 and 18:00, then admission from 200 SEK. The event runs from 15:00 to 03:00 and is held at Capital Sound System in Kvarteret / Hus 7, Styckmästargatan 10, Stockholm. Music, club, dubstep, techno, hip hop, Afro, Samba, dancehall, preparty

name: Krosas Juodšilių ruduo
description: On October 25, 2025, the “Sporto renginiai” association and the Juodšiliai Eldership of Vilnius District Municipality are organizing the “Juodšilių ruduo” sports festival. The race course includes the forest trail on Mokyklos St. and the forest trails on Šilo St. One lap is 4.5 km long. Race bibs will be handed out and new participants can register from 10:00 to 11:30. Races start at 12:00 with the 600 m run, followed at 12:15 by the 4.5 km, 9 km and 18 km distances.

images.alt_text: Bėgimo startas su vaikais po Juodšilių rudens arkos.
Juodšilių ruduo logo su bėgikais, dviratininku ir rudens lapais.

name: Krosas „Juodšilių ruduo“
description: The Juodšiliai Cross-Country Race is a sports celebration in Vilnius District, held on October 24 in Juodšiliai. The event is organized by the association „Sporto renginiai“ together with the Juodšiliai Eldership of Vilnius District Municipality. The race encourages the local community to be active and promotes athletics and running in Lithuania. Anyone may take part, and the event promotes a healthy lifestyle and identifies athletes across different age groups.
course_highlights: The course is in the town of Juodšiliai, Mokyklos g. 9
Events: 600 m, 4 km and 12 km cross-country distances
Participants must wear their race numbers on the front of their shirts
additional: Race-number collection and registration take place from 10:00 to 11:30. Participants may not transfer their number to another participant, use personal assistance, or bring animals onto the course. Participants must follow the course and officials’ instructions. Protests must be submitted in writing within 30 minutes after the race and are subject to a 30 EUR fee. Changing to a shorter event incurs a 6 EUR fee; changing to a longer event requires payment of the additional entry fee. Event location: Juodšiliai, Vilnius District; events: 600 m, 4 km, 12 km; registration from 10:00 to 11:30; participation is open, subject to special conditions and fees.

name: Sporto šventė Juodšilių ruduo
location: Juodšilių, Vilniaus rajonas, Vilniaus apskritis, Lithuania
description: The “Juodšilių ruduo” sports festival is a Vilnius District sporting event taking place on October 24, 2026, in Juodšiliai. The event encourages community members to take part in sports, promotes athletics and running, and advocates a healthy lifestyle. Anyone may participate, with distances of 600 m, 4 km, and 12 km. Participants register and collect their bibs at the event venue from 10:00 to 11:30. Participation is voluntary, and runners are responsible for their own health.
course_highlights: The course is in the territory of Juodšiliai Eldership, Vilnius District
Events: 600 m, 4 km, and 12 km cross-country runs
Walking animals and using personal support during the event are prohibited
additional: Bib collection and registration take place from 10:00 to 11:30. Participants must present an identity document to collect their bib. Participants may not transfer their bib to another person, use personal support, walk animals on the course, or leave the course without a judge’s permission. Protests must be submitted in writing within 30 minutes after the end of the event, with a fee of 30 EUR. The fee for changing an event is 6 EUR; changing to a longer event requires payment of the difference. Running events: 600 m, 4 km, and 12 km; registration from 10:00 to 11:30; participant awards and commemorative medals; participant restrictions and rules.

name: Pärnu Rannajooks
description: Pärnu Rannajooks on Pärnu Kahe Silla Klubi hooaja ja kolmikürituse sarja lõpetav jooksuvõistlus, mis toimub Pärnu Rannastaadionil. Võistlejatel on valida 5 ja 10 kilomeetri distantside vahel, mida saab läbida joostes või käies-kepikõndides. Rada kulgeb kaunis Pärnu rannapiirkonnas, pakkudes osalejatele nii loodusvaateid kui ka linnale iseloomulikke arhitektuurimälestisi, sealhulgas rannapromenaadi merevaatega. Üritus on sobilik nii harrastajatele kui ka kogenud jooksjatele ning pakub meeldivat spordielamust.
course_highlights: 5 ja 10 km distantsid joostes või käies-kepikõndides
Rada kulgeb Pärnu rannapiirkonnas kaunite loodusvaadete ja arhitektuurimälestistega
Rannapromenaad merevaatega
additional: Distantsivalikus on 5 ja 10 kilomeetrit, mida saab läbida joostes või käies-kepikõndides. Võistlus on osa Pärnu Kahe Silla Klubi kolmikürituse sarjast. Lastejooksud ja virtuaaljooksu distantsid on samuti kavas. Sündmus hõlmab ka virtuaalseid jooksu ja lastejookse ning toimub Pärnu Rannastaadionil, pakkudes võimalust nautida sporti ja loodust üheskoos.

name: Sarvilahden Maraton
description: Sarvilahti Marathon offers participants several different running distances, including the marathon, half marathon, and 5- and 10-kilometer routes. The marathon and half marathon follow the same route, with the half marathon completed twice. The event provides electronic timing, and the maximum time for the marathon is 6 hours. All participants receive a medal, but medals cannot be guaranteed for those who register late.

images.alt_text: Juoksija Sarvilahden maratonilla. Hyvä kuva kilpailusta.
Sarvilahden maratonin reittikartta Loviisassa. 41km reitti näkyy kartalla.

name: Lepokallion lenkki
description: Lepokallio Trail is a 5.8-kilometer hiking route in the varied forest landscapes of Hanhikoski, Ylistaro. It was renovated and is maintained by the Hanhikoski Rural and Home Economics Women's Association. There are two lean-to shelters along the route, Lepokallio Shelter and Pururata Shelter, both with a fire pit and firewood. The route is accessible year-round and offers an easy outing through varied terrain, including bright pine forests and atmospheric spruce forests.

images.alt_text: Laavu lumisessa metsässä, osa Lepokallion lenkki -polkujuoksureittiä.

name: Viikin Viitonen
description: Viikin Viitonen is an event open to everyone, held several times a year. This year, the event will be run on July 1, bringing runners together in the atmosphere of a summer evening. The event has set a new record with 106 participants, and the current maximum number of participants is 150. Advance registration and the entry fee cost 10 euros (incl. 10% VAT).

name: Sjögarpslunken 2026
description: Sjögarpslunken is a recurring running event that will celebrate its 50th anniversary in 2026 and is scheduled for Sunday, October 25, 2026. The event page indicates that the race has offered several distances (according to previous registration forms: 2.5 km, 5 km, 7.5 km, and 14 km) and that the organizer publishes invitations, race rules, start lists, maps, and results on the website. The website describes the course's beautiful scenery and a challenging 14 km profile. More information and details about the course and profile are available via links on the event page.
course_highlights: Beautiful course layout (linked on the event page)
Challenging 14 km course profile
Multiple distances - 2.5 km, 5 km, 7.5 km, and 14 km (according to previous registration forms)
additional: The race celebrates its 50th anniversary in 2026. The website contains links to maps and course profiles as well as previous years' race rules, invitations, start lists, and preliminary results. Previous registration forms (2020) showed options for distance and preferred race day (October 23, 24, or 25). Content includes invitation, race rules, start lists, course map, results, and course profile; 14 km course. The race is traditionally held during the last weekend of October and will celebrate its 50th anniversary in 2026.

name: LBT 16 - Bėgimas Lietuvoje
description: LBT 16 - RUN AROUND LITHUANIA will take place on October 26, 2025, at 11:00 at the Lithuanian Museum of Ethnography in Rumšiškės. Registration and bib number collection will begin at 09:00.

images.alt_text: Rumšiškių Bėgimas Aplink Lietuvą vaizdas su malūnu ir peizažu.
Bėgikų grupė pasiruošusi bėgti. Matosi numeriai ir aplinka, tinkama bėgimo renginiui.

name: Bėgimas „Aplink Lietuvą“
description: The “Around Lithuania” Run is a traditional running event held in Rumšiškės, on the grounds of the Lithuanian Open-Air Museum. The event offers a range of distances, from a 300 m children’s race to the 21.098 km half marathon, which is the main event and counts toward the Lithuanian Running Cup standings. Participants start according to age-group handicap rules, and the event program includes registration, starts for different distances, and awards. It is a great opportunity to spend time actively outdoors and compete with running enthusiasts from all over Lithuania.
course_highlights: Distances range from a 300 m children’s race to a 21.098 km half marathon
Starts follow age-group handicap rules
Location: Lithuanian Open-Air Museum in Rumšiškės
additional: Event program: 09:00 registration and race number distribution, 10:45 competition opening, starts for different distances from 11:00 to 13:00, awards from 14:00. The main distance is 21.098 km, consisting of 4 laps. The age-group handicap system allows less competitive participants to start earlier. The event takes place in Rumšiškės, with online registration available. The program includes starts, awards, and special groups.

name: Sopot Półmaraton
description: Sopot Half Marathon is an annual half-marathon held in the picturesque seaside city of Sopot. Participants can run a route through charming parts of the city, finishing at ERGO Arena, which offers a unique atmosphere and comfort. The event attracts runners from all over Poland, offering professional organization and attractive race packs. It’s a great opportunity to experience the excitement of sport in the Pearl of the Baltic and earn a commemorative medal and T-shirt.
course_highlights: The route passes through central Sopot and the seaside promenades
The finish is located at ERGO Arena
Picturesque views of the Baltic Sea and Sopot’s iconic pier
additional: The race pack includes an official T-shirt and medal. The half-marathon route is certified and passes through central Sopot and the seaside promenades. The finish is inside ERGO Arena, providing comfortable conditions for runners after the race. Race packs available from 10 February 2026; participant limit: 3,500; discounts for holders of the Sopot Card; the event is part of the Korona Półmaratonów Pomorza 2026–2030 series.

name: Tuusula Trailrun
description: Tuusula Trailrun 2024 trail race will be held on Sunday, 27 October 2024 at 11:00 at the biathlon stadium of Tuusula Sports Centre. The route runs along the trails of Tuusula’s Korpikylä and Sammaloja, offering varied terrain and wide, runnable trails. Trail running shoes or studded shoes are the most suitable, but the route can also be run safely in regular running shoes. There are water stations on the course at the 5 km, 10 km and 15 km marks, and the route is marked with ribbons, signs and chalk.

images.alt_text: Ilmakuva urheilukeskuksesta, mahdollisesti Tuusula Trailrunin lähtöpaikka.

name: Hiidenhölkkä Nummela
description: As autumn approaches, so does the traditional Hiidenhölkkä, which is being held for the 47th time this year. Hiidenhölkkä–Nummelan Tarmo. The 10 km and 20 km (2 x 10 km) Hiidenhölkkä routes circle Nummelanharju and Nummela Airport. Hiidenhölkkä starts at 12:00, and the running event ends at 14:00.

name: Pilvimaja Night Trail
description: Pilvimaja Night Trail is a unique trail running event held in the Vaasa area. The event gives runners the chance to experience beautiful scenery and the calming effects of nature in the dark, on a reflective-marked course. The distance is approximately 13 km, and the event takes place on Friday, October 31, 2025, at 20:00.

images.alt_text: Pilvimaja Night Trail Run logo. Polkujuoksutapahtuma Skatilassa, Suomessa.
Kartta reitistä, jossa näkyy polkujuoksureitin kulku ja etäisyydet.

name: Vantaan Kestävyyskierros
description: At the Vantaa Endurance Series, you can challenge yourself in five different events. The series is suitable for fitness enthusiasts and endurance athletes of all levels, and offers a great opportunity to try completely new sports. The Vantaa Endurance Series consists of Vantaa Ski Race, Vantaa Off-trail Challenge orienteering, Vantaa Triathlon, Seutula Loop and Vantaa Marathon. The events are standalone competitions, but together they make up the Vantaa Endurance Series.

images.alt_text: Suunnistuskilpailu Vantaan kestävyyskierroksella. Monet osallistujat juoksevat maastossa.
Vantaan ratikkareitti kartalla.  Reitti kulkee lentokentältä Länsimäkeen.

name: Repovesi Trail 2026
description: Repovesi Trail 2026 is a trail running event held in Repovesi National Park on Saturday, 31 October 2026. The event offers three challenging distances: 10 km, 21 km and 42 km, taking runners through stunning natural scenery among rugged cliffs and forest views. The routes are clearly marked and feature varied terrain, offering a challenge for experienced runners and new adventurers alike. The event centre is at the Lapinsalmi car park, a short distance from the start of the route.
course_highlights: The routes follow the established trails of Repovesi National Park
Climbs, rugged cliffs and stunning forest views
The 21 km main route is run twice for the 42 km distance; the 10 km route takes a shortcut from the main route
additional: The event centre is at the Lapinsalmi car park, address Riippusillantie 55, 47900 Vuohijärvi. The race has a limit of 100 participants per distance, 300 in total. The finish closes at 18:00. Parking is available near the event centre. Runners must use their own cup at drink stations. Baba Foods smoothies, Maxim sports drink, sweets, crisps, bananas and raisins are available at the finish. After the race, a buffet meal is served at Restaurant Prinssi, with continuous bus transport to the car park. Route provisions include marking and aid stations; the event is environmentally friendly and offers prizes to participants.

name: Pohjoisbaanan maili 2026
description: Pohjoisbaanan Mile 2026 is a traditional mile race held on Pohjoisbaanan in Käpylä, Helsinki, on October 31. The race gives runners the chance to test their pace over one mile (1.609 km). The start is on the pedestrian and cycle path near Käpylä railway station, and the event is open to all running enthusiasts. The event is organized by Helsingin Juoksijat ry, and participation is free for members. Welcome to enjoy a fast-paced, community-minded running event!
course_highlights: The distance is exactly one mile, or 1.609 km
The start is on the pedestrian and cycle path near Käpylä railway station
The event takes place on Pohjoisbaanan in Käpylä, Helsinki
additional: Participation is free for members of Helsingin Juoksijat ry. The start location is marked by a Helsingin Juoksijat flag. The event lasts about an hour, from 11:00 to 12:00. The event starts at 10:00, and no information is available about specific course features or registration procedures. Helsingin Juoksijat also offers a variety of running training and community events throughout the year.

name: Komia Ilkan Polku
location: Ilmajoella Kyrkösjärven läheisyydessä, Ilmajoki, South Ostrobothnia, Finland
description: KOMIA Ilkan Polku is a varied and challenging trail-running event held in Ilmajoki near Kyrkösjärvi. The event offers several distances, including a 39 km marathon, a 20 km half marathon, a 10 km sprint, and the children’s Halloween Run. The route follows a variety of trails and village roads, with approximately 300 metres of elevation gain. The event centre is at Luontokeskus Käpälikkö on the shore of Kyrkösjärvi, where runners can enjoy beautiful natural scenery and challenging sections. The event is also family-friendly and encourages participants to dress in a Halloween theme.
course_highlights: Varied trails along the Ilkan Polku nature trail
Approximately 300 metres of total elevation gain
The route also includes approximately 3 km of village roads and gravel roads
additional: The event has mass starts, bag storage, and bag transport from the start to the finish area. The café serves coffee, sweets, sausages, and drinks. First-aid points are located along the route and at the finish. Changing facilities, showers, and toilets are available in the changing rooms at Kyrkösjärvi beach. Littering in nature is prohibited. The children’s Halloween Run is free and encourages participants to dress up in costume. The event includes various categories, the route, timing, prizes, a café, soup, bag storage, toilets at Kyrkösjärvi beach, a recommendation to have insurance, first aid, and the opportunity to test running shoes.

name: John Bauer Trail Run
location: Huskvarna, Jönköping Municipality, Jönköping County, Sweden
description: John Bauer Trail Run is a challenging and quite hilly cross-country race held in Huskvarna, near Lake Vättern. The race offers several distances for both adults and children, including 18 km, 10 km, 5 km, as well as children and youth classes. The courses go partly on trails and partly on unpaved terrain, with demanding hills such as Strutsabacken where the Bergatrollet title is awarded to the fastest runner uphill. The event is family-friendly with changing rooms, showers, catering, and security personnel along the course.
course_highlights: Challenging and quite hilly cross-country race with partly trail and unpaved terrain
Strutsabacken (slalom hill) as a challenging hill with the Bergatrollet race
Water stations with water, sports drinks, and bananas on longer distances
additional: Number bibs with chips are collected on race day no later than 11:15 and must be worn visibly on the front of the shirt. Timing is done with a chip and provides both total time and uphill time at Strutsabacken. Water stations are available at various distances with water, sports drinks, and bananas. Changing rooms, showers, and toilets are available in the IKHP cabin. Valuables can be left and picked up at the bib distribution. Security personnel and Red Cross medical staff are present. Children and youth classes start at 10:45, adult classes at 11:30, and the 400m toddler run has free start times between 10:00 and 12:00. Trail race with hilly terrain, on-site registration, medals for all participants, prizes for top finishers and Bergatrollet, safety measures including medical support.

name: Fiskarin Halloween 10K
description: Helsinki Halloween Run 2025 takes place on 25 October 2025! The event also includes a children’s race, Kids Run Helsinki Halloween, with distances of approximately 450 m (for children under 7) and 900 m (for older children). The route is officially measured, and the competition has 5 km and 10 km categories for men and women. The best Halloween costume will be awarded a prize!

images.alt_text: Halloween-teemainen kuva juoksutapahtumaan. Musta linna, lepakkoja ja kurpitsa. Teksti: Halloween Hölkkä 5.11.2022.

name: Höstmilen
description: The Autumn Mile is a cross-country race in the Kolmård Forest outside Åby, north of Norrköping, taking place on November 1, 2026. The course runs on trails between Sörsjön and Lillsjön and offers scenic and challenging terrain for both competitors and recreational runners. The organizer is OK Kolmården, and there are three main course options: the classic 10.6 km, Höstfemman 5.2 km, as well as courses for children and youth.
course_highlights: Cross-country race on trails between Sörsjön and Lillsjön
Höstmilen 10.6 km (Sörsjön → Lillsjön) and Höstfemman 5.2 km (start/finish at Lillsjön)
Running in the scenic and hilly terrain of Kolmård Forest
additional: Registration closes on October 29 at 23:00 online; thereafter, registration is possible on October 31 from 11:00 to 14:00 at XXL and at the start location on November 1. For the classic Höstmilen, a bus departs from Jurslaskolan to Sörsjön. A race information packet with practical details will be published approximately one week before the race. The competition classes have only two prize categories (Men and Women) for the adult races. A complete list of registered participants is published on the 'Registered' page. The distances and race formats are 10.6 km, 5.2 km, and children’s races (1.4 or 2.0 km); team race, corporate race, and school race. The race info and registration can be found at hostmilen.nu.

name: Riston Hölkkä
description: Risto’s Run is held in Suomusjärvi, Salo, every year on the Sunday after All Saints’ Day. The event is named after Risto Nuuroks, a four-time World Championship medalist in orienteering who won silver in the individual event in 1978. Competitive and recreational categories are available for runners of all abilities, and the routes pass through rural landscapes, mostly on gravel roads. Risto’s Run will next be held on 2 November 2025, with the race headquarters at Sisumaja.

images.alt_text: Riston Hölkkä - osallistujia, juoksijoita hymyillen ja kädet ylhäällä.
Riston Hölkkä - juoksija juoksee kilpailussa, kilpailunumero 89.
Riston Hölkkä -juoksija juoksee hiekkatiellä, numero 91 rinnassa.

name: Fiskarsin Maraton Rasepori
description: Fiskars Marathon Raasepori will be held on 20.06.2025, starting from the Fiskari Athletes’ lodge. The race starts at 10:00. The entire route follows gravel roads, offering runners a range of distances, including 15 km, 7 km, 1.5 km and 0.5 km. The event is a perfect opportunity for both beginners and experienced runners seeking a challenge and beautiful scenery. All participants receive a commemorative medal.

images.alt_text: Fiskarsin kylä lintuperspektiivistä, jossa sijaitsee juoksureitti.

name: Tampere Races
description: Tampere Marathon 2025 will be run on Sunday, August 31. You can choose to run the marathon, half marathon, quarter marathon (10.5 km), or take part in the marathon relay, run in teams of four. Children have their own Mini Marathon event at Tampere Stadium. The course has changed compared with previous years due to construction work in the city, and runs mainly on asphalt and partly on gravel paths.

name: Fiskarsin Maraton Raseporis 2026
description: The Fiskars Marathon in Raseborg 2026 is an exciting running event that gives participants the opportunity to experience magnificent scenery and a sense of community. The event attracts runners of all levels and is an excellent opportunity to test your fitness and enjoy running. The marathon is designed to offer unforgettable moments for both competitors and spectators.

name: Itämeri Maraton
description: Baltic Sea Marathon will be run and walked on Saturday, October 4, 2025. The distance options are the marathon, half marathon, and quarter marathon (10.5 km). The official time limit is six (6) hours for the full marathon and 5.5 hours for the half marathon and quarter marathon. The course is officially measured, and the start and finish area are at Keskuskoulu, Halmstadinkatu 2. Advance registration closes on Tuesday, September 30, 2025, at 24:00.

name: Keurusselän Syyslenkki
description: Keurusselkä Autumn Run takes place on the grounds of Hotel Keurusselkä and in the sports park, mainly following ski trails. The event is held on Saturday, October 4 at 11:00, with 6 km and 10 km routes. The start and finish are at Hotel Keurusselkä, and a prize containing local products will be raffled among runners in both distances. The entry fee is €15, which includes use of the hotel spa after the run.

images.alt_text: Ilmakuva järvestä ja metsästä, mahdollisesti juoksureitin maastosta.
Hotelli Keurusselkä, lähtö- ja maalipaikka Keurusselän syyslenkille.
Hotelli Keurusselkä järven rannalla, Keurusselän Syyslenkin lähtöpaikka.

name: Ilmaristen Ympärijuoksu
description: Ilmaristen Ympärijuoksu is a running event held on 06.10.2024 from 11:00 to 13:00. The event takes place at Ilmaristen Metsäpirtti, Pahkalaukkaantie 58, Ilmarinen, Lieto. It is organized by Liedon Luja, TUL V-S.

images.alt_text: Ilmaristen Metsäpirtti, Lieto, Suomi. Ilmaristen Ympärijuoksu tapahtumapaikka.

name: Pirkan Hölkkä & Kieppi
description: The autumn season’s fitness highlight, Pirkan Hölkkä, will be run on Sunday, 5 October 2025, for the 55th time. Pirkan Kieppi, a 14 km event, is held alongside Pirkan Hölkkä. It starts at 11:30 from the Pirkan Hölkkä finish area, in the yard of TAKK’s Nirva campus. The approximately 14 km Pirkan Kieppi through the beautiful autumn scenery of Vuores and Hervanta is suitable for anyone with a good basic level of fitness. There is no rush at the event, and participants can enjoy being outdoors and the refreshments provided at the aid stations.

images.alt_text: Joukko juoksijoita lähtöviivalla odottamassa kilpailun alkua.
Pirkan Hölkkä juoksukilpailu, jossa juoksijat liikkeessä. Vuosi 2024.
Pirkan Kierros -logo. Sisältää juoksun, hiihdon, soutun ja pyöräilyn kuvia.

name: Paraisten Lenkki
description: Come celebrate the 60th anniversary run of the Pargas Run with us on Sunday, October 6, 2024. The race follows the traditional 10.35 km course, starting and finishing at Pajbacka Sports Field, which also has changing rooms and showers. To mark the occasion, all participants will receive a gold commemorative medal and a unique Pargas Run T-shirt. After the finish, coffee, juice, and layer cake will be served to all participants.

images.alt_text: Juoksija-lehden kansi, jossa juoksija juoksee polulla.

name: Fiskarsin Maraton Rasepori
description: Fiskars Marathon Rasepori will be held on 20.06.2025 in Raseborg, starting from the Fiskari Athletes’ lodge at Kalliomäentie 4. The race starts at 10:00, and the race office opens at 8:30. Several distances are available: 15 km, 7 km, 2 km and 0.6 km for different age groups. The route winds through beautiful scenery along gravel roads, giving runners the chance to enjoy nature and peaceful trails.

images.alt_text: Ilmakuva rakennuksista ja metsästä Fiskarsissa, Raaseporissa.
Fiskarsin kylän rakennus ja tie, mahdollisesti juoksureitti.
Kaunis luontomaisema, jossa on vesi ja puita.

name: TrailHunt Vooremäe 1000+
description: TrailHunt Vooremäe 1000+ on maastikujooks Vooremäe kaunite terviseradade ja metsade vahel Tartumaal. Võistlus tõstab esile väljakutseid, nagu 1000 tõusumeetrit ühe jooksu jooksul, pakkudes osalejatele võimalust testida oma võimeid ja nautida metsarajalt saadavat positiivset energiat. Võistluskeskus asub uue teenindushoone juures, kus on mugav pesemisvõimalus ja riiete vahetus. Rajal on mehitatud toitlustuspunkt ning ajavõtt toimub puutevaba SPORTIdent süsteemiga. Distantsid varieeruvad 14 km matkast kuni üle 42 km maratonini, kus maratonijooksjad läbivad täpselt kolm 14.1 km pikkust ringi.
course_highlights: 14.1 km pikkune ring, mis vastab Vooremäe suure ringi liikumissuunale
Üle 1000 tõusumeetri kogusumma maratonidistantsil
Mehitatud toitlustuspunkt rajal, mida läbitakse mitu korda
additional: Stardinumber leitav enne võistlust Seiklushundi kodulehe stardiprotokollist. Ajavõtt toimub puutevaba SPORTIdent (SI AIR) süsteemiga, kiip kinnitatakse randmele. Võistluskeskuses on võimalik pärast võistlust pesta ja riideid vahetada. Rajal on üks mehitatud toitlustuspunkt, kus pakutakse vett, coca-colat ja kerget näksimist. Kohapeal registreerimist ei toimu. Ümberregistreerimine ja muudatused ainult e-posti teel. Trailrun, mägine maastik, registreerimine Stebby kaudu, aid stations, finisher-medalid, autasustamine

name: Nuuksio Pikkujoulu Ultra
description: Nuuksio Pikkujoulu Ultra takes place on Saturday, November 16, 2024, at Folkhälsan Solvalla Sports Institute, starting at 9:00 a.m. The competition category follows the backyard-style format, with simultaneous starts; the final start is at 4:00 p.m. and the finish closes at 5:00 p.m. In the recreational category, you can run at your own pace for as many laps as you like. There is also a shortened course of approximately 5 km, offering the atmosphere of a mass start. This event is a great opportunity to try ultrarunning amid the beautiful scenery of Nuuksio. Refreshments include mulled berry juice, warm juice, gingerbread cookies, and other light snacks.

images.alt_text: Nuuksio Pikkujoulu-ultra reitin kartta. Selkeä kuvaus reitistä.
Nuuksio Pikkujoulu Ultra -juoksukilpailun kuva lumisessa maastossa.

name: Teivocup I
description: Teivo Cup I was run on 26 November 2011 in sunny weather, with temperatures a few degrees above zero. The race had 80 runners, who competed on a route that was icy in places. There was a good turnout in the youth categories. In the girls’ 11-year-old category, Mila Manninen (KU-68) ran the fastest time, 4:10. In the boys’ 11-year-old category, Miska Manninen (KU-68) was the fastest in 4:13. In the men’s 5 km, Jarkko Järvenpää improved the previous course record by two seconds, running 14:54.

images.alt_text: Juoksukilpailu: joukko juoksijoita juoksee asvaltoitua tietä pitkin.
Juoksukilpailu lapsille, mukana numerolappuja ja juoksijoita.

name: Höstrusket
description: The Autumn Run is a trail and road race in Northern Djurgården, Stockholm, taking place on November 7, 2026. Choose between 10 km, half marathon (21.1 km), or marathon (42.195 km) with start and finish at Fisksjöängsvägen. The race is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners and offers motivating pacers, well-stocked water stations, and a festive conclusion to the running season in the Royal National City Park. The event is organized by Marathongruppen in collaboration with local athletics clubs, and the proceeds go back to sports.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Fisksjöängsvägen in Northern Djurgården (about 800 m from Ropstens T‑station)
Measured courses mostly on asphalt with some gravel; 10 km: +103.9 m, marathon: total +439 m
Rich water stations and lap services as well as clear kilometer signs
additional: Start/finish at Fisksjöäng (about 800 m from Ropstens T‑station). Bib number distribution, pacer tents, food/coffee sales, drop-off of outerwear and toilets at the event area. Opportunity to change clothes and shower in a facility a few hundred meters away for a fee. Chip timing by RaceTimer; pacers offered for several finish times (list per distance). Max and cut-off times: 10 km 2:00, half marathon 2:30, marathon 5:30 (repetition at the last lap at 13:40). Age limits: 15 years for 10 km (13 years with guardian), 17 years for half marathon and marathon. Certain aids and vehicles (staves, inline skates, strollers, bicycles, handcycles, racing wheelchair) are not allowed; special conditions apply for escorts/wheelchairs. Proceeds go back to sports. Registration is open.

name: Iron Backbone Ultra
description: Iron Backbone Ultra is a trail adventure in Kristinehamn built around the Iron Trail, offering three distances (15 km, 30 km, and 50 km). The race takes place in varied and characterful terrain - deep forests, marshlands, small lakes, pastures, and older trails - where both mental toughness and running joy are tested. The start and finish are at Hultets outdoor recreation area, and the 15 km course partly runs outside the Iron Trail. The organizer Topp & Dröm welcomes both experienced trail runners and those trying trail running for the first time.
course_highlights: The course largely follows the Iron Trail through varied terrain (forests, marshlands, lakes, pastures, and older trails)
Start and finish at Hultets outdoor recreation area, Kristinehamn
The 15 km course partly runs outside the Iron Trail
additional: Three distances are offered: 15 km, 30 km, and 50 km; start and finish at Hultets outdoor recreation area; from October 1st, the number of spots is limited to ensure a specially designed medal for all participants; organizer is Topp & Dröm (contact person Lasse / phone 073-853 75 21) and there are sections for water stations and equipment on the information pages. Start times: 30 km and 50 km at 17:00; 15 km at 17:30. No mug at water stations; bring your own mug. Start and finish at Hultets outdoor recreation area, Kristinehamn. Registration fees are updated over time and from October 1st, the number of spots is limited to secure a specially designed medal for all participants.

name: Jätten Bule-löpet
location: Österbymo, Ydre kommun, Jönköping County, Sweden
description: The Jätten Bule Race is a traditional cross-country race organized by IFK Österbymo on the first weekend of November. The race celebrated its 50th anniversary in 2019 and attracts runners of all ages to the Ydre forests. The distances vary from KnatteBule for the youngest, 2.4 km for children aged 4-12, as well as 5 km and 10 km in running or walking through challenging terrain. The event is a folk festival in autumn attire and welcomes both competitive and recreational runners.
course_highlights: Cross-country race in hilly and challenging forest terrain
Distances from children's race to 10 km for adults
The race takes place in the Ydre forests around Bulevallen and Bulespåret
additional: Distances include KnatteBule for the youngest, 2.4 km for children aged 4-12, as well as 5 km and 10 km in running or walking. Bulevallen is the gathering place and IFK Österbymo, together with Ydre Municipality, is responsible for the electric light trail Bulespåret, a 2.4 km hilly course used in connection with the event. The race includes various distances, from children's races to adult races, and is held in a scenic environment in Ydre. Weather conditions in 2026 may affect the terrain, but the race is open to all runners and outdoor enthusiasts.

name: Panevėžio maratonas
description: The Panevėžys Marathon 2024 will take place in Panevėžys, Lithuania, and registration will open on September 13, 2024. Anyone who has registered and had a health check may participate.
