Üritus on osa Liikumisharrastuse Kompetentsikeskuse tegevustest, mille eesmärk on edendada aktiivset eluviisi ja tervist. Sündmus kutsub osalema kõiki, kes soovivad parandada oma heaolu ja nautida liikumist erinevates eluetappides. Võru maakonna kaunis loodus loob meeldiva tausta liikumiseks.
course_highlights: Võru linna ja maakonna maastikud
Sobib jooksmiseks, kepikõndimiseks ja kõndimiseks
Liikumine hea enesetunde ja tervise nimel
additional: Võru linn, Võrumaa; osavõtutasud: tasuta lastele, teistele 2 eurot; registreerimine Stebby kaudu; kiibiajavõtt ja osavõtutingimused on olemas

name: Sunset Run 2026
description: Sunset Run on 5 km pikkune jooksu- ja kepikõnniüritus, mis toimub Stroomi ranna kergliiklusteedel ja Unibet Arena lähedal Tallinnas. Võistlus toimub Eesti Kergejõustikuliidu võistlusmääruste järgi ning osaleda võivad kõik piisavalt treenitud huvilised. Distantsi võib läbida joostes, käies või kepikõndi tehes, kus käijad ja kepikõndijad stardivad osalejate rivi lõpus. Võistlusel on eraldi arvestus erinevates vanuseklassides nii meestele kui naistele. Korraldajateks on MTÜ Sportlik Eesti ja MTÜ Triatloniakadeemia, kes tagavad professionaalse korralduse ja osalejate mugavuse.
course_highlights: 5 km distants Stroomi ranna kergliiklusteedel
Võimalus läbida joostes, käies või kepikõndi tehes
Võistlus toimub õhtusel ajal kell 20:30
additional: Registreerimine toimub internetis kuni 18. augustini 2026 kell 23:59. Kohapeal registreerimine ja stardimaterjalide väljastamine toimub 19. augustil kell 14:00-19:00 ja võistluspäeval 20. augustil kell 10:00-17:00 Rocca al Mare keskuses ning 20. augustil kell 18:30-20:15 Stroomi rannahoone juures. Ümberregistreerimine on võimalik lisatasu eest (10 €) kuni 18.08.2026. Osavõtumaksu tasumine toimub pangalingi kaudu registreerimisankeedi täitmise järgselt. Võistlusel on vanuseklasside arvestus ning osalemine toimub omal vastutusel. Race includes options for running, walking, and Nordic walking; registration online and on-site; start at 20:30; terrain on coastal paths and promenade.

name: XXXV-as tradicinis tarptautinis estafetinis bėgimas „Baltijos Kelias“
description: The 35th traditional international relay race “Baltic Way” will take place on August 21–24, 2027. The race symbolically retraces the 1989 Baltic Way, when millions of Lithuanians, Latvians, and Estonians joined hands in pursuit of freedom and independence. The approximately 650-kilometer route runs from Vilnius through Riga to Tallinn, with runners taking turns to cover stages of varying lengths. This is not only a sporting event, but also a living history lesson and a celebration of community, bringing together participants and supporters from the three Baltic countries.
course_highlights: An approximately 650 km route from Vilnius through Riga to Tallinn
A relay race through the three Baltic states
A symbolic reenactment of the historic human chain of the Baltic Way
additional: The race lasts four days, during which runners cover up to 200 kilometers each day. The event opens at Cathedral Square in Vilnius. Participants take turns in relay format, and the race is accompanied by meetings with people from towns and communities along the way. The event is part of the national physical activity program. It takes place over four days, with opportunities to meet and support the runners along the route, and commemorates the unity of the Baltic peoples.

name: Lüganuse rahvajooks
location: Kiviõli keskväljak, Kiviõli, Lüganuse vald, Ida-Viru maakond, Estonia
description: Lüganuse Rahvajooks on osa Ida-Viru jooksusarjast, mis toimub Kiviõli keskväljakul. Võistlusel on mitmed distantsid alates lastejooksust kuni 9 km jooksuni, sobides erinevatele vanuseklassidele ja oskustasemetele. Osalejad saavad nautida sõbralikku ja kogukondlikku atmosfääri ning võimalust võistelda sõpruskondade arvestuses. Registreerimine on lihtne ja osalustasu taskukohane, mis teeb sellest suurepärase sündmuse nii harrastajatele kui ka kogenud jooksjatele.
course_highlights: Mitmed distantsid: 300m lastejooksust kuni 9 km jooksuni
Võistlus toimub Kiviõli keskväljakul
Sõpruskondade arvestus ja kogukondlik võistlusmoment
additional: Osalejatele on avatud Bronto lastejooks 300m, 2 km, 5 km ja 9 km distantsid. Võistluskeskus avatud sekretariaat 10:30-11:55. Autasustamine toimub 15 minutit pärast viimase võistleja finišit kõigile vanuseklassidele koos. Võistlejad osalevad omal riisikol. Osalustasu saab tasuda kohapeal sularahas või Stebbys. Võistlus toimub Kiviõli keskväljakul, registreerimine on avatud nii online kui ka kohapeal, ning osalejad saavad valida erinevate distantside vahel.

name: Vilniaus bėgimo klubų taurė
location: Vingio parkas, Vilnius, Vilniaus rajonas, Vilnius, Lithuania
description: The Vilnius Running Clubs Cup is a running competition held at the Vingis Park Athletics Stadium in Vilnius. The event is intended for running clubs from Vilnius and other Lithuanian cities, sports clubs, families, children, young people, adults, seniors, and people with disabilities. The main event is a 5×1000 m team relay with five participants. Individual 1000 m races and a children’s 60 m race are also held. The event promotes physical activity, community spirit, and a healthy lifestyle in Vilnius.
course_highlights: The competition takes place at the Vingis Park Athletics Stadium
The main event is a 5×1000 m team relay
Individual 1000 m races and a children’s 60 m race are also held
additional: Competition schedule: 12:00 children’s 60 m race; 13:00 women’s 1000 m race and women’s tricycle race; 13:15 men’s 1000 m race and men’s tricycle race. The women’s, mixed, and men’s team relay events have been cancelled. The organizers reserve the right to adjust start times. The event includes various running events, including races for children, adults, and people with disabilities, and will take place on 28 August 2027.

name: Maraton Wigry
location: Stary Folwark, Wigierski Park Narodowy, Podlaskie Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Wigry Marathon is a unique marathon held within Wigry National Park, around the scenic Lake Wigry. The approximately 42.2 km course runs mainly along forest and unpaved paths, with a small proportion of asphalt, offering runners exceptionally clean air and beautiful views of the Suwałki and Sejny regions. This is not a marathon for setting personal bests, but for those who want to enjoy the exceptional natural surroundings and atmosphere. The event takes place on 22 August 2026, starting at the Monastery in Wigry and finishing at the Municipal Square in Stary Folwark.
course_highlights: The course is entirely within Wigry National Park
82% forest and unpaved roads and paths; 18% asphalt and sidewalks
Views of Lake Wigry and the clean air of the Green Lungs of Poland
additional: Transfer for participants to the start location. The technical briefing is optional. Bib transfers to another person are possible until the end of July 2026. A bonfire for participants and spectators after the race. The course map is available in GPX format. The event is scheduled for 22 August 2026, with online registration and a range of distances.

name: IV Maraton Wigry
location: Jezioro Wigry, Suwałki, Podlaskie Voivodeship, Poland
description: The IV Wigry Marathon is a unique marathon held in the scenic Wigry National Park, around Lake Wigry. The course runs mostly along forest and unpaved paths, with a short stretch of asphalt, offering runners pristine air and beautiful views of the Suwałki and Sejny regions. This is not a marathon for setting personal records, but for enjoying the exceptional nature and atmosphere. The start and finish are at historic locations, and after the race the organizers invite participants and spectators to a bonfire.
course_highlights: The course is entirely within Wigry National Park
82% forest roads, unpaved roads and paths; 18% asphalt and sidewalks
Views of Lake Wigry and the surrounding natural scenery
additional: The marathon starts at 09:30 at the Monastery in Wigry and finishes at 16:30 at the Municipal Square in Stary Folwark. The race office and registration are open until 08:30. The technical briefing is optional. Transfers to the start are available for participants. After the race, there will be an awards ceremony and a bonfire for participants and spectators. The course map is available in GPX format. The participant limit is 600 across both courses. Advance registration and an entry fee are required. The event also includes a shorter 13 km distance.

name: Naktinis bėgimas 2026
description: Night Run 2026 invites you to feel the rhythm of the night and immerse yourself in the end-of-summer buzz in Kaunas. It’s a unique opportunity to unwind from everyday life and end the summer with an energetic run featuring music, a sea of lights, and the company of enthusiastic runners. The event takes place in Town Hall Square and Santaka Park, offering spectacular views and an unforgettable nighttime adventure. Participants compete in the 2.5 km, 5 km, and 10 km distances, and the event is intended for both amateurs and professionals.
course_highlights: Course in Town Hall Square and Santaka Park
Night run with music and a sea of lights
Races over 2.5 km, 5 km, and 10 km
additional: Participants must attach their bib with the timing chip to the front of their shirt. Registration details and race distance can be changed until 2026-08-23 for a €5 fee. A participant’s time may not be recorded if they do not complete the course within the set time limit. The use of vehicles on the course is strictly prohibited. The event will take place in Kaunas; the course features a night run with lights, music, and a lively atmosphere. Registration and further information are available on the official website.

name: 22. Ülemiste metsajooks
description: 22. Ülemiste metsajooks on loodussõbralik 3 km pikkune trail jooks, mis toimub Tallinna Veepuhastusjaama ümbruses. Võistluskeskus ning start ja finiš asuvad aadressil Järvevana tee 3. Üritus on avatud kõigile jooksuhuvilistele ning pakub meeldivat ja sportlikku kogemust.
course_highlights: 3 km pikkune metsarada Tallinna Veepuhastusjaama ümbruses
Tähistatud rada ja spordijook ning vesi finišis
Meditsiiniline abi kogu raja ulatuses

The race will start and finish in Pakruojis City Park, where participants can enjoy not only the sport but also discover the nature and culture of northern Lithuania. The event brings together people of different ages and social groups to spend time actively and healthily.

Ürituse eesmärk on propageerida jooksuharrastust kui kättesaadavat liikumisviisi ning pakkuda sportlikku elamust erinevatele vanuseklassidele.

name: Alytaus Pusmaratonis – 2026
description: Alytus Half Marathon 2026 invites all running enthusiasts to a special summer finish in Alytus. The event starts and finishes in Alytus Town Hall Square, and the course passes through the city’s most beautiful spots—lush green parks, charming streets, and the banks of the Nemunas. Participants will experience a sense of community, movement, and excitement, with a festive atmosphere and support awaiting them at the finish. It’s a great opportunity to discover Alytus and take home unforgettable memories, whether you’re aiming for your best result or simply spending a meaningful day.
course_highlights: The course passes through lush green parks
Charming city streets
Inspiring banks of the Nemunas

Pika traditsiooniga jooksusarja etapid
additional: Sarjas on erinevad distantsid alates laste jooksudest kuni põhijooksudeni. Osalejate seas on nii noored kui ka eakamad jooksusõbrad. Sarja etapid toimuvad erinevates paikades Lääne-Virumaal, kus jooksusuund võib aastati muutuda. Võistlusel osalejad saavad valida erinevate distantside vahel ning registreerimine toimub veebis. Tulemused ja info avaldatakse sarja kodulehel.

name: Tallinna Sügisjooks 10 km
location: Vabaduse väljak, Tallinn, Harju County, Estonia
description: Tallinna Sügisjooks 10 km on sügisene jooksuvõistlus, mis toimub Tallinna kesklinnas Vabaduse väljakul. Start antakse 12. septembril 2026 kell 14.00. Võistlus sobib nii jooksjatele kui ka kõndijatele, pakkudes ajavõtuga ja ajavõtuta osalemisvõimalusi. Osalejatele on tagatud sõbralik atmosfäär ning võimalus nautida linna sügisest ilu.
course_highlights: 10 km pikkune rada Tallinna kesklinnas
Võimalus osaleda jooksu või käimisega, ajavõtuga või ilma
Start ja finiš Vabaduse väljakul
additional: Hinnasoodustused: 20% soodustus seenioridele alates 60. eluaastast ja noortele alla 20. eluaasta. 10% soodustus gruppidele, kui registreerub vähemalt 10 inimest korraga. Sündmus pakub soodustusi eakatele, noortele ja gruppidele ning on osa Tallinna Maratonist, mis toimub 11.-13. septembril 2026.

name: Nike Noortejooks
description: Nike Noortejooks on noortele suunatud jooksuvõistlus, mis toimub Tallinna südalinnas Vabaduse väljakul. See on osa Swedbanki Tallinna Maratoni üritustesarjast ja pakub noortele võimalust osaleda lõbusal ja sportlikul sündmusel. Jooksu start on õhtul, mis loob meeldiva atmosfääri ning toetab noorte aktiivset eluviisi. Registreerumine on lihtne ja soodushinnad kehtivad varajastele osalejatele.
course_highlights: Toimub Tallinna kesklinnas Vabaduse väljakul
Õhtune start kell 18:30
Noortele sobiv ja turvaline jooksukeskkond
additional: Registreerudes varakult on võimalik saada soodsamaid osavõtutasusid. Noortele ja seenioridele on Tallinna Maratoni sarjas ka erisoodustused. Osalejatele on tagatud turvaline jooksukeskkond ja korraldus. Võistlus toimub Tallinna vanalinnas ja Vabaduse väljakul, osalejatel on võimalus osa saada noorte sportlaste kogukonnast ning võistlusel on autasustamine parimate seas.

description: Jüri Jaansoni Kahe Silla jooks on traditsiooniline Pärnu jooksusündmus, mis toimub septembri esimesel nädalavahetusel. See toob kokku tuhandeid spordisõpru, pakkudes nii 10 km jooksu kui ka kepikõndi ja õhtujooksu. Võistlus toimub kauni Pärnu linna ja silla piirkonnas, pakkudes sportlikku elamust igas vanuses osalejatele. Ürituse korraldab Pärnu Kahe Silla Klubi, kes kutsub kõiki aktiivseid inimesi osalema ja nautima liikumist.
course_highlights: 10 km jooks ja kepikõnd Pärnu kaunites sildade piirkondades
Pärnu õhtujooks 3 km distantsil
Lastejooksud ja ratastoolisõit perepäeval
additional: Võistlusel on ajavõtuga ja ajavõtuta distantsid, lisaks toimub perepäev koos lastejooksude ja ratastoolisõiduga. Võistluskeskus asub Endla Teatri juures. Registreerimine toimub mitmes voorus, võimaldades soodsamaid hindu varajastele registreerujatele. Tegemist on perepäevaga, kus on võimalik osaleda erinevatel jooksu- ja käimisüritustel ning nautida kohalikke spordiklubi ja huvialakoolide tegevusi. Registreerimine ja täpsem info on kättesaadav organisatsiooni veebilehel.

name: 15. Kütioru maastikujooks-kõnd
description: Kütioru maastikujooks-kõnd on osa Võrumaa jooksu- ja kõnnisarjast, mis pakub mitmekesiseid distantsivalikuid nii jooksjatele kui ka kõndijatele. Võistlus toimub Kütioru Mäesuusakeskuses ning rada on maastikuline, pakkudes vaheldusrikast jooksukogemust. Sarjas on erinevad distantsid alates mudilaste jooksudest kuni põhidistantsideni, mis sobivad igale tasemele. Võistlus on traditsiooniline ja avatud kõigile spordihuvilistele, kes soovivad nautida Võrumaa kaunist loodust ja sportlikku seltskonda.
course_highlights: Maastikuline rada Kütioru Mäesuusakeskuse ümbruses
Mitmekesine distantsivalik alates mudilastest kuni põhidistantsideni
Võimalus nautida Võrumaa kaunist loodust ja vaheldusrikast maastikku
additional: Sarjas on jooksu- ja kõndimisvõimalused erinevatele vanusegruppidele ja tasemetele. Rada võib sisaldada nii asfalt- kui kruusateid ning pehmemat maapinda. Mudilaste jooksud toimuvad eraldi aladel. Võistluskeskus ja transpordikorraldus on tavaliselt ette nähtud, kuid täpsem info tuleb hooaja juhendist. Võistlusel osalejad saavad nautida kaunist loodust ja mitmekesist maastikku, ning sündmus on osa Võrumaa jooksu- ja kõnnisarjast, mis hõlmab erinevaid distantsse ja vanusegruppe.

name: Pärnu Õhtujooks ja Kahe Silla jooksu ratastoolisõit ja lastejooksud

price_tiers.distance: Jüri Jaansoni Kahe Silla jooks 10 km

description: Jüri Jaansoni Kahe Silla jooks on traditsiooniline Pärnu spordisündmus, mis toob septembri esimesel nädalavahetusel kokku tuhanded jooksusõbrad. Võistlus toimub Vaasa pargis ning hõlmab erinevaid distantsi- ja osavõtuvõimalusi, sealhulgas õhtujooks, ratastoolisõit ja lastejooksud. Kahe Silla jooks on tuntud oma kauni linna- ja sillaäärse raja poolest, mis pakub sportlikku väljakutset ja mõnusat atmosfääri kõigile osalejatele. Üritus on avatud nii harrastajatele kui ka kogenud jooksjatele ning rõhutab liikumise rõõmu ja kogukonna ühtsust.
course_highlights: 10 km jooks ja kõnd Vaasa pargi kaunil rajal
Õhtujooks ja perepäev koos lastejooksudega
Ratastoolisõit kaasava spordielamuse pakkumiseks
additional: Perepäeval on lisaks lastejooksud ja ratastoolisõit. Võistlused toimuvad Vaasa pargis. Võistluse raames on ka kõndimise võimalus. Registreerimine toimub veebilehel, kus on ka juhendid ja stardimaksud. Võistlusel on ajavõtt. Üritus hõlmab mitmeid jooksu- ja liikumisvõimalusi, sealhulgas lastejooksud, ratastoolisõit ning peamine 10 km jooks, mis kulgeb mööda Pärnu jõe ja linna kauneid vaateid.

name: 60. Festiwal Chodu
location: Portowy region Gdańska, Gdańsk, Pomorskie, Poland
description: The 60th Walking Festival is a prestigious international sporting event held in the port region of Gdańsk on 5 September 2026. It brings together athletes of various ages and ability levels, with race-walking events over 10 km (women and men, including Open, U20 and U18 categories), 5 km and 3 km for younger participants, as well as the Polish Masters Championships over 5 km. The festival also includes the Polish U23 Championships over 10 km and accompanying events such as the “Walk with the Postman” Prologue and the Polish Post Office Defenders’ Run – Energa Cup. The organiser, LECHIA Gdańsk Athletics Club, promotes physical activity among people with disabilities, too, with wheelchair races and FrameRunning competitions.
course_highlights: Race walking over 10 km, 5 km and 3 km, with distances suited to different age categories
Polish Masters Championships over 5 km and Polish U23 Championships over 10 km
Accompanying events, including the “Walk with the Postman” Prologue and the Polish Post Office Defenders’ Run
additional: The festival promotes physical activity among people with disabilities through wheelchair races and FrameRunning competitions. It is organised by LECHIA Gdańsk Athletics Club and supported by the Ministry of Sport and Tourism. Events cover several distances, including 10 km, 5 km and 3 km, and online registration is available. The event promotes sporting activity among people of different ages and people with disabilities, with support from the Ministry of Sport and Tourism.

name: 64 Bieg Westerplatte
description: The 64th Westerplatte Run is Poland’s oldest continuously held 10-kilometre road race, taking place in Gdańsk. The race starts at the historic site where World War II began, giving the event a unique character and an atmosphere of reflection on sacrifice and peace. The course is certified and marked at every kilometre, and the finish is at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk, providing an added attraction for participants. The event draws up to 5,000 runners and is both a sporting challenge and a tribute to the Defenders of the Coast in 1939.
course_highlights: Certified course marked every 1 km
An opportunity to run through the Tunnel under the Dead Vistula, which is normally closed to pedestrian traffic
Finish at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk, a modern football stadium
additional: Race bib collection at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk on 6–7 September 2026. Water station on the course at approximately 6 km. Participant limit: 5,000. Free buses will take runners to the start on race day. Bag drop available with a race bib sticker. No showers. The awards ceremony will take place at the finish at approximately 11:45. Cash prizes and trophies for the winners in the OPEN and age-group categories. Registration runs from 2026-03-02 to 2026-08-20, with a limit of 4,900 participants. Official T-shirts can be purchased at the Expo. The event includes race-pack collection, the Expo, transport, the start, and the awards ceremony at Westerplatte.

name: Self-Transcendence 2 mailin juoksu, Vaasa
description: The Self-Transcendence 2 Mile Run Vaasa takes place every Tuesday from May to September at 7:00 p.m. on the Hietalahti Peace Mile. The course is a 1-mile park route completed twice. The start and registration are behind the swimming hall. The run offers a fast and pleasant park route suitable for runners of all levels.
course_highlights: A 1-mile park route
The course is completed twice
The start and registration are behind the swimming hall
additional: Runs are held every Tuesday from May to September. The event has several age-group categories. Results from previous years are available. The event is organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team, which has served the running community for over 35 years. The event takes place every Tuesday at 7 p.m. through September, and no entry fee is specified.

name: Ukmergės fabrikų krosų taurės 4 etapas
location: Ukmergė, Ukmergė district municipality, Vilnius County, Lithuania
description: The Ukmergė Factory Cross-Country Cup 2026 is a five-stage sporting event featuring cross-country running, MTB cross-country cycling, and rogaining competitions. The event encourages active recreation in nature and promotes sport among participants of all ages. The competitions take place in Ukmergė, with VšĮ Sportas miške as the main organizer. Participants compete in age groups and event categories, and all groups have a mass start. The time limit is 120 minutes, except for Mini Rogaining.
course_highlights: The competitions take place at the stadium of Šilas Basic School.
All groups have a mass start, the same at every stage.
The event features running, MTB cross-country cycling, and rogaining competitions.
additional: Race bibs and timing chips are issued at the start venue from 16:30 to 17:30. The cycling event starts at 18:00 (19:15 for the night stage). The running event starts at 18:05 (19:20 for the night stage). The hikers start at 18:10 (19:25 for the night stage). Maps for the rogaining event are distributed at 17:45, and the start is at 18:00. The time limit to finish the competitions is 120 minutes (except for Mini Rogaining). The event features competitions in several sports; registration takes place at the venue, participants may be of various ages, and there are multiple stages and different events.

name: Finlandiaviesti
location: Jyväskylä, Rantaraitti, Jyväskylä, Central Finland, Finland
description: Finlandiaviesti 1/2026 is part of the Finlandia Marathon event, held in Jyväskylä on 11–12 September 2026. The event offers runners a range of distances, including 5 km, 10 km, the half marathon and the marathon, and is suitable for runners of all levels. The route follows Jyväskylä’s Rantaraitti, which has been awarded the title of Finland’s most beautiful traffic route, offering a flat and fast running experience. The Finlandia Marathon is known for its runner-friendly course, excellent atmosphere and memorable event weekend amid the beautiful scenery of Central Finland.
course_highlights: Flat and fast route along Jyväskylä’s Rantaraitti
Route awarded the title of Finland’s most beautiful traffic route
Water stations along the route, with tables reserved for runners’ own drinks
additional: There are water stations along the route, with tables for runners’ own drinks beside them. Students receive a €10 discount on the entry fee (€5 for the Finlandia Vitosella). An S-Etukortti or Juoksijakortti gives a €4 discount on the entry fee. Cancellation protection is included for registrations made by 31.5; after that, the cancellation protection fee is €5. The event includes relays, the marathon, the half marathon and shorter races, giving participants the chance to enjoy the beautiful surroundings and great atmosphere.

name: ASTRI KESKUS Narva Sügisjooks 2026
location: Astri Keskus, Narva, Ida-Viru maakond, Estonia
description: Astri Keskus Narva Sügisjooks 2026 on Ida-Viru maakonnas toimuv jooksu-, käimise- ja kõndimisüritus, mis kutsub kõiki liikumishuvilisi osalema. Üritus on osa Liikumisharrastuse kompetentsikeskuse tegevustest, mille eesmärk on edendada tervislikku ja aktiivset eluviisi. Sügisjooks pakub võimalust nautida liikumist ning toetada oma vaimset ja füüsilist tervist. Osalejad saavad valida endale sobiva liikumisviisi ning kogeda liikumisrõõmu koos teistega.
course_highlights: Toimub Astri Keskuse ümbruses Ida-Viru maakonnas
Sobib jooksmiseks, käimiseks ja kõndimiseks
Osalejate liikumisaktiivsust toetav ja tervist edendav üritus
additional: Sündmus hõlmab jooksu, kõndimist ja käimist ning toimub 19. septembril 2026. Registreerimine on avatud ning üritus on suunatud kõigile vanuse- ja tasemekategooriatele.

name: 84. laste Paala järve jooks
description: 84. laste Paala järve jooks on traditsiooniline laste jooksuvõistlus, mis toimub Paala järve rannas Viljandi lähedal. Võistlusel on erinevad distantsid vastavalt laste vanusele, alates 300 meetrist kuni kahe ringi jooksuni ümber järve. Jooksu korraldab tervisespordiklubi JOOSU ning see pakub lastele võimalust aktiivselt sportida ja nautida loodust. Võistlus algab 12. septembril 2026 kell 10:00 ning osalejatele on ette nähtud auhinnad ja meenemed.
course_highlights: Start ja finiš Paala järve rannas
Jooks ümber Paala järve, üks ring 1200 m
Distantsid alates 300 m kuni 2 ringi (2400 m)
additional: Võistlejate registreerimine algab kell 10:00 samal päeval. Distantsid on jaotatud vanusegruppide järgi: tillujooks 300 m (5-a ja nooremad), põhijooks 1 ring ümber järve (6 - 10-a poisid ja tüdrukud ning 11 - 12-a tüdrukud) ja põhijooks 2 ringi ümber järve (11 - 12-a poisid). Palju auhindu ja meeneid. Jooksu korraldab tervisespordiklubi JOOSU. Võistlus algab kell 10:00, registreerimine toimub kohapeal; üritus keskendub tervisele ja liikumisele ning on suunatud lastele ja noortele.

name: Tahko Trail Run
organizer: Kuopio-Tahko Markkinointi Oy ja TAHKOcom Oy
description: Tahko Trail Run is a new trail running event held amid the stunning scenery of Tahkovuori on 12 September 2026. The event offers four distances to choose from, suitable for both first-timers and experienced trail runners. The routes pass through varied landscapes close to nature, with heart-pumping climbs and breathtaking views. The event focuses on memorable experiences, atmosphere, well-marked routes and aid stations. The finish area offers a race-day atmosphere, food, and the chance to use the sauna and shower at Break Sokos Hotel Tahko.
course_highlights: The 8.5 km route features Tahko’s most beautiful natural attractions and scenery, and is also suitable for walking.
The 14 km route offers a challenge and memorable experiences, with approximately 370 m of elevation gain.
The challenging yet rewarding 23 km route follows the trails of Rahasmäki and includes the legendary Tahko Stairs, with approximately 650 m of elevation gain.
additional: The routes are well marked, and there are several aid stations offering water, sports drinks, fruit and salty snacks. Drinks are served only into your own container, so bringing your own cup or water bottle is recommended. Participants receive a medal as a keepsake at the finish, and light snacks and drinks are available in the finish area. The meal is a pasta buffet at Break Sokos Hotel Tahko. Participants can use the hotel’s shower and sauna. Bib collection and the information desk are located at Hophaus Tahko, next to the event area. The cloakroom is self-service and is not continuously supervised. There is plenty of parking, but most spaces are paid; free parking is available beside Tahkonlahti beach, about a 10-minute walk from the event area. The event includes drinks, a pasta buffet at Break Sokos Hotel Tahko, and access to the hotel’s shower and sauna. Children and families can also participate.

name: SaaristoTrail
description: SaaristoTrail is an exciting trail-running event in Parainen, offering varied routes through stunning archipelago scenery. The event has three main distances: 7 km, 14 km and a 21 km half marathon, suitable for both beginners and more experienced trail runners. The routes include varied trails, forest tracks and significant elevation changes, including the steep climbs of Svinövuori, offering unforgettable views and a challenge. The relaxed atmosphere and careful organization make it an enjoyable experience for all participants.
course_highlights: Varied trails and forest tracks
Steep climbs up Svinövuori, with juice served at the summit
Approximately 850 metres of total ascent on the 21 km route
additional: The 1 km children's run is free for those who register in advance (the last day to register is 10.9) and costs 5 euros for late registration. All children taking part receive a medal. The event centre is at Finby Ski Stadium, where shower facilities are also available in the changing rooms at Archipelagia Golf. The route is marked with red-and-white plastic tape. Race materials can be collected from the race office starting at 8.45 and up to half an hour before your start. Juice and water are available at the finish, and the results are posted on the information board. Late registration at the event venue is available via MobilePay or bank card; cash is not accepted. The event offers different route options, so participants can choose a suitable distance. Routes and results are available on the event website, and the event offers a chance to enjoy the archipelago’s natural scenery and the joy of exercise.

name: Tampere Maraton 13.9.2026
description: Tampere Marathon is a true city marathon, held in the heart of Tampere on 13 September 2026. The event offers a marathon, half marathon, 10 km race, minimarathon for the youngest members of the family, and a marathon relay for teams of four. The route runs through the city centre and alongside Tampere’s waterways, mostly on asphalt and partly on gravel paths, offering beautiful urban scenery and a challenge for runners. The start and finish area is at Tampere Stadium, which is well connected by public transport. Organised by runners, for runners, the event offers the joy of achievement to runners of all ages and abilities.
course_highlights: The route runs through the city centre and alongside Tampere’s waterways
Mostly asphalt with some gravel paths; the route has been officially measured
Two aid stations approximately every 3–4 km, with toilets at the aid stations
additional: Race office open Sat 12.9. from 16:00 to 19:00 and Sun 13.9. from 8:00 onwards at Tampere Stadium. The 10 km start is at Aleksandra Siltanen Park, approximately 2 km from the stadium; allow 20 minutes to get to the start. Changing rooms and bag storage at Tampere Stadium. Marathon pacers will run target times of 3:45 (uncertain), 4:00, 4:15, 4:30 and 5:00. A hot soup meal, juice and water will be available at the finish. Timing and results service by MyLaps Sports Service. Lead cyclists ensure the front runners have an unobstructed route. Traffic control on the course is provided in cooperation with the police. The event takes place on 13.9.2026; registration is open online; various categories and distances are available; participants are provided with race services and route information; Runner’s Card discounts are available, and participation can be transferred with a medical certificate.

name: Swedbank Vilniaus maratonas 2026
description: The Swedbank Vilnius Marathon is the largest running event in Lithuania, held in Vilnius Old Town. The event offers a range of distances, from a children’s run to a full marathon, allowing every participant to find a challenge that suits them. The marathon courses wind through the streets and parks of Vilnius Old Town and along the banks of the Neris, offering unforgettable views and experiences. This international event attracts runners from countries around the world and is a great opportunity to enjoy sport and a sense of community.
course_highlights: The course winds through Vilnius Old Town, Vingis Park and along the banks of the Neris
Marathon, half-marathon, 10 km, 5 km and children’s run distances
Scenic city streets and parks, with an international running community
additional: The race bib must be attached to the front of the shirt and be clearly visible. Participants in the marathon, half-marathon, 10 km, 5 km, walking and children’s run are awarded commemorative medals. Portable toilets will be available at the event gathering areas. Minors must have consent from a parent or guardian to collect their race bibs. Corporate registration closes on September 1. The event offers a range of distances, children’s runs and walking events; registration information and free shirts for early registrants.

name: RUN & RAVE Palanga
description: RUN & RAVE Palanga is a new community initiative for people who love movement, music and good energy. The event takes place in Palanga and includes mobility training, a 5 km social run with DJ music, an ice bath ritual and coffee breaks. It’s a great opportunity to meet new people, make connections and experience the energy of summer at a single morning event. Registration is required, and participants are invited to bring running shoes, swim shorts and a towel.
course_highlights: 5 km social run with DJ music
Mobility training
Ice bath at Vytauto Ice Bath
additional: The event takes place several times during the summer, including 2026-09-13. Participants are invited to bring running shoes, swim shorts and a towel. RUN & RAVE is a community event combining movement, music and good energy, with DJ music and an ice bath after the run. The event location is Palanga, and the event date is September 13, 2026. The event includes social runs in an urban setting. Advance registration is required. The event aims to foster community spirit and an active lifestyle.
