description: Visahölkkä is a traditional running event held in the rural surroundings of Ojakkala on the first Sunday in October. The event has been organized since 2007, and participation has settled at 30–50 runners. Visahölkkä is part of the Vihti Hölkkäkunkku series and, in addition to competitive categories, offers a fitness category in which the fastest woman and man are awarded. The start is at Ojakkala School, and the event is open to runners of all ages.
course_highlights: A run through the rural surroundings of Ojakkala
The route is shown on the Visahölkkä route map
The event is part of the Vihti Hölkkäkunkku series
additional: Register by 12:45 at the venue or in advance by email. The top three finishers in the competitive categories receive awards. In the fitness category, the fastest woman and man receive awards. Payments should be made to Ojakkalan Visa’s account: FI11 4006 1520 0181 71. A route map is available. The run is part of the Vihti Hölkkäkunkku running series. Registration is available in advance or at the venue.

name: Solvalla Trail
location: Nuuksio National Park, Espoo, Uusimaa, Finland
description: Solvalla Trail returns to the trail-running calendar in the Nuuksio area of Espoo on Sunday, October 4, 2026. The event offers runners the chance to enjoy scenic trails over two distances: 9 km and 18 km. Organized by Esbo IF, it is suitable for both experienced trail runners and recreational runners. Join us for an exciting and memorable trail-running event in beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: Trail running through the scenic terrain of Nuuksio
Two distances: 9 km and 18 km
The event takes place in Espoo on October 4, 2026
additional: Trail race in Nuuksio with 9 km and 18 km options, route marked in the forest, race day is October 4, 2026.

name: PINK RUN su Antėja
location: Kauno muzikinio teatro parkas, Kaunas, Lithuania
description: Pink Run with Antėja is an annual charity pink-ribbon run in Kaunas, dedicated to fighting breast cancer and preventing the disease. The event takes place at the Kaunas Musical Theatre park and along Laisvės Avenue, offering courses of various lengths for both professionals and recreational runners. It is a joyful, positive sporting celebration where participants run for the women they love, dressed in pink costumes and adorned with pink paint and balloons. The funds raised support women with cancer. The event invites everyone to join and support this important mission.
course_highlights: 600 m children's run in the city park
5 km and 10 km courses along Kaunas’s Laisvės Avenue
Joyful atmosphere with pink costumes, paint and balloons
additional: Race bib collection takes place on Friday and Saturday from 11:00 to 19:00, and on event day from 9:00 until 30 minutes before the start. The bib collection venue is at I. Kanto St. 25, next to the KAVALIERIUS café. Several start times are scheduled for event day: 5 km starts at 11:00 and 12:00; 10 km starts at 13:00 and 14:30. Award ceremonies and a contest for the most original participant costume take place after the runs. Registration takes place at I. Kanto St. 25 in Kaunas; queues for bib collection may form on event day. The event programme includes warm-ups, award ceremonies and the costume contest.

name: /M.Pirksaare/Türi Tehisjärve jooks, liikumissari 8. Järvamaa Järvede jooksud 11. etapp
description: Türi Tehisjärve jooks on osa 8. Järvamaa Järvede jooksude sarjast, mis pakub mitmekesiseid jooksuvõimalusi erinevatele vanuseklassidele. Rada kulgeb ümber Rava tehisjärve, pakkudes vaheldusrikast pinnast liivast, mullast ja kruusast. Võistlusel autasustatakse parimaid jooksjaid ning see sobib nii harrastajatele kui ka noortele jooksusõpradele. Üritus toimub 7. oktoobril 2026 Rava järve ääres Järvamaal.
course_highlights: Jooksurada ümber Rava tehisjärve
Vahelduv pinnas: liiv, muld ja kruus
Rajale jäävad mitmed järvevaated
additional: Järvamaa Järvede jooksude sarjas arvestatakse jooksjaid erinevates vanuseklassides. Rajal on eraldi stardikoridorid ning jooksud sobivad nii mudilastele kui ka täiskasvanutele. Võistlusel autasustatakse parimaid mehi ja naisi, kes läbivad ühe järveringi kõige kiirema ajaga. Võistlus on osa Järvamaa Järvede jooksud sarjast, mis hõlmab mitmeid etappe ning toetab kogukonna ja tervisespordi edendamist.

name: 42. Munamäe–Võru maastikujooks-kõnd
location: SA Võru Spordikeskuse suusabaas Kubijal, Võru, Estonia
description: 42. Munamäe - Võru maastikujooks-kõnd on osa Võrumaa jooksu- ja kõnnisarjast, mis pakub mitmekesiseid distantsivalikuid nii jooksjatele kui ka kõndijatele. Põhidistants kulgeb maastikul ja asfaltteedel, pakkudes vaheldusrikast rada Võru piirkonnas. Sarjas on ka lühemad distantsid ning mudilaste jooksud, mis sobivad igas vanuses osalejatele. Võistlus toimub SA Võru Spordikeskuse suusabaasis Kubijal, mis on tuntud oma kauni looduse ja hea rajatingimuste poolest.
course_highlights: Põhidistants kulgeb maastikul ja asfaltteedel Võru piirkonnas
Mitmekesised distantsid: ca 5,9 km, minidistants 1,16 km ja mudilaste jooksud
Rada on osaliselt maastikuline, osaliselt asfaltkattega
additional: Võistluskeskus avatakse kell 11:00 Kubija Suusabaasis. Bussid väljuvad Kubijalt erinevatesse stardipaikadesse, näiteks Haanjasse ja Kasaritsasse. Sarjas on lisaks jooksule ka kõnd ja mudilaste jooksud. Rada on osaliselt asfalt- ja kruusateedel ning sisaldab ka pehmemat maad Haanja Puhke- ja Spordikeskuse territooriumil. Võistluse raames toimuvad ka väiksemad distantsid lastele ja algajatele, ning registreerimine ning kaardid on kättesaadavad korraldaja kodulehel. Üritus toetab tervislikke eluviise ja kogukonna aktiivset osalemist.

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 7. Võsu Sügisjooks
description: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari on traditsiooniline jooksu- ja kõnnisari, mis pakub mitmekesiseid jooksuvõimalusi erinevatele vanuseklassidele ja tasemetele. Sarja etapid toimuvad Lääne-Virumaa piirkonnas, pakkudes jooksjatele kauneid maastikke ja meeldivat sportlikku kogemust. Võsu Sügisjooks on sarja 7. etapp, mis toimub Võsu Laine piirkonnas ning on osa pika traditsiooniga jooksusarjast. Sarja eesmärk on motiveerida inimesi aktiivselt liikuma ja nautima jooksu ning tervisesporti.
course_highlights: Mitmekesine maastik Lääne-Virumaa piirkonnas
Pika traditsiooniga jooksusarja osa
Rajad sobivad erinevatele vanuseklassidele ja tasemetele
additional: Sarjas on erinevad distantsid ja vanuseklassid, sh noortejooksud ja lastejooksud. Sarja etapid toimuvad erinevates paikades Lääne-Virumaal, kusjuures jooksude suund ja maastik võivad aastati varieeruda. Osalejatele on oluline registreeruda õigeaegselt, kuid täpsemad registreerumise ja hinnainfo detailid puuduvad. Võsu Sügisjooksu raames toimuvad ka teised jooksud ja tegevused, registreerimine toimub veebis ning osalejatele on võimalus saada autasustusi vanuseklasside kaupa.

name: 71. Viljandi Linnajooks
description: Viljandi Linnajooks on traditsiooniline kestvusjooks, mis toimub igal aastal oktoobrikuu teisel pühapäeval Viljandi linnas. Jooks kulgeb ümber Viljandi järve ning on üks Eesti vanimaid spordivõistlusi, kuhu koguneb jooksuparemik üle kogu riigi. Lisaks põhijooksule toimub mitmeid rahvaspordiüritusi, sealhulgas lastejooksud erinevatele vanusegruppidele. Viljandi Linnajooksu rada on 10,4 km pikkune ning üritus pakub sportlikku ja meeleolukat kogemust nii harrastajatele kui ka profisportlastele.
course_highlights: Jooks ümber Viljandi järve
Raja pikkus 10,4 km
Üks Eesti vanimaid kestvusjooksu traditsioone
additional: Lastejooksud vanusegruppidele 5 - 6, 7 - 8, 9 - 10 ja 11 - 12 aastat, tasuta ja ilma ajavõtuta. Rahvajooks 5 km kell 11.00. Autasustamine toimub kell 14.00. Registreerimine ja stardimaterjalide väljastamine Vabaduse platsil 9.00 - 11.30. Jooksutrassi sulgemine kell 14.30. Võistluspäev algab registreerimisega Vabaduse platsil kell 9:00 ning võistlused toimuvad kuni kella 14:30. Osalejatele antakse medaleid ning võistluse raames korraldatakse ka lastevõistlusi ja harrastajate jooksu.

name: Sõeru Kevadjooks
description:
Sõeru Kevadjooks on pühendatud ajaloolisele Sõeru silmaallikale, mis asub Vanamõisa
multifunktsionaalsel tervise- ja õpperajal. Jooksu eesmärgiks on jooksuharrastuse
propageerimine, võistlusvõimaluse pakkumine ja ka võitjate selgitamine erinevatel
distantsidel. Oluline on ka tutvustada piirkonda, pakkuda värskes õhus sportlikku vaba aja
veetmise võimalust kogu perele ning propageerida sportlikke eluviise.
additional:
Registreerimine ja stardid toimuvad Vanamõisa vabaõhukeskuses (Vabaõhukeskuse tee 20), Harjumaa, Saue vald, Vanamõisa küla. Stardimaterjalide väljastamine toimub 12. mail kell 17:00-20:00
Vanamõisa karavanpargi kohvikus (Vabaõhukeskuse tee 18). 13. mail toimub stardimaterjalide väljastamine ja võistlejate registreerimine alates kell 15:00 Vanamõisa vabaõhukeskuse palksaalis. Numbrite väljastamine lõpeb kell 17:15 ja lastejooksudele kell 16:30.

Lastejooksud algavad kell 17:00
Põhijooksu start kell 18:00
Noortejooksu start kell 18:10
Kõik stardid antakse Vanamõisa vabaõhukeskusest. Samas kohas on ka finiš.

images.alt_text: Sõeru Jooks 13.05.2026 jooksjad ja linn siluett

name: Kopli Liinide Jooks
description:
Rada algab Kopli Liinide promenaadilt. Teekond jätkub läbi Kopli Käsepargi, seejärel mööda mereäärt.

Raja esimene pool kulgeb mööda mereäärt, pakkudes kauneid vaateid Kopli lahele.

Rada läbib ka Paljassaare hoiuala, mis on kaunis looduskaitseala ja tuntud linnuvaatluse koht. Seejärel liigume läbi Tallinna Vesi territooriumi, kus on võimalik näha, kuidas toimub vee puhastamine, enne kui naaseme tagasi promenaadile.

name: Haaga Run
description: Haaga Run will be held for the ninth time on 8 November 2025 in Helsinki! The event is organized jointly by Runner's High and FC POHU, with 5 km and 10 km race distances. The event features a mass start, making it a great opportunity for running enthusiasts.

images.alt_text: Haaga Run -juoksun voittajat, iloisia ja medaljit kaulassa.
Haaga Run -juoksukilpailuun osallistujia. Lapsi juoksee iloisesti.
Haaga Run -juoksukilpailun kuva, jossa juoksijat juoksevat maastossa.

name: NUTS HEL
description: NUTS HEL is an urban trail running event in Helsinki's Central Park, with three different distances: 6 km, 14 km and 25 km. The event is suitable for both first-timers and experienced runners. The start and finish are at Eläintarha Sports Field, and the longest route takes runners along the trails of the Haltiala Forest Nature Reserve. On Friday evening, NUTS Kids & Juniors is also held for the family's youngest trail runners!

images.alt_text: NUTS HEL -polkujuoksun maaliintulo. Juoksijat lähestyvät voittoa.
Eläintarhan urheilukenttä, NUTS HEL -kisan lähtö- ja maalipaikka.

name: Esi-Teivocup
description: Teivocup is a winter-season test run series held around Teivo Racecourse once a month from November to April. Each race is 5 km, with men’s and women’s categories. The event is for all fitness enthusiasts, whether recreational joggers, competitive runners or marathoners.

images.alt_text: Talvinen juoksukilpailu, jossa osallistujat juoksevat lumisella radalla.

name: Hercules Trail Run
description: Hercules Trail Run is a trail running event held in Mustijoki, Porvoo, on October 11, 2025. The event offers races on routes of different lengths, including 2 km, 7 km, 14 km, and 21 km, so there is something for runners of all fitness levels. The trail rally is designed especially for younger participants, and adults can safely run alongside the children.

images.alt_text: Kartta Hercules, CA:n alueesta, jossa Hercules Trail Run järjestetään.
Juoksukilpailu, jossa lapset ja aikuiset juoksevat.

name: Nummela Backyard Ultra
description: Nummela Backyard Ultra is an ultrarunning race held on Nummelanharju. The race ends when only one runner remains. The race is run on the orange daytime course, which is 6.7 km long, and the blue night loop, which consists of two 3.35 km laps.

images.alt_text: Nummela Backyard Ultra -juoksukilpailun tunnelmaa. Juoksijat lähellä maalia.
Nummela Backyard Ultra -juoksukilpailun kuva sateisessa säässä. Juoksijat juoksevat maantietä.
Nummela Backyard Ultra -reitin kartta. Oranssi ja sininen lenkki näkyvät.

name: Forssan Puistojuoksu
description: Forssa Park Run is a running event held since 1985 that attracts runners of different age groups. Held once a month, the event draws 100–200 participants, and its scenic route winds through the landscapes along the Loimijoki River. Runners can choose between a 5.8 km and an 11.2 km route, which runs near Forssa city centre through the park of the old cotton mill. The event awards the best runners, and the most active participants in particular receive an annual medal.

images.alt_text: Puistojuoksukilpailun juoksijoita Loimijoen varrella.  Hyvä kuva!
Forssan Puistojuoksun 2023 kausikorttimainos. Juoksijoita ja päivämäärät.

name: Kotojärven Ympärijuoksu
description: Kotojärven Ympärijuoksu is a traditional running event held at Mika Waltari School in Pornainen. The event gives participants the chance to challenge themselves in beautiful natural surroundings, and the route is designed to offer a suitable challenge. Last year, 73 people took part, and more than 100 runners are expected this year across the different categories, which include distances of 14.3 km, 6.8 km, and 2.2 km.

name: Dark Run Lahti
description: Dark Run Lahti is a unique fun run held in the fading light of an autumn evening amid the stunning scenery of Salpausselkä. The event offers 5 km and 10 km distances suitable for participants of all fitness levels. Runners travel mainly along outdoor trails by headlamp, and the event also includes the optional Dark Forest horror experience, which adds excitement to the course. The atmospheric event centre is located at Lahti Sports Centre. After the run, there is an awards ceremony and prize draws.
course_highlights: The routes follow unlit outdoor trails through Salpausselkä’s autumn scenery
There are two aid stations on the 10 km route and one on the 5 km route
Optional Dark Forest horror experience on the final forest section
additional: The race uses an electronic timing system, with timing tags attached to race bibs. The awards ceremony is at 20:15, with prizes for the three fastest finishers in the 5 km and 10 km distances, as well as prize draws for all participants. The event centre has showers, saunas and toilets. Participants may run, walk or Nordic walk the distances. The event includes running in the dark, a horror experience and fenced routes; the minimum age is 12. The event is held at Lahti Sports Centre and in the surrounding area.

name: NUTS HEL
location: Helsingin Keskuspuisto ja Haltialan metsät, Helsinki, Finland
organizer: Northern Ultra Trail Service - NUTS oy
description: NUTS HEL is an urban trail running event held in Helsinki Central Park and the Haltiala forests on 9–10 October 2026. The event offers a range of distances for runners of all levels, including the Kids & Juniors categories for children and young people. The routes run through nature in an urban setting, offering a memorable running experience in autumnal Helsinki. On Friday, Nightfall 6K is run in the dark by headlamp, and on Saturday the longer distances of 6 km, 14 km and 25 km are available. The event is designed for both first-timers and more experienced trail runners.
course_highlights: Urban trail running in Helsinki Central Park and the Haltiala forests
Nightfall 6K is run in the dark by headlamp
Three aid stations on the route: Hakamäentie, Pirkkola and Paloheinä
additional: The event centre and start are at Eläintarha Sports Field, from where runners set off on the trails of Central Park. Bib distribution begins on Friday at 15:00. Baggage storage is available at the event area at your own risk. The aid stations offer water, NOSHT sports drink, savoury and sweet snacks, and soft drinks on the 25 km route. A hot soup, also available as a vegan option, is served at the finish. Portable toilets and showers are available in the changing rooms at Eläintarha. The race is partially self-supported, and outside assistance is permitted only at official aid stations. The event offers an urban route close to nature in Central Park and the Haltiala forests. Participants can register through the event website, and the event is family-friendly and community-oriented.

name: Hercules Trail Run
description: Hercules Trail Run is a trail-running event held for the tenth time, inviting runners to experience Porvoo’s finest trails and seaside scenery in the crisp October air. The event offers a variety of route options for all fitness levels, from the 2 km children’s Trail Rally to a 42 km trail run. Race day begins with the children’s Trail Rally and continues with several distances along beautiful, varied trails in the Porvoo area. The entry fee includes a range of services. Photo and video material will be recorded during the event and used for event communications.
course_highlights: 2 km Trail Rally for children, with no risk of getting lost
Trail runs of 7 km, 14 km, 21 km and 42 km, with different numbers of laps
Stunning seaside scenery at Mustijoki in Porvoo
additional: Start times: 9:00 race office opens; 11:00 2 km Trail Rally; 12:00 7 km; 12:05 42 km; 12:15 21 km; 12:25 14 km. The finish closes at 20:00. The entry fee includes communications and photography. Participants’ names will be published in the start and results lists. Adults may run along with children in the Trail Rally if they can keep up. Trail running, multiple distances, natural terrain, coastal views, registration information, event schedule

name: Säkylänharjun polkujuoksu

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Perhemaksu 80 € (Ilmoita maksaessasi, keitä osallistujia perheeseen kuuluu)

description: Säkylänharju Trail Run will take place on Saturday, 10 October 2026, at the Huovinrinne Biathlon Centre in Säkylä. The event offers trail-running enthusiasts a variety of routes, including a section through Klopin monttu. The race centre is easy to reach, and the event is known for its tried-and-tested format. Participants can choose from different distances and enjoy the tranquillity of nature and varied terrain.
course_highlights: Routes pass through Klopin monttu
Race centre at the Huovinrinne Biathlon Centre
Varied trails and peaceful natural surroundings
additional: Late entries can be made at the race office on race day, no later than one hour before your start. The entry fee can also be paid at the race office using the Epassi app. The race centre is at the Huovinrinne Biathlon Centre, with parking at the venue. By registering, you agree to the publication of your name and team details and to the use of photo and video material in the event’s communications. The routes pass through the kettle hollows of the esker and pine heathland; drink stations and a hot meal are included; registration is available in advance and at the event; various categories and distances.

name: Vantaan Kestävyyskierros
distance_verbose: 100 km, Maraton, 30 km, Puolimaraton, 10 km, 10 km, 5 km, 2.5 km, 1500 metriä
description: The Vantaa Endurance Tour 2023 is starting! Sign up for the Vantaa Endurance Tour, where you’ll challenge yourself in five different sports. The tour is suitable for fitness enthusiasts and endurance athletes of all levels, and offers a great opportunity to try completely new sports. In 2023, one registration gives you access to five endurance events in Vantaa, allowing you to focus on training instead of searching for races.

images.alt_text: Hiihtäjä Vantaan kestävyyskierroksen reitillä.  Aurinkoinen päivä ja hyvin hoidettu latu.
Vantaan Kestävyyskierros -logo. Sininen tausta ja keltainen teksti.

name: Valon Kymppi
description: Valon Kymppi is a 10 km running event held every autumn in Jyväskylä. The late start, fading evening light and glow of the city lights along the Rantaraitti create a unique atmosphere for the run. The route has been awarded Finland’s most beautiful transport route. It is flat and fast, and the event centre is Jyväskylä Paviljonki.

images.alt_text: Valon Kymppi -juoksun lähtö Jyväskylässä. Juoksijat valmiina startissa.
Valon Kymppi -juoksija hymyilee ja näyttää peukkua Jyväskylän maisemissa.
Valon Kymppi -juoksija hymyilee ja näyttää peukkua Jyväskylän Rantaraitilla.
Valon Kymppi - Jyväskylän reittikartta. 10km juoksu Rantaraitilla.

name: Nevas Night Run
description: The Nevas Night Run 2026 event will be run or walked on 4 September 2026 in Kalkkiranta, Sipoo. Participants can choose between two distances: 12.5 km and 7 km. The longer distance includes two laps around Byträsket, while the shorter distance is designed for all runners. The revamped event also features new categories and a new start location, bringing participants new challenges and experiences.

images.alt_text: Mainos Nevas Night Run -juoksusta. Juoksija osoittaa banneria, jossa juoksukilpailun logo.
Nevas Night Run logo, jossa juoksijoita ja tähtiä pimeässä.

name: Finlandia Marathon
description: Finlandia Marathon is a running event held in Jyväskylä on 11–12 September 2026. The route follows Jyväskylä’s flat, fast Rantaraitti, which has been awarded the title of Finland’s most beautiful transport route. The event centre is Lutakonaukio and Jyväskylä Paviljonki.

images.alt_text: Finlandia Marathonin lähtö Jyväskylässä. Juoksijat starttaavat.

name: Finlandia Vitonen
description: Finlandia Vitonen is the shortest distance at the Finlandia Marathon and is open to everyone interested in physical activity. Participants can move at their own pace, whether it’s a fast sprint or a leisurely walk. The 5 km route follows Jyväskylä’s Rantaraitti, with the start at Lutakon aukio. The event also features fun, encouraging activities in the start and finish area and along the route.

images.alt_text: Finlandia Vitonen -juoksussa osallistujia. Hyvä kuvaus kilpailusta.

name: Vaasa Maraton
description: Vaasa Marathon will be held on September 6, 2025, at Kaarlen kenttä on Ruutikellarintie in Vaasa. The race start schedule is arranged for different groups, and participants must start their final lap by 3:00 p.m. at the latest. Participants can choose the marathon, half marathon, 10.5 km distance, or the Minimarathon, which is free for children.

name: Masters Athletics Marathon
description: Masters Marathon runners can once again compete with the world’s best runners in their own age groups. WMA is excited to announce that RunInBucharest has accepted the challenge of hosting the World Championships for Masters athletes in 2024. The 2024 World Masters Athletics Marathon Championship will be held on October 13 alongside the Bucharest Marathon, offering a wonderful opportunity to enjoy running in beautiful surroundings, with the course passing the city’s most important landmarks.

images.alt_text: Maratonjuoksijat lähtevät Bukarestin kilpailuun, jossa on tunnusomaista "START"-kyltti.
Bucharestin yö, suihkulähteitä ja valaistuja rakennuksia, jotka sopivat maratonin kontekstiin.

name: Nuuksio Classic Trail
description: Nuuksio Classic is one of Finland’s most iconic trail-running events, offering a unique running experience amid stunning scenery. The race takes place in Nuuksio National Park and attracts runners from Finland and around the world. Participants can choose from different distances, including 42 km and 70 km, and enjoy superb courses, wild forest, and excellent organization. Join us on September 5, 2026!

images.alt_text: Maastojuoksija Nuuksion poluilla järven äärellä, aurinkoisena päivänä.

name: Orimattilan Kymppi
description: The most significant village event to develop in Kuivanto is Kuivannon Kymppi. As a celebration of physical activity, it brings villagers together in late autumn to exercise and organize a sporting event. This outdoor and sporting event, initiated by local residents, was first held in 1981, when 24 participants completed the course. The event has grown into a significant international gathering, with more than 500 participants from countries including Russia, Estonia, Sweden, England and Kenya. Through cooperation between the City of Orimattila and local village associations, the event has been carried forward one year at a time.

name: Matin Muistokymppi
description: Matin Muistokymppi is a running event held on 5 September 2024 in Lieksa. The race gives participants the opportunity to run a 10-kilometer distance through beautiful scenery. The course is designed to be both challenging and enjoyable for runners of all levels. The event is aimed especially at fitness enthusiasts and running fans, and offers an excellent opportunity to enjoy the outdoors and good company. Participants can run or walk, and anyone who wants a time will be timed.

images.alt_text: Juoksijat lähtevät juoksukilpailuun, jossa on paljon osallistujia.
Juoksukilpailu käynnissä, kilpailijat juoksevat märällä asfaltilla.
Ryhmä ihmisiä kävelemässä tai juoksemassa ulkona.

name: Laajavuori Trail Run
description: Welcome to Laajavuori Trail Run, a trail running event in Laajavuori, Jyväskylä, on Saturday, 13 September 2025! This exhilarating event offers stunning routes in the heart of Central Finland’s natural landscape—hills, forests, roots, and breathtaking views. Whether you’re an experienced runner or just starting out on the trails, Laajavuori Trail Run is the perfect way to challenge yourself and enjoy nature while staying active.

images.alt_text: Suomen lippu ja kaunis luontomaisema metsässä ja järvellä.

name: Kaisaniemen Juoksu
description: Kaisaniemi Run will be held on Saturday, 13 September 2025, with 5 km and 21.1 km distances. Registration for the 2025 event is now open – sign up here! The start for both distances is a few minutes’ walk from Eläintarha Sports Field, on Hammarskjöldintie. The courses have been officially measured in accordance with WA standards.

images.alt_text: Nainen juoksee hämärän aikaan. Hyvä kuva juoksusta.

name: Bladhin Loppet
description: Bladhin Run is making a comeback, and we will hold the race on 13 September 2025. This historic running event winds through the beautiful wooden-house scenery of Kaskinen and offers participants an unforgettable experience. The race features several distances, including 5 km, 10 km, a half marathon, a children’s run (500 m), and a rollator run (150 m).

name: Kohnan Lenkki
description: Kohnan Lenkki 2023 will be held on September 16, 2023, and features several different categories for different age groups. The event includes running distances of varying lengths, such as 0.8 km for children and 9.8 km for adults. There are separate categories for girls, boys, women, and men, ensuring a suitable race for all participants. The event takes place in an area called Kohna in Panelia, Satakunta, through which the Eurajoki River flows.

images.alt_text: Kohnan Lenkki -juoksukilpailun logo, jossa on lintuja oranssilla taustalla.

name: Kaljamaili SM-kisa
description: Peräkylän Ponnistus is hosting the Finnish Beer Mile Championships on Friday, 26.08 at 18:00 at the main track of Pirkkola Sports Park. The rules are simple: run a mile, or just over four laps of the track, and drink one beer before the start of each lap. The fastest to the finish wins. There are two categories: Beer (Official) and Non-alcoholic beer, and both are unisex. The world record under international rules is 4:33.6.

images.alt_text: Kolme ihmistä yleisurheiluradalla, yksi heistä viittoo.

name: Lasse Virén Hölkkä
description: The international 53rd Lasse Virén Fun Run will take place in Myrskylä on Sunday, September 13, 2026, at 12:00. Several distances are available, including a 10.3 km road race, a 21.1 km half marathon, and a 6 km fitness event and hike/pole walk/jog. Welcome to Lasse’s Fun Run!

images.alt_text: Lasse Virén hölkkä -juoksijat maastossa. Kilpailun tunnelmaa.
Lasse Virén hölkkä -juoksija maastossa. Hyvälaatuisen kuvan.
Juoksija Lasse Virén hölkkä -kisassa.  Kaunis maalaismaisema.

name: Visahölkkä
description: Visahölkkä is a traditional running event held in the rural surroundings of Ojakkala on the first Sunday in October. The first Visahölkkä was held in autumn 2007, and participation has settled at between 30 and 50 runners. The event offers several different distances suitable for runners of all ages and abilities, and it is part of the Vihdin Hölkkäkunkkusarja series.

images.alt_text: Visahölkkä-juoksukilpailun kuva. Kaksi juoksijaa juoksee maastossa.

name: Forssan Puistojuoksu
description: Forssa Park Run is an event that has been held since 1985 and has brought runners together for 30 years. The monthly park run draws 100–200 runners of all ages, and its beautiful route winds through the scenery along the Loimijoki River. Runners can choose between a 5.8 km and an 11.2 km route, which passes through the park of the old cotton mill near Forssa city centre. The start and finish are on Keskuskatu, in front of the more than 100-year-old Elävien Kuvien cinema.

images.alt_text: Puistojuoksussa osallistujia nauttimassa liikunnasta kauniissa maisemassa.
Puistojuoksun kausikortti 2024. Juoksijoita ja kuukauden päivämäärät.

name: Tammimäki Juoksu
description: The Tammimäki Run will be held for the second time on Sunday, 8 September at 14:00 in Pappinen. The route is 10.7 km long and includes significant elevation changes. There are two categories (Men and Women), and the top three finishers in each category will receive cash prizes (€100, €60 and €40). The entry fee is €10, and registration takes place at the race centre, Vartiamäentie 15, Pappinen.

images.alt_text: Juoksukilpailu, jossa osallistujat juoksevat märällä asfaltilla.

name: Gennarbyviken Runt
description: Gennarbyviken Runt is a great gravel-road route that loops around Gennarbyviken. This year, a half marathon was held for the first time, and the Kero brothers ran the race at a fast pace. Jaakko Kero won in 1:13:42. There were 64 participants in total, fewer than the previous year. Gennarbyviken Runt has been a popular event for over 60 years.

images.alt_text: Juoksija Gennarbyviken Runt -kilpailussa juoksee soratiellä, numero 115.

name: NGS Unrestricted Duathlon
description: Unrestricted Duathlon is a new event in the NGS calendar, combining cross-country skiing and gravel riding. The event offers a great opportunity to explore the beautiful autumn scenery and forests. The event options are Half Marathon – 21 km (4 km cross-country skiing + 13 km gravel + 4 km cross-country skiing), Marathon – 42 km (6 km cross-country skiing + 30 km gravel + 6 km cross-country skiing), and Ultra – 84 km (12 km cross-country skiing + 60 km gravel + 12 km cross-country skiing). The event will be held in Pajulahti on September 20–21, 2025.

name: Velo Salo Backyard Ultra
description: The Velo Salo Backyard Ultra course is mostly forest road, but also includes a more challenging section of trail of about 250 metres and an easier gravel/asphalt section of about 400 metres. The course is run clockwise and is 6.7 km long, with each new lap starting on the hour. The race continues until only one runner remains, but unfortunately the organizers will have to end the race after 36 laps if no winner has emerged after just over 240 km of running.

images.alt_text: Kokoelma kuvia Velo Salo -juoksukilpailusta, juoksijoita ja tapahtuman nimi näkyvissä.
Pyöräilijöitä Velo Salo -tapahtumassa, jossa osallistujilla on kilpailun nimi paidassa.

name: Ruissalojuoksut
description: Experience beautiful nature and fresh autumn air at Ruissalo Runs on September 19. Ruissalo Runs is a popular running event held amid the beautiful scenery of Ruissalo Island. The event gives runners the opportunity to take part in races of various distances, including a half marathon and a 10-kilometer run. The route passes through scenic surroundings known for their diverse landscapes. The event attracts both recreational runners and competitive athletes, and is an excellent opportunity to enjoy running and nature.

images.alt_text: Ruissalojuoksujen kartta: lähtö, maali, pysäköinti ja muut tärkeät kohdat.

name: Aulanko Tower Trail
description: Aulanko Tower Trail is a trail running race in Häme’s breathtaking national landscape. Both routes are sure to challenge competitors: the longer distance has a total elevation gain of 550 m, while the shorter route climbs more than 350 meters. The 22 km and 13 km route options take runners through Aulanko’s beautiful national landscape, and as part of the Trail Tour Finland series, Aulanko Tower Trail offers a racing experience for every runner!

images.alt_text: Aulanko Tower Trailin lähtö. Juoksijat valmistautuvat kilpailuun.

Aulangon Tornin Polku -juoksun maaliintulo. Juoksija ylittää maaliviivan.

name: Pentin Hölkkä
description: Pentin Hölkkä is an outdoor event for the whole family, taking place on 28 September 2024 from 12:00 at the village association’s new outdoor lodge, at Sammallammintie 480. The event features a 5.2 km route on gravel roads, and registration opens at 12:00. The timed race starts together at 14:00, while participants can also take part at their own pace without being timed. The entry fee is €5, and a short children’s run will take place around the lodge.

name: Kansallinen Kymppi
description: Kansallinen Kymppi will be held at Lahti Stadium on Saturday, September 20, 2025. Come and run a track 10K or watch Finland’s top 10K runners compete up close. The event brings together recreational runners, juniors, and the national elite—an event for everyone who loves running, where you can challenge yourself in a 10,000-metre track race. Kansallinen Kymppi offers a unique opportunity to run an official 10,000-metre track race, and the evening culminates in a contest between the national elite.

name: Oulun Academy Run
description: The 57th Oulu Run and the 7th Academy Run will take place on Saturday, 16 September 2023, with the event centre located on Raatinsaari. The route passes through Pikisaari, Hietasaari, Toppilansaari, Möljä Bridge, Toppila Beach, Merijali Beach, Patosilta and Ainola Park, finishing at Raatin Stadium. The distance is officially measured at 10 km. In addition to refreshments, participants receive free admission to Raatin swimming pool after the event by showing their race number.

name: Espoo Rantamaraton
description: Welcome to run the Espoo Rantamaraton along beautiful routes on the coast of the city of Espoo. On Saturday, September 20, you can take part in the marathon (42.195 km), half marathon (21.1 km), 10K (10 km), 5K (5 km timed run), Aalto Walk (5 km untimed walk/run), or the children’s run (1K/600 m).

name: Kullervo Marathon
description: The Kullervo Marathon 2025 will take place in Joutseno on 21 September 2025. The event is known for its fast course, where several Finnish records, domestic season bests and personal records have been set. For example, last September Ole Halonen ran the men’s domestic season best in Joutseno, with a time of 2:24:26.

name: Bockabroloppet
description: IK Falken organizes BOCKABROLOPPET on Sunday, September 21, 2025, at 11:00. The start and finish are at the Pedersöre outdoor recreation center, Teerijärventie 110, 68840 Lappfors. The race has several categories: girls/boys under 12 years, 1.5 km; under 14 years, 2.5 km; and adult categories, 14 km and mountain bike, 28 km. Refreshments and facilities, including toilets, showers, and a sauna, are available at the race venue.

images.alt_text: Talvinen juoksukilpailu, jossa osallistujat juoksevat lumisella tiellä.
Bockabroloppet-juoksukilpailun logo, jossa juoksija ja silta.

name: Nuuksio Night Trail
description: Petzl Nuuksio Night Trail 2026 will take place on 25.9.2026! The event center is at Luukki Outdoor Lodge, Luukintie 33 (next to Luukki Manor). The route is approximately 13 kilometers long and runs alongside Nuuksio National Park. All runners must have a headlamp, as the event takes place in a dark forest. The organizer does not rent out headlamps during the event.

name: Punkaharjun Halkijuoksu
description: Pre-registration for the 2026 Punkaharju Cross-Country Run is now open! See more details and register to run here! Alisa Vainio set an impressive course record in the Punkaharju Cross-Country Run half marathon, which was held for the 49th time.

images.alt_text: Ilmakuva metsäisestä maisemasta järven rannalla, todennäköisesti juoksureitti.

name: Rantaraitin Juoksu
description: The Rantaraitti Run takes place on September 27, 2025, in Kokkola, offering runners a choice of 5 km or 10 km distances. The start is from a gravel field, heading onto the coastal route towards Tyysterniemi. The route follows the shoreline and is easy to run, consisting mostly of crushed stone. The courses are designed for runners of all levels, with the longer distances being more demanding.

images.alt_text: Kartta Kokkolan alueesta, mahdollisesti reitti tai tapahtuma-alue.

name: NAMI-matka
description: NAMI-matka is the Tampere region’s sweetest running event, offering a relaxed event in an encouraging atmosphere. The event is organized by NAMI ry and has been a celebration of enjoyable running since 2018. At NAMI-matka, runners can choose from several distances: 100 km, 50 km, a marathon, or nonstop. The course is accurately measured at 2 km, and aid stations are always close by, serving treats at every station and soup, coffee, and accompaniments at the finish.

name: Radioaseman Ultra
description: The Radioaseman Ultra Marathon (100 km) was held in Pori on September 23, 2023, on the Itä-Pori fitness trail at Radioasemantie 1, 28330 Pori. The route was 2 km long and ran around Pori’s former shortwave radio station. This unique ultramarathon gives runners the opportunity to test their fitness on varied terrain, where tall trees provide shelter from the wind. The race attracts runners from across the country and offers shower facilities and aid stations after the finish.

images.alt_text: Juoksijat Radioaseman Ultra Maratonissa, mukana miekka ja viitta.

name: Säkylänharju Trail Run
description: The Säkylänharju trail run at Huovinrinne takes place on Saturday, 27 September 2025. This year, the event was blessed with beautiful sunny autumn weather, and there were 126 participants in total. A total of 42 runners completed the longest, 24 km route, while 48 ran the 16 km route. The routes pass through the stunning landscapes of Säkylänharju, across pine heaths and the ridge’s impressive kettle holes.

images.alt_text: Säkylänharjun polkujuoksun palkintojenjako, kolme parasta juoksijaa podiumilla.

description: The Ketunlenkki Trail in Repovesi National Park offers varied and beautiful forest and lake scenery. The route is rewarding for day hikes and includes the Lapinsalmi suspension bridge and the Ketunlossi ferry. Repovesi is a wonderful place to hike and enjoy the outdoors, offering unforgettable nature with ponds, streams, and lakes.

name: Windal Half Marathon
description: Windal Half Marathon takes place in Vimpeli at Saarikenttä, where the race center is open from 8:30 a.m. to 2:00 p.m. The race route is relatively flat, paved with asphalt, and officially measured. The route is not closed to other traffic, so competitors should remain alert. Signs, a lead vehicle, and a first-response vehicle alert other traffic to the runners.

name: Voimaa Metsästä
description: The distances at the Voimaa Metsästä event range from 6 to 21 kilometres, with a separate 2 km distance for children. Each distance follows its own marked, continuous trail route, and no part of the route is run more than once. The 2024 routes have undergone a thorough update, and the new event centre is located in the former premises of the UKK Institute. All routes are mostly off-road trails, with short sections on gravel roads.

name: Koirakiven Kierros 51:s
description: The 51st Koirakiven Kierros will be held in Mäntyharju on 27 September 2015. This running event offers participants a 6.1 km course where competitors can test their skill and speed. Several fast runners took part in the event, with Antti Parjanne winning in 19:25.

images.alt_text: Nainen ja koira juoksevat yhdessä hiekkatiellä.

name: Pääkaupunkijuoksu
description: The legendary Pääkaupunkijuoksu will be held in Helsinki’s Central Park on Sunday, 27 September 2026, for the 51st time. The event hub is at the beautifully renovated Pirkkola Sports Park, promising an even more functional and lively event area! The race distances are the half marathon, 10 km and 5 km, and walkers can take part in the 7 km Kunnon Kävely, with no timing. The event offers participants unique experiences in pristine Finnish nature in the beautiful Central Park.

images.alt_text: Juoksijat Pääkaupunkijuoksussa, jossa näkyy kilpailun nimi ja päivämäärä.

description: The Vantaa Endurance Series gives participants the opportunity to challenge themselves in five different events. With a single registration for the 2023 Vantaa Endurance Series, you can take part in five endurance events in Vantaa, covering skiing, running, cycling, swimming and orienteering.

On-site late registration closes at 17:15 at the latest. All categories start at 18:00. Categories: Women/Men 10 km and 5 km; children of all ages 2 km without timing. The top three will receive prizes.

images.alt_text: Polkujuoksija metsässä, juoksee sauvojen kanssa, numero rinnassa.

name: Vaarojen Ultramaraton
description: Vaarojen Ultramarathon offers magnificent trail running routes in Koli National Park. The event takes place on October 3–4, 2025, and includes several different distances, the longest of which is 130 km. The race attracts runners of all levels and offers beautiful scenery and challenges.

images.alt_text: Vaarojen Ultramaraton -juoksija haastavalla reitillä. Upeat maisemat!

description: Fiskars Marathon Raasepori offers beautiful gravel roads in the Uusimaa archipelago, west of Helsinki. The race starts at 10:00, and the race office opens at 8:30. Distances and categories include 15 km, 7 km, 2 km and 0.6 km routes, suitable for different age groups and ability levels. The peaceful gravel roads wind through picturesque scenery, with plenty of stopping places along the coast.

The event hub is moving from Tuomikylä School to Seinäjoki, at Kyrkösjärvi Beach and the Luontokeskus Käpälikkö facilities, which also brings changes to the distances. The main event is KOMIA Ilkan Polku 39 km. Also on offer are KOMIA Ilkan Relay, with 4 legs of about 10 km each, and KOMIA Pikku Ilkka 20 km. New this year are KOMIA Sprintti Ilkka 10 km and the shorter KOMIA Mini Ilkka, about 2 km, offering even better opportunities to enjoy the nearby trails around Kyrkösjärvi.

The route runs through the city centre and alongside Tampere’s waterways, including the shores of Lake Pyhäjärvi amid the arboretum scenery. The start and finish area is at Tampere Stadium, which is easily accessible. The Tampere Juoksee event is organised by Tampereen Pyrintö ry, bringing together young athletes and experienced runners.

description: The third race in the Winter Series takes place on Saturday, December 13, 2025, at 11:00 on the Koskenkylä course. The Winter Series starts again, with the first race held on Saturday, October 4. The event gives participants the opportunity to run officially measured distances.

description: Whether you're an experienced competitive runner or simply love running, Tampere Juoksee is for you. Join us for a 5K, 10K or half marathon and enjoy the joy of exercise in the heart of Tampere. Tampere Juoksee returns on Saturday, 3 October 2026, and registration is already open!

images.alt_text: Juoksijat Tampere Juoksee -kilpailussa. Matkat 5 km, 10 km ja puolimaraton.

name: Itämeri Maraton
description: The Baltic Sea Marathon will be run and walked on Saturday, 3 October 2026, in the city of Hanko. Distance options are the marathon, half marathon and quarter marathon (10.5 km). The official time limit is six (6) hours for the full marathon and 5.5 hours for the half marathon and quarter marathon. Finishes after these limits will be considered disqualified. The course is officially measured, and the start and finish area are at Keskuskoulu, Halmstadinkatu 2.

name: Keurusselän Syyslenkki
description: Keurusselkä Autumn Run is a running event held at Hotel Keurusselkä in Mänttä, Finland. The event takes place on Saturday, October 4, 2025, at 11:00 EEST.

name: Vantaan Maraton
description: The Vantaa Marathon is one of Finland’s largest and fastest marathons. Join us to challenge your personal records or simply for the joy of running! The Vantaa Marathon takes place on Saturday, October 3, 2026, with Tikkurila Sports Park serving as the event hub.

name: Pirkan Hölkkä ja Kieppi
description: Pirkan Hölkkä will be run for the 54th time on Sunday, October 6, 2024. The first 3 km are on streets, followed by 3 km on a gravel track in a recreation area, as far as Leppäjärventie. The route includes varied forest trails, gravel roads and forest roads, and is marked with blue marker tape, directional arrows and kilometer signs. There are six aid stations along the route, and the organizers have aimed to include as many forest trails as possible.

images.alt_text: Pirkan Hölkkä -juoksukilpailun logo, jossa lukee "Pirkan Hölkkä" ja "Syksyisen luonnon syliin".

name: 55. Pirkan Hölkkä 5.10.2025
description:
A jewel of the running season, the icing on the cake: this long-distance running event, held mainly on trails, takes place every year on the first Sunday in October.

The 33-kilometre route from Valkeakoski to Tampere runs along a varied mix of fitness trails, forest roads and trails. Around five kilometres of the route are on asphalt. In addition to the running categories, you can take part in a walking category, which is not timed. The event is organised jointly by Tampereen Taivaltajat ry and Valkeakosken Retkeilijät ry.

Pirkan Hölkkä dates back to 1970. The route has largely remained as it is today. In recent years, the average number of participants has been around 1,000–1,500.
additional:
You can choose from the age categories Women’s Open, N40, N50, Men’s Open, M40, M50 and M60. The start is at the Sahara sports field in Valkeakoski (Tallikatu 11), where the starting gun will sound at 9:30 on Sunday morning. Late registration at the start is available from 8:00 to 9:00.

The event uses gun time, measured from the starting gun until you cross the finish line. At the start, you can choose a position near the start line according to your target time.

The first 3 km of the race are on streets. For the next 3 km, the route follows the fitness trail in the recreational area as far as Leppäjärventie. After that, the route to Rutajärvi (11 km from the start) consists of varied forest trails and a short section of gravel road. The 3.5 km stretch between Rutajärvi and Vähä-Kausjärvi is on forest roads. Of the 5 km between Vähä-Kausjärvi and Taivalpirtti, the first part is on forest roads, followed by forest trails; after crossing Savontie, the route returns to gravel roads.
From Taivalpirtti onward, the route alternates between gravel roads and forest trails until it reaches the recreational trail around Suolijärvi. The final 3 km follow a gravel-surfaced recreational trail between Hervanta and Koivistonkylä. This section still has a few climbs that will test Finnish grit.

The Pirkan Hölkkä route is marked with blue flagging tape, directional arrows and kilometre signs. The organisers have aimed to include as many forest trails as possible. There are six refreshment stations along the route.

The finish is in Nirva, Tampere, in the grounds of Tampere Adult Education Centre (Kurssikeskuksenkatu 11). Paid bus transport to the start is available from the finish area and Tampere city centre, both in the morning before the start and in the afternoon after you finish. You can include transport and the soup lunch sold at the finish area in your entry fee by selecting these add-ons in our online store.

images.alt_text: Juoksijat venyttelemässä ennen 55. Pirkan Hölkkää, lokakuussa 2025.
Kaksi miestä, joilla on Pirkan Hölkkä -lippikset.

name: Pirkan Kieppi 5.10.2025
description:
The jewel of the running season and the icing on the cake, Pirkan Hölkkä is a long-distance running event held mostly on trails. It takes place every year on the first Sunday in October. Together with TU38, we are organizing the much-requested shorter distance, the 14 km Pirkan Kieppi.

Pirkan Kieppi starts at the Pirkan Hölkkä finish area, in the courtyard of TAKK’s Nirva campus, at 11:30. On-site late registration is open from 10:00 to 11:00.
additional:
The route continues via Lahdesjärvi to Vuores, where it winds through the beautiful scenery of this neighbourhood. It then joins the traditional Pirkan Hölkkä route at the Vormisto aid station, from where runners continue to the finish together with the full-distance participants.

Pirkan Kieppi has two open categories, women (N) and men (M). Timing is based on gun time, from the starting gun to crossing the finish line. At the start, you can choose a spot near the start line according to your target time.

images.alt_text: Pirkan Kierros logo, sisältää juoksun ja muita urheilulajeja.

name: Paraisten lenkki
description: The Parainen Run will be held for the 50th time this year. Anyone can take part, whether they run to win or for exercise. The event offers everyone the chance to enjoy running, whatever their level.

name: Ilmaristen Ympärijuoksu
description: Ilmaristen Ympärijuoksu is a running event held in the Ilmaristen Metsäpirtti area. Several different distances are offered, including a 10 km competitive race for men and women and a 5 km recreational run. The event offers a 10-kilometre distance for different age groups and attracts runners from across Finland. It is known for its good organisation and high standard of competition.

images.alt_text: Ilmaristen Ympärijuoksu ilmoitus: juoksutapahtuma, tiedot, reitit
Ilmaristen Ympärijuoksu mainos, jossa juoksijoita ja tietoa kilpailusta.

name: Lokakuun Kymppi
description: Lokakuun Kymppi is a traditional running event held in Tolkkinen amid beautiful autumn scenery. This year, a large field took part: a total of 223 recreational runners and 60 competitors completed the officially measured course. Eero Saleva won the men’s race, while Sara Kuivisto was the fastest in the women’s race. The route is mainly on asphalt and offers stunning scenery and an encouraging atmosphere.
