description: Östgötatidningen Mjölby Stadslopp is a family-friendly fun run starting and finishing in Stadsparken in Mjölby. The main race is six kilometers through the city, there is also KyrkRundan of about three kilometers and a free children's race. The event features music and activities along the course and is a local community celebration encouraging walking, jogging, and running. Welcome to a day of movement, socializing, and joy on Saturday, May 9, 2026.
course_highlights: Six kilometers with start and finish in Stadsparken in Mjölby
Approximately half of the course runs close to Svartån
99 percent asphalt; some challenging uphill sections and the last kilometer through Mjölby center towards Gästisparken
additional: Race bibs are collected at Intersport on Friday, May 8 from 12:00 to 18:00 (discount coupon 25% upon pickup). Uncollected race bibs are handed out in Stadsparken no later than one hour before the start. The top flap on the bib is the chip - without it, no time will be registered. Late registration is open from April 30 to May 7 via the website and can also be done at the bib distribution on May 8 or in Stadsparken on May 9 (only Swish). Warm-up is provided by Fitness4You; the event offers refreshments from ICA Supermarket Mjölby and water/sports drinks from Finspångs Brunnsborrning. The number of participants has been high previously, with 1074 runners reported; registration for 2026 opens and results and record descriptions will be published by organizing media.

name: Strandmilen
description: Strandmilen is a local running event in Hultsfred that takes place along Lake Hulingen on a nice, flat course. There is a 10 km course and two children's distances, and the organizers welcome both club and recreational runners. Children can also register for the longer course if they wish. For more information, the organizer refers to the race information sheet on the race website.
course_highlights: Flat course along Lake Hulingen
10 km for adults and two different children's races
Friendly family-oriented race environment at Herrstorpet
additional: The children's races start at 10:00 AM and the 10 km race starts at 11:00 AM. You do not need to belong to a club to participate. The organizer refers to a race information sheet for more details. The children's race starts at 10:00 AM according to the schedule; Strandmilen is part of Herrstorpet's new building day with dressage cycling, guided tours, and concerts in the morning.

name: Åstöloppet Trail
description: Åstöloppet Trail is a welcoming trail run through Åstön Nature Reserve, scheduled for May 9, 2026. The event offers four distances (1 km, 4 km, 8 km, and 14 km) and features a mix of wide forest trails, technical sections, and unpaved terrain. Start and finish are at Skeppshamn, promising a scenic finish by the sea, suitable for both beginners and experienced trail runners. The organizer is Tynderö IK, and the race director can be reached via the provided contact address.
course_highlights: Four distances: 1 km, 4 km, 8 km, and 14 km
Mix of wide forest trails, technical sections, and unpaved terrain
Start and finish at Skeppshamn with coastal views in Åstöns Nature Reserve
additional: Date: May 9, 2026. Distances: 1 km, 4 km, 8 km, 14 km. Start and finish at Skeppshamn in Åstöns Nature Reserve. Race director Linus can be reached via race.tyndero@gmail.com. The event premiered in 2025, and results from 2025 are published on the website. The distances for Åstöloppet Trail are 1 km, 4 km, 8 km, and 14 km. The terrain consists of wide forest trails, technical sections, and unpaved terrain along Åstöns Nature Reserve. Registration is done via the link on the organizer's page.

name: Kolmårdstrailen
location: Kolmården, Norrköping Municipality, Östergötland County, Sweden
distance_verbose: Halvmarathon, 10 km, 10 km, 7.5 km, 5 km, 5 km

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.price: 21 km 400 kr; 11 km 300 kr; 6 km 200 kr; Ungdom 50 kr; Kidz 50 kr
tiers.description: Till och med 3 Maj: 21 km 400 kr, 11 km 300 kr, 6 km 200 kr, Ungdom 50 kr, Kidz 50 kr.

late_fee.price: 21 km 500 kr; 11 km 400 kr; 6 km 300 kr; Ungdom 50 kr; Kidz 50 kr

description: The Kolmårdstrail is a hilly and experience-focused trail run in the scenic Kolmården with technical trails, rocky outcrops, and many elevation meters. You can choose between courses of approximately 21 km, 11 km, and 6 km (as well as a children’s course of 500 m). The course is described as challenging but close to nature - passing through Rödgölens Nature Reserve and offering fine views from Kolmården’s highest point. The organizer emphasizes the experience and provides services such as a water station and the option to download GPX data for your watch.
course_highlights: Hilly, technical trail terrain with many elevation meters and rocky outcrops
Passes Rödgölens Nature Reserve and Ågelsjön; Kolmården’s highest point (171 m above sea level) with a view
Small trails and single tracks, wooden bridge over marsh areas, rope in the “koklämman”, and a final tough/partially unpaved kilometer
additional: Regular registration until May 3; late registration online until May 6 and thereafter on site (race day) from 09:00 to 11:00, payment in cash or via Swish. GPX data for the courses can be downloaded. Water stations are available after approximately 7.5 km at the Scout Cabin. A children’s run of about 500 m is available for children up to 10 years old. For the Kolmården Night Trail: bring a headlamp, the course is marked with reflectors, no shower facilities, and chanterelle soup is served at the finish. The organizer offers cancellation and accident insurance as an optional add-on. Kolmården races in the series include Kolmården Vertical (5 km, 300 meters of elevation), Swimrun Kolmården, Kolmården Night Trail (9 km), and Luciatåget (7.5 km). Results are available online, and several distances are emphasized during the event.

name: Östhammars Stadslopp
description: Stadsloppet 2026 is organized by Östhammars Friidrott and will take place on Saturday, May 9, 2026, starting at Frösåkersvallen in Östhammar. The event is presented on the club's competition page and is aimed at local runners and participants in the nearby area. When registering, necessary contact information is collected for race administration and result publication, and images from the event may be used in the club's channels.
course_highlights: Start at Frösåkersvallen in Östhammar
additional: The club informs that contact details provided during registration are used for race contact and that name, age, and results may be stored for result lists and race statistics. Images from the event may be used on the club's website, Facebook, and Instagram; participants can contact the club to request removal. Club membership for 2026 is managed via Svenska Lag. The website contains start lists, registration, and results for Stadsloppet 2025.

name: SHE Silverlöpet
organizer: Sala-Heby Energi AB (i samarbete med IFK Sala)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Anmälningsavgift fram tom den 1/5: 2 km 40:- för barn

description: SHE Silverlöpet is a restart of the classic Silverlöpet, organized in collaboration with SHE. The race runs through Sala city center and in beautiful surroundings with start and finish in Stadsparken. You can choose 10 km (officially measured), 5 km, or a children's race of 2 km - the race is open to everyone and presented as a community festival with medals for all participants.
course_highlights: Through Sala city center and around Sala's beautiful environment
Start and finish in Stadsparken, Sala
The 10 km course is officially measured
additional: Registration is done via Mitt Lopp (opens 2026-03-01). Online registration is valid until early May; late registration takes place on site on 9/5 (5 - 10 km: 08:00 - 09:00, children's 2 km: 08:00 - 09:15). Prices and awards: medals for all participants; prizes for 1st-3rd place in women and men in the 10 km; raffles for the 5 km. Restart of Silverlöpet in Sala; the last race was held in 1999; distances are 5 km and 10 km. The event is announced by Sala-Heby Energi AB in collaboration with IFK Sala.

name: Spångaloppet
location: Spånga IP, Spånga, Stockholm Municipality, Stockholm County, Sweden
description: Spångaloppet is a local running race organized by Spånga/Bromstens Bandy Club, scheduled for May 9, 2026. The race offers courses for different ages and levels, including 10 km and 5 km through beautiful natural areas and past Spånga center, as well as a 2 km course for younger runners and a 400 m kids' race. The start and finish for all races are at Spånga IP. Everyone is welcome to participate, and registration is done via RaceID under Spångaloppet 2026.
course_highlights: 10 km and 5 km through beautiful natural areas and Spånga center
2 km course for younger runners and a 400 m kids' race
Start and finish at Spånga IP for all races
additional: Registration is via RaceID under "Spångaloppet 2026". Contact for questions: spangaloppet@sbbk.nu. All races start and finish near Spånga IP. Registration via RaceID; questions to spangaloppet@sbbk.nu.

name: Sommarro Snabbare

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 1 maj - 9 maj 595 SEK Begränsat antal platser.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 1 maj - 9 maj 130 SEK. Efteranmälan. Begränsat antal platser.

description: Sommarro Snabbare is a unique and fast-paced running race in the cultural reserve Sommarro in Örebro. The race takes place on a 2.6 km loop in a forest park environment where each lap must be completed in progressively shorter times (first lap 25 minutes, next 24 minutes, third 23 minutes, etc.), making the competition faster with each round. Everyone starts under the same conditions, and the winner is the one who lasts the longest – suitable for both fast runners and those who want to challenge their endurance. There is also a Little Sommarro Snabbare for children born in 2013 or later (one lap, no timing).
course_highlights: 2.6 km loop in a beautiful forest park environment (Sommarro cultural reserve)
Hilly course, mostly gravel and jogging trails with some terrain sections
Start/finish on the lawn; race run with progressively faster lap times
additional: Mandatory race briefing at 10:45; warm-up with Nordic Wellness before the start. Timing is done with a transponder around the ankle (number of laps mainly determines placement; in case of equal laps, the time on the last lap decides). Lost transponder incurs an 800 SEK fee. Water/energy drinks (Umara) and energy bars are available, as well as light refreshments. No changing rooms/showers; two public toilets nearby. Parking at Sommarro Värdshus and Lugnets IP; city bus 7 stops at Halltorpsvägen.

name: Ölands Kyrkstafett
description: Öland's Parish Relay is a classic long-distance relay race held for the 47th time, offering a fantastic running experience on a spring-blooming Öland. The start and finish are in Färjestaden, and the race is available in two variants: a longer course with eleven legs totaling 67.5 km and a shorter course with six legs totaling 23.5 km. The race welcomes both dedicated runners and beginners, with legs suitable for all levels. Officials and a announcer follow the race to provide the best possible service and atmosphere throughout the event.
course_highlights: Long course: 11 legs, 2.7 km to 8.5 km, total 67.5 km
Short course: 6 legs, 2.7 km to 5.4 km, total 23.5 km
Start and finish at Hamnplanen in Färjestaden
additional: Number bib collection takes place on May 8th from 15:00 to 17:00 and on race day May 9th from 08:00 to 09:30 at Hamngrillen in Färjestaden. Changing rooms and showers are available at the sports hall 200 meters north of Ölands Köpstad. Wellness Studio hosts a group warm-up before the start. Individual split times, intermediate times, and team finish times are provided. The announcer follows the lead pack from start to finish. The race offers accommodation and food options at Ekerum Resort and Best Western Plus Kalmarsund Hotel. Registration is open until April 30, 2026, with late registration until May 6. Participants can expect a well-organized event with officials, a group warm-up, and awards for the best teams.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://olandrunning.se/lopp/olands-kyrkstafett/): 2026-05-09 — "Tid & datum 09 maj 2026 kl. 10:00" (was estimated 2026-05-09)

name: Hoby Backyard Ultra 12H
description: First edition of Hoby backyard ultra 12h! The course is 6706 meters with approximately 50% trail/gravel road and 50% asphalt. 57 meters of elevation gain per lap.
additional: Start takes place in Ekebacken in Bräkne-Hoby

name: Vårruset (Växjö)
description: Vårruset Växjö is the Växjö edition of Sweden's largest women's running tour, which in 2026 will visit 19 cities. In Växjö, the distances offered are 2.5 km or 5 km with start and finish at Strandbjörket around Växjösjön. The race can be registered as an individual or as a team, and a medal, a finish bag, and Vårruset music quiz with prizes are included, while timing can be opted out of. Age recommendations apply, and digital registration is used; as an extra feature, free HPV vaccination for women born 1994 - 1999 is available on site during Vårruset according to Region Kronoberg.
course_highlights: 2.5 km or 5 km around Växjösjön with start and finish at Strandbjörket
Team and individual registration with picnic after the finish for teams
Medal, finish bag, and Vårruset music quiz with prizes (timing can be opted out)
additional: Team-based picnic after the finish; digital registration; part of the national Vårruset tour 2026 (19 cities). Distance options: 2.5 km or 5 km (measured 5 km). Start and finish at Strandbjörket; team registrations (5 people) are offered a picnic after the finish. Registration can be done digitally until race day, no later than 1 hour before the first start; timing can be opted out of during registration.

name: Bankvarvet
price_range: 125 kr/vuxen, barn och ungdom upp till 16 år deltar gratis
description: Bankvarvet is a recreational race in Kisa scheduled for May 7, 2026. The race emphasizes the joy of moving rather than the best time or fastest lap, welcoming participants of all ages and levels. Throughout the day, entertainment, activities, and food experiences are offered, making it a festival for the whole family and friends. Bankvarvet encourages community and setting personal goals, whether walking, jogging, or running.
course_highlights: The race takes place in Kullaparken in Kisa
Focus on joy of movement and personal goal setting
Family-friendly with entertainment and activities
additional: The event runs from 16:00 to 20:00 with over 2000 participants. There are elements of entertainment, activities, and food experiences. Participants are encouraged to register together with friends or family for a more enjoyable experience. Ultramarathon runner Frida Södermark shares training tips for the race via Sparbanken's social media. The race starts at 18:30 in Kullaparken, Kisa; activities for the whole family; opportunity for companies to participate; entertainment and food during the day.

name: Skärholmsloppet
description: Skärholmsloppet is a family-friendly fitness event in Skärholmen, taking place for the fourteenth time in 2026 on Saturday, May 16. The event offers a timed 5 km race for participants aged 13 and older, a Fun Run of 1.6 km for all ages, as well as Little and Mini races for children. Registration is free through the #RUN4ZERO initiative, and all finishers receive a specially designed medal. The Löparakademin, a non-profit organization working with youth activities, is the organizer.
course_highlights: 5 km timed race, start and finish at Puckelbollplan
DJs and music stations along the course creating a suburban festival atmosphere
Children's courses: Lilla Skärholmsloppet approx. 1.6 km and Mini approx. 500 m
additional: Registration on the website closes Thursday, May 14 at 5 PM, but late registration is possible at the bib distribution on Friday, May 15, and on race day, May 16, subject to availability. A bib is required for all participants and will be distributed well in advance of the race. All finishers receive a medal; Lilla participants are also offered fruit and drinks at the finish line. The start/finish is at Puckelbollplan, and the Little/Mini races have separate start times and divided start fields by age group. The race takes place in Skärholmen, Stockholm, and participation is free via RUN4ZERO with medals for all finishers.

name: Kilsbergen Ut & Tillbaka
course_highlights: Three out-and-back routes from Ånnaboda (choose between 10 km, 26 km, or 54 km)
Hilly trail running in forests and mountains with technical sections and nice trails
The Bergslagsleden includes a turnaround at the viewpoint Rusakulan; all start at the same place creating a social atmosphere
additional: Maximum 70 participants. Bibs are collected at the race center from 08:00. The fee is paid via Swish to 123 118 33 18 - specify your name as a message. All equipment and energy needed on the course must be carried by the runner; no support along the course, only at the race center. Energy station at the race center with water, Umara sports drink, bananas, candy, etc.; own drop bag can be placed there. After finishing, participants are offered simple hot food (vegetarian option). Toilets are available in the area; changing and showers at SM-stugan (lower parking). Recommended parking at the lower parking lot. Three out-and-back routes (10/26/54 km) from Ånnaboda; maximum 70 participants; last registration May 15; start at 09:00 on May 16, 2026; energy station, drop bag, and meal after finish.

name: Vistakulle Backyard
distance_verbose: 50 miles, Marathon, 6.7 km, 3.5 km, Backyard Ultra
description: Vistakulle Backyard is a running event in the Vistakulle area near Gränna, organized by Rudu Friskvård in collaboration with Bauer Activities. The race is aimed at those who are a bit adventurous and interested in training, emphasizing the natural experience as much as performance. The event will take place on May 16, 2026, and offers a memorable course in natural, hilly terrain.
course_highlights: Hilly trails and inclines in a natural environment
Varying surfaces: trails, gravel roads, and asphalt
Beautiful views of Lake Vättern and surrounding forests
additional: Now organized by Rudu Friskvård. Event hours are scheduled from 07:00 to 19:00 on May 16, 2026. Bauer Activities emphasizes that their races are suitable for both beginners and experienced participants, and that the areas (Eastern Vättern slopes) are a UNESCO-designated biosphere with a strong natural profile. Part of the Gränna StadsTrail program. Registration/contact: info@baueractivities.se.

name: Kajenloppet
organizer: Nacka Hockey och Kajen i Nacka strand
description: Kajenloppet is a running festival in Nacka Strand on May 17, 2026, offering 10 km, 6 km, and two children's races (1200 m and 400 m). The course follows a beautiful loop along the water, passing historic sites and offering views of Stockholm's inlet. The start and finish are located at Kajen in Nacka Strand, and the day is combined with a family festival with activities, music, and entertainment. The race promotes local pride and is suitable for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Beautiful loop along the water
Passes historic sites with views of Stockholm's inlet
Start and finish at Kajen in Nacka Strand; family festival with activities and music
additional: Distances: 10 km, 6 km, and children's races 1200 m and 400 m. Date and location: May 17, 2026, Kajen in Nacka Strand. Start and finish at the same place at Kajen. The day includes a family festival with activities, music, and entertainment. Part of the registration fee goes to Min Stora Dag.

name: Vårruset Stockholm
description: Vår Ruset Stockholm is part of Sweden's largest fitness tour for women and is held on Tuesday, May 19, 2026, in Northern Djurgården. The race offers selectable distances of 2.5 km or a certified 5 km course and is suitable for both recreational runners and experienced athletes. The event has a warm, community-oriented character with the opportunity to register teams and end the evening with a picnic after the finish line. Registration is done digitally and the same price applies whether you choose timing or not.
course_highlights: The race takes place in Northern Djurgården
The 5 km course is certified
Nearest metro station: Universitetet
additional: A medal, finish bag, Vårruset music quiz with prizes, bib number, and (for those who choose it) official timing are included; timing can be opted out of so results are not published. Team registration (5 persons) includes a picnic after the finish; all team members can run different distances. Recommended ages: 5 km from 13 years (11 years with adult supervision), 2.5 km from 11 years (7 years with adult supervision). Registration is binding and the registration fee is non-refundable upon cancellation. There is also a digital race for participants who cannot attend physically (with medal mailed after the tour). Bib numbers are sent by post to the address provided in the registration before a specified date; any surplus proceeds go 100% back to sports.

name: Sandbäckens Norrköpingsstafetten
description: Sandbäckens Norrköpingsstafetten takes place on Wednesday, May 20, 2026, in Folkparken in Norrköping. Four people form a team and take turns walking, jogging, or running a lively 4 km stretch each. There are categories with and without timing, and the race is marketed as an accessible and festive relay race for recreational runners and teams. Thanks to HSB, children and youth participate completely free of charge, and there is special information for schools.
course_highlights: Four legs of 4 km each (4x4 km total)
Start, exchange, and finish in beautiful Folkparken
Suitable for walking, jogging, or running; categories with and without timing
additional: Children and youth participate free of charge thanks to HSB; schools are encouraged to register (contact for schools: mikael.grip@lopparrangoren.se). The organizer offers the possibility to rent tents and event decorations via Rent a Tent (booking deadline for guaranteed access: May 5, contact norrkoping@rentatent.se). Start, exchange, and finish are gathered in the park, creating a good atmosphere for spectators and events. The team consists of four participants; a picnic bag from ICA Kvantum Mirum Galleria and a medal after finishing are mentioned in the event communication. Over 700 participants and about 180 teams participated in previous years; youth and students participate free of charge thanks to sponsorships from HSB and Fiskeby. More information and registration are available at norrkopingsstafetten.se. ICA Kvantum Mirum offers a picnic for all participants; various sponsors provide tents or gathering spots.

name: Vårruset (Falun)
description: Spring Ruset is Sweden's largest fitness tour for women - a joyful and accessible spring evening where participants can run, jog, or walk 2.5 or 5 km. The event takes place as a tour in 19 cities from May 4 to June 4, 2026, and Falun is one of the locations. All participants receive, among other things, a medal and a bib, and team registrations (five people) are rewarded with a picnic after crossing the finish line. The race has been organized since 1989 and is aimed at recreational runners of various ages according to recommendations for each distance.
course_highlights: Two distances: 2.5 km and 5 km
The 5 km course is measured in all locations
Teams of five people receive a picnic after finishing
additional: What is included with individual registration: medal, finish bag, timing (if chosen), and bib. For team registration, a picnic after finishing, medal, finish bag, timing (if chosen), and bib are included; a team consists of five people, and a picnic voucher is issued only when the entire team (5 paying members) is registered. There is also a digital option (Vårruset Digital) where you can run between May 4 and June 4 and have a medal sent home; digital registrations cannot be combined with physical participation in the tour. Payment is accepted via Swish and Klarna; wellness portals Epassi, Benefits, and Benifex are supported. The guide on how to register and information on how to add team members can be found in the FAQ and the registration guide on the website. Free training sessions before Vårruset are offered by Falu IK Friidrott in collaboration with Vårruset and Intersport; two training sessions are scheduled before the race.

name: Blodomloppet (Karlskrona)
price_range: Individuell: 300-350 kr; Lag (5 personer): 1500-1750 kr; Lilla Blodomloppet: 100 kr; blodgivar-rabatt 40 kr per person
description: Welcome to the Blood Race in Karlskrona on May 20, 2026 - a recreational race that highlights the vital importance of blood donation. You can walk, jog, or run 5 km or 10 km, participate in the Little Blood Race (800 m), or walk 5 km. The courses are measured by an official from the Swedish Athletics Federation, and the walking paths have their own route so participants can finish with a picnic together. The race is organized by KA 2 IF and offers both individual and team registrations, as well as discounts for blood donors and ICA members.
course_highlights: Four courses: running 5 km, running 10 km, children's race 800 m, and walking 5 km
Walkers have their own route so they can be released first and picnic together with others
The courses are measured by an official from the Swedish Athletics Federation and meet competition standards
additional: Organizer: KA 2 IF (contact for Blood Race: karlskrona@blodomloppet.se, tel 0793-299924). A team can consist of a maximum of 5 participants, and team members can participate in different distances. For larger registrations, an Excel template is available in the registration system for import, as well as an option for a customer page for companies/organizations for centralized administration and discount codes. Blood donors and ICA members receive a 40 SEK discount per person. A picnic after the race is part of the event. Courses: 5 km, 10 km, 800 m, and walking 5 km; Excel template for larger groups; start times and warm-up will be communicated later via the information channel.

name: Västerviksfemman 2026
description: Västerviksfemman is an evening race of 5 km starting and finishing in Stadsparken in central Västervik. The race is run on a 2.5 km loop that is completed twice and offers a pleasant setting and good atmosphere along the course. You can participate individually or register a team (at least five people) where the five fastest results are combined. Welcome to the running festival in Stadsparken on Wednesday, May 20, 2026, at 19:00.
course_highlights: 2.5 km loop run twice with halfway turnaround
Start and finish in Stadsparken; course runs through central Västervik
Course layout may be adjusted due to construction work on Storgatan
additional: Number bib distribution takes place well before the start and bibs must be collected before 17:30 on race day. Collection: Monday, May 18 - Intersport 11-14; Tuesday, May 19 - Intersport 11-14; Wednesday, May 20 - at the stage in Stadsparken from 12:00. Registration is via RaceID (link provided on the event page). Team competition: at least 5 people per team; the team result is the compilation of the 5 fastest participants; if more than 9 participants are from the same unit, multiple teams can be registered. 5 km course; start and finish in Stadsparken; bibs can be collected before 17:30 on race day or according to schedule; start at 19:00; VO-Joggen times included in the program; team discount 20% with code LAG20.

name: Vårruset (Västerås)
description: Vår Ruset in Västerås is part of Sweden's largest fitness tour for women and will take place on Thursday, May 21, 2026, starting at 7:00 PM at Lögastrand. The race offers distances of 2.5 km and 5 km (the 5 km is measured) and is suitable for both experienced runners and those who want to jog or walk. Everyone who registers individually will receive a medal, a finish bag, and a bib; teams of five people are offered a picnic after the finish. Timing for the 5 km is available but can be opted out of during registration if you do not want your result published.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Lögastrand
The course runs through central Västerås
The 5 km distance is measured (also available at 2.5 km)
additional: Registration is done digitally and can be completed until race day, at least 1 hour before the first start; recommended age for 5 km: 13 years (with adult 11 years), 2.5 km: 11 years (with adult 7 years). Team registration (5 people) includes a picnic after the finish. Included for participants: medal, finish bag, Vårruset music quiz + prizes, and bib; timing is available for 5 km but can be opted out of. Local organizer: Västerås FK (www.vasterasfriidrott.se); information about a local training session will be published with separate registration via Västerås FK's registration page. Distances are 2.5 or 5 km; a team consists of five people and registration can be made as a team or individual; timing can be opted out of during registration; registration is digital and a picnic is offered after the finish.

name: Blodomloppet Linköping
description: Join us in raising awareness for the vital blood donation at the Blood Run Linköping! The race offers the opportunity to walk, jog, or run 5 km and 10 km, as well as a Little Blood Run for younger participants. The event is team- and company-friendly – many participate in teams of five, and the race traditionally ends with a large picnic. Registration can be done individually or in teams, and the organizer offers special discounts for blood donors and youth teams.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km (possibility to walk, jog, or run)
Suitable for both individual runners and teams (3 - 5 people, often teams of 5)
The race ends with a large communal picnic
additional: Registration is done individually or in teams (3 - 5 people); payment is always for 5 in a team, and can be supplemented to a full team without cost until April 30 (to be supplemented via linkoping@blodomloppet.se). Youth teams (all born in 2009 or later) participate at half the entry fee until April 30. Blood donors receive a discount of 40 SEK per person. The last day for team registration is May 14; registration on the website is open until the start. All who register by May 14 and provide a mobile number will receive an SMS ticket link for free travel within Östergötland for 6 hours on race day. Number bib distribution: May 19 from 11 am to 7 pm (GeBlod, Storgatan 32), May 20 from 12 pm to 6 pm (GeBlod), and May 21 from 4 pm to 7 pm (Saab Arena). From May 1, personal visits may be required for certain changes. Companies can get a customer page in the registration system. Discounts for blood donors and information about training before the race are available. The last day for team registration may be mid-May, and payment methods include Swish, card, and e-invoice. The ticket provides free travel within Östergötland for up to 6 hours on race day.

name: Stigtomtaloppet 2026
location: Stigtomta, Nyköping Municipality, Södermanland County, Sweden

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Lagtävling (3-6 pers) 3,8 km eller 7,6 km inkl picknickkorg = 1500 kr

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Lagtävling (3-6 pers) 3,8 km eller 7,6 km inkl picknickkorg = 1500 kr

description: Stigtomta Race is a scenic running festival in Stigtomta organized by OK Hällen since 2012. The race is suitable for all ages and running abilities with distances of 3.8 km and 7.6 km, as well as shorter children's classes and a new dog class in 2026. The courses run on a mix of grass, trail, and road through forests and residential areas, and the event is popular both for individual runners and for teams/work groups who want to compete together. For teams, a picnic basket is included, to be picked up at the catering tent after finishing.
course_highlights: Course on asphalt, trail, and grass through forests and residential areas
Start and finish on the green area next to ICA Nära in Stigtomta
The hill sprint: timing in the steepest hill and prizes along the course
additional: Start times: Knatte 17:40, Lower/Middle School Class 18:00, Dog 18:15 - 18:20 (fast dogs first), Adult (including team competition) 18:45. Participant bags and bibs with timing chips must be collected no later than 30 minutes before each start. For teams, a picnic basket is included (to be picked up at the catering tent; drinks not included). The catering tent accepts card payments. Parking is available according to signs along road 52; cycling is recommended. The dog class is limited to 30 participants, and dog owners must pick up after their dogs. A dog-friendly variant will be introduced in 2026 with a separate start for dog runners; different ways to participate (run, pull the dog, or walk) in Stigtomta.

name: Ludvika stadslopp
description: Ludvika City Run is organized by Ludvika FFI and is a family-friendly city race with several distances for both children and adults. The start and finish are at Charlie Norman's Square, and the event includes a toddler race, the Little City Run, as well as 5 km and 10 km races (optional with or without timing). The event will be held on Saturday, May 23, 2026, and welcomes runners of all ages and levels. There is a bonus connected to the course record for the 10 km race.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Charlie Norman's Square
Toddler race (0 - 6 years), Little City Run (up to 12 years), and 5 km and 10 km races
10 km: bonus/prize for course record
additional: Registration is done via a Google form (https://forms.gle/Q5BfNzbjmGGyDGy46). Race schedule: 11:00 Toddler race (0 - 6 years), 11:30 Little City Run (up to 12 years), 13:00 start for 5 km and 10 km (with or without timing). The start/finish is located between the train station and the small boat harbor at Charlie Norman's Square. The start and finish for all races are at Charlie Norman's Square; the event includes various races during the day, including shorter toddler races and longer running distances.

name: Backyard Ultra Vänge
location: Vänge, Uppsala Municipality, Uppsala County, Sweden
description: Backyard Ultra Vänge is a unique ultramarathon event organized by Hagunda IF where participants run a 6.7 km lap every full hour until only one runner remains. The race is held in Vänge, about 7 km outside Uppsala along national road 72, combining challenging terrain with natural surroundings and strong community. There is also a team competition with a point system that rewards fair median times and larger teams; registration opens on September 18th and the upcoming race is planned for May 23, 2026.
course_highlights: Lap of approximately 6.7 km (6,706 meters)
Trail race in scenic environment with challenging sections
A new lap starts every full hour - complete the lap before the hour ends to continue
additional: Maximum capacity is mentioned as 180 participants (the page shows 179/180 spots filled). The race uses a team competition with a point system that removes the extreme results for fair median time and awards bonuses for larger teams. The lap occurs every hour and only those who complete the lap before the hour ends can start the next lap. Results and previous races are published on the race results page. Capacity 180 participants; 179 spots filled and 1 spot remaining.

name: VirsboRUN
location: Skräddartorpet, Virsbo, Fagersta Municipality, Västmanland, Sweden
description: Welcome to VirsboRUN - a family-friendly trail race at Skräddartorpet on Saturday, May 23, 2026. You can choose to run 1 to 4 laps on the 5.3 km loop (maximum 21.2 km) or let the children participate in the free toddler race of about 800 meters. The course runs through pristine nature and Hälleskogsbrännan with varied trails and beautiful views; after finishing, participants will receive a medal and freshly grilled hamburger.
course_highlights: 5.3 km loop (up to 4 laps) - you choose how many laps to run
Challenging terrain with approximately 101 meters of elevation gain per lap, including rocky sections and forest trails in Hälleskogsbrännan
Toddler race about 800 m (free) and an extra water station approximately halfway (~2.5 km)
additional: Number bibs are collected at Stora Ladan from 10:00 AM. The toddler race is limited to 50 participants and the Men/Women classes are limited to 150 starters. Late registration is available until about 1 hour before the start on race day. Everyone who finishes will receive a medal and a goody bag; freshly grilled hamburgers (including vegetarian options) are also provided. Relay is allowed (2 - 4 persons), maximum race time is 3 hours, and participation is at your own risk (no refunds). Participants must wear a visible bib on the chest; dogs are not allowed. Virsbo Rescue Service will be on site. Trail race in the forest near Virsbo at Skräddartorpet; 5.3 km laps with 101 m elevation gain per lap; free toddler course (800 m); medals for all; freshly grilled hamburgers for all competitors; outdoor gym, parking, changing rooms, showers, sauna, toilets, and refreshments available on site.

name: Å-Varvet
description: The Å-varvet in Eskilstuna is an urban race where runners can choose between distances of 5 km and 10 km. The race starts and finishes in the city park in central Eskilstuna and offers running through a beautiful city environment, according to official sources. The 2026 edition is scheduled for May 23, and the organizer is described as Eskilstuna Municipality. According to the official Facebook page, a quarter marathon of approximately 10,549 meters is also promoted, providing an additional option for distances.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the city park in central Eskilstuna
Running through a beautiful city environment
Distance options: 5 km and 10 km (considering different courses and experiences)
additional: The distances offered according to official sources are 5 km and 10 km; start/finish in the city park; the 2026 edition is planned for May 23. According to the Facebook page, a approximately 10,549 m quarter marathon is also promoted.

description: The Stockholm Stadium Race is held on Sunday, May 24, 2026, starting, passing the halfway point, and finishing at the historic Stockholm Stadium. The main race is a 5 km run on a two-lap course around the scenic areas of the Stadium, and there are also categories for children and youth. The race is family-friendly and community-oriented, organized by Djurgårdens IF Athletics with chip timing and prizes for the top three.
course_highlights: Start, passing the halfway point, and finish at Stockholm Stadium
Main race 5 km on a two-lap course around the Stadium
Children's and youth categories (shorter distances, some categories without timing)
additional: Registration via RaceID closes at 09:00 on race day; thereafter, registration is only possible on-site. The chip is attached to the bib number, and both net and gross times are used; placement is based on net time. Race packets can be collected from 10:00 on race day; payment by card and Swish before race day, only Swish on race day. Members of Djurgårdens IF Athletics can register for free using a provided code. All registered participants receive two football tickets (one for a men's match and one for a women's match). Medical personnel will be on site. In the spring, trial runs on the race track are offered by DIF Running. Distance options include 5 km and shorter distances (400 m, 1.2 km, 2.6 km); the first start is at 12:00; trial runs on the race track are available during the spring.

description: Stadium Race is a running event with start, lap, and finish at Stockholm Stadium, taking place on Sunday, May 24, 2026. The main race is 5 km and runs on a two-lap course through the scenic areas of the Stadium. There are also categories for children and youth with various distances. The race offers chip timing and attractive prizes for the winners. All participants also receive tickets to football matches as part of the membership in Djurgårdens IF Athletics.
course_highlights: 5 km two-lap course around scenic areas at Stockholm Stadium
Categories for children and youth with distances from 400 m to 5 km
Start, lap, and finish at the historic Stockholm Stadium
additional: Net and gross times with chip timing in the bib. Registration via RaceID closes at 09:00 on race day, thereafter only on-site registration. Payment by card and Swish before race day, only Swish on race day. Members of Djurgården Athletics can register for free with a code. All participants receive two tickets to a men's and a women's football match, to be collected on race day from 10:00. Medical personnel will be on site. The race also includes shorter distances for younger participants, and registration is via RaceID. The event takes place on the same day as the cycling race Stadiongirot.

name: Vårruset Jönköping
description: Vår Ruset in Jönköping is an evening race held at Rocksjön in Knektaparken with distances of 2.5 km and 5 km (the 5 km course is measured). The race is open to participants of various ages and offers medals, finish bags, and bibs to registered participants. Timing is available as an optional choice and team registrations (teams of five) are offered with a picnic after the finish. The event is organized locally by IKHP Huskvarna and welcomes both recreational runners and experienced runners for a pleasant spring evening.
course_highlights: The course runs along Rocksjön in Knektaparken
Optional distances 2.5 km and 5 km (5 km is measured)
Timing is optional - can be opted out so results are not published
additional: Team registration (5 persons) includes a picnic after the finish; individual and team registrations receive a medal, finish bag, and bib. It is possible to opt out of timing in the registration so that your result is not published. Recommended age: 5 km from 13 years (or 11 years with adult); 2.5 km from 11 years (or 7 years with adult). Free training sessions are held before the season (for example, March 19 at 6:30 PM at Rocksjöstadion). Registration is digital and can be done until race day, at least 1 hour before the first start. Local organizer: IKHP Huskvarna. The distances are 2.5 km or 5 km. Age recommendation: 5 km: 13 years (with adult 11 years); 2.5 km: 11 years (with adult 7 years). A team consists of 5 people; team leader fills in details and members fill in their details before team registration. Picnic after the race. Event area: Rocksjön in Knektaparken.

description: Welcome to the Blood Race Hudiksvall - a fun run that highlights the importance of blood donation. Participate by walking, jogging, or running 5 km or 10 km (both timed), or register children for the Little Blood Race. The event is locally organized by Strands IF Athletics in collaboration with GeBlod Gävleborg and traditionally concludes with a communal picnic. Registration is open, and there are options for team registration and group solutions.
course_highlights: Optional distances 5 km and 10 km, both with timing
Little Blood Race for children
Concludes with a traditional picnic after the race
additional: Timing is offered for 5 km and 10 km. Team registration is available (1750 SEK), and an Excel template can be downloaded for large registrations; the organizer can assist with a customer page or discount code for groups over 50 participants. GeBlod Gävleborg is specified as the local blood donor partner with contact phone number and office hours. Number bibs, storage, changing facilities, toilets, water stations, and parking information are provided on the information pages. Team and group work are mentioned; team picnic baskets; limited storage near the ice hall/Holmen Arena; parking may be limited; public transport or cycling is recommended.

price_tiers.distance: Gladsheim Finspångs Stadslopp (7 km) och AktivRundan (3,5–3,8 km)

description: Gladsheim Finspång City Run is a fun and festive race event with start and finish in Bruksparken in central Finspång. The main race is 7 km on even terrain through the city environment, and there is also a shorter AktivRunda and a children's race (XL Bygg Lilla Slottsrundan). All participants receive a medal at the finish line, and the event is characterized by strong audience support, music, and prize ceremonies. In 2026, the race celebrates its tenth anniversary and welcomes both competitive and recreational runners as well as families and children.
course_highlights: 7 km through central Finspång on even and nice terrain
The course is lined with spectators and music to motivate runners
Shorter AktivRundan (~3.8 km) without timing and children's race 1.7 km
additional: Start and finish in Bruksparken; bib number distribution at Stora Coop Finspång/Viberga Tuesday, May 26 from 15:00 to 19:00; bibs not collected at Coop will be handed out at the start/finish area no later than one hour before the start; the top flap on the bib is the chip that registers the time; no shower facilities; all who walk/jog/run to the finish will receive energy products from COOP and a water bottle sponsored by Finspångs Brunnsborrning; medal sponsored by Curt Nicolin Gymnasiet; late registration via the website from May 18 to 25 costs 395 SEK (online), and registration at bib distribution from May 26 to 27 costs 425 SEK (on-site). 7 km course through central Finspång (start/finish in Bruksparken); AktivRundan approximately 3.5 - 3.8 km; XL Bygg Lilla Slottsrundan 1.7 km for children. Bibs are collected at Stora Coop Finspång/Viberga; the chip is registered via the flap at the top of the bib; registration and payment via Swish is possible; race day opens at 15:00 in Bruksparken. The 2026 event marks the 10th anniversary; start for XL Bygg Lilla Slottsrundan at 17:00, main start at 19:00.

description: The Blood Donation Run in Uppsala is a fitness event that highlights the vital importance of blood donation and welcomes participants to walk, jog, or run 5 km or 10 km. The race also offers the Special Race and the Little Blood Donation Run for younger participants. The courses are partially measured, and the event concludes with a communal picnic, creating a social and inclusive atmosphere. The Blood Donation Run is a health activity that engages both individuals and teams, with a strong focus on health and the significance of blood donation.
course_highlights: 10 km course is measured
5 km course is approximately 4950 meters long
Little Blood Donation Run is 2.5 km long
additional: Registration is valid for 5 people. Larger registrations can be made via an Excel template. The 10 km course is measured, other courses are estimated. The event concludes with a communal picnic. There are water stations and medical services on site. Bib numbers, changing facilities, and toilets are available. Participants can also participate with dogs. Environmental considerations and accessibility are prioritized. The event is part of Sweden's largest blood donation race and aims to promote blood donation while offering a social and healthy race for all ages.

name: Blodomloppet
organizer: Stora Tuna OK och Kvarnsvedens GOIF Friidrott
description: The Blood Donation Run in Borlänge is an open fitness event where you can walk, jog, or run 5 km or 10 km, as well as participate in the Little Blood Donation Run (approximately 800 meters). The race is organized locally by Stora Tuna OK and Kvarnsvedens GOIF Friidrott and has a strong social profile with team registration options and a concluding picnic. The event aims to raise awareness about blood donation and welcomes both individual participants and teams. Information and practical details (bib numbers, storage, start areas) are published on the event page.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km running routes that go north over the Sports Field and split at Storsvängen
The walking route goes down towards Borlänge city center and ends at the fruit and medal stations
The Little Blood Donation Run is approximately 800 meters and takes place in the area around the event site
additional: Registration can be done individually or in teams (3 - 5 persons, picnic basket included). Teams cannot register after May 21; individual participants can register late in the system until May 28 at 12:00. Same-day registration on the event day takes place at the arena area from 15:00 to 17:00 and only via Swish (400 SEK). Bib number distribution is available at Friskis&Svettis (Skomakargatan 9) on May 24 from 13:00 to 16:00. Blood donors receive a 40 SEK discount per person. The kiosk at the event site accepts only Swish. Team registration for 3 - 5 participants includes a picnic basket. Individual registration is also available; blood donors get a 40 SEK discount per person. The start time is 17:00 with warm-up at 16:45 (according to information). The race routes include 5 km, 10 km, and the Little Blood Donation Run (~800 m); registration is via the website or on-site at the Sports Field from around 15:00. Sale of start packages includes a functional T-shirt, bib number, and medal.

name: Vårruset
description: Spring Races in Örebro is part of Sweden's largest fitness tour for women and is held on Thursday, May 28, 2026, at Gustavsviksbadet. Runners can choose between a 2.5 km or a precisely measured 5 km course; both individual and team registrations (teams of 5 people) are welcome. The event offers a medal, a finish bag, a bib number, and optional timing - teams that register are invited to a picnic after the finish. The event is organized locally by KFUM Örebro Friidrott in collaboration with Marathongruppen and other local clubs.
course_highlights: Optional distances 2.5 km or precisely measured 5 km
Evening run at Gustavsviksbadet starting at 18:30
Team picnic after finishing for teams of five people
additional: Registration is digital and can be done until the day of the race, no later than 1 hour before the first start. For individual registration, a medal, finish bag, bib number, and (if chosen) timing are included - timing can be opted out of so results are not published. Recommended age: 13 years for 5 km (11 years with adult supervision), 11 years for 2.5 km (7 years with adult supervision). There is also a digital option (Vårruset Digitalt) where a medal is sent after the tour ends and team registration is not possible. Distances: 2.5 km or 5 km; team registration includes a picnic; age recommendations: 13 years for 5 km (11 years with adult supervision), 7 years for 2.5 km (11 years with adult supervision). Event area at Gustavsviksbadet; digital registration and binding registration.

name: Eksjö Stadslopp
description: Welcome to Eksjö City Run on Friday, May 29, 2026 – an evening race in the beautiful wooden town of Eksjö. The race program includes the classic 10 km, 5 km recreational run, as well as children’s and youth races (1000 m and 600 m). The finish line is at Stora Torget, and proceeds from the event go to Eksjö Södra IK’s children and youth activities. The course is measured for both 10 km and 5 km, and the event is open to runners of all ages.
course_highlights: The race runs through Eksjö's historic wooden town
Finish line at Stora Torget in Eksjö
The course is officially measured for both 10 km and 5 km
additional: Race bibs are collected at Snäckan (next to the swimming hall). Distribution times: Thursday, May 28 from 17:00 to 20:00 and Friday, May 29 from 14:00; changing rooms are available at Prästängshallen until 21:30 on race day. Late registration is available from May 24 with an increased fee and is possible until one hour before the start of each race via the same registration page. Medals are awarded to all finishers of the 600 m and 1000 m races; plaques are given to finishers of the 5 km and 10 km races. Sprint prizes for the 10 km race after approximately 1.2 km (first man and woman, must complete the race). Classification is based on year of birth. Group registration is available via invoice at tavling.esik@gmail.com. Course maps can be collected at Snäckan on Thursday and Friday. Late registration from May 24 with an increased fee; race bibs are collected at Snäckan by the swimming hall; parking is available at Storegårdsgatan 3A, Eksjö; changing rooms are at Prästängshallen until 21:30 on race day.

name: adidas Shake Out Run
description: Get a preview of the unique marathon atmosphere by running the adidas Shake Out Run. The race is 5 km long and starts and finishes at Stockholm Stadium. It is a perfect warm-up for those running the marathon the next day, but also an opportunity for others to experience the atmosphere during the event weekend. The first 1,000 registrants are guaranteed an adidas T-shirt in their chosen size.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Stockholm Stadium
Distance 5 km - a short race perfect as a warm-up
Participation provides a preview of the marathon atmosphere during the event weekend
additional: The race is organized by the athletics clubs Hässelby SK and Spårvägens FK. Age limit 13 years (11 years with guardian). The first 1,000 registered participants are guaranteed an adidas T-shirt distributed during the race; others can visit the information desk after the race to see which sizes are available. Payment options: internet banking, Visa/MasterCard, Swish, or invoice via Klarna. Late registration is possible digitally until 1 hour before the first start. Minimum age 13 years; environmentally friendly transportation options to the event area (subway/bus or bicycle); registration is done via participant account; first come, first served—T-shirts and sizes are distributed at the information desk.

name: adidas Stockholm Marathon
description: adidas Stockholm Marathon is a classic marathon race taking place on May 30, 2026, attracting both elite and recreational runners. The race is 42,195 meters long, officially measured according to current regulations, and runs through central Stockholm on a new course. The event is organized by the athletics clubs Hässelby SK and Spårvägens FK, with the organizer highlighting extensive runner services along the route. The start is from Stockholm Stadium, and the race offers seeding opportunities through events such as adidas Premiärmilen and adidas Premiärhalvan.
course_highlights: 42,195 meters, officially measured according to the Swedish Athletics Federation and IAAF
New course through central Stockholm (including Sveavägen, Kungsgatan) with city passages
World-class runner services along the entire route
additional: Start and finish area: Lidingövägen outside the clock tower at Stockholm Stadium. Starts in two waves, at 12:00 and 12:10. The maximum time for the marathon is 6.5 hours, with four control points with stop times along the route. Seeding: the last day to report times for seeding is May 3, 2026; adidas Premiärmilen and adidas Premiärhalvan are qualifying events for seeding. adidas Premiärmilen (10 km) takes place in Northern Djurgården, with a total elevation of 117 meters, mixed terrain, and a tentative start time at 11:00; maximum time is 2 hours, and contact for Premiärmilen is info@premiarmilen.se. The event is organized by Hässelby SK and Spårvägens FK, and the website is provided by Marathongruppen i Stockholm AB. The event is sold out for May 30, 2026. The course runs through central Stockholm and ends at Stockholm Stadium; runners have the opportunity to participate in related adidas events such as Premiärmilen, Premiärhalvan, and Shake Out Run.

name: Öland Lighthouse Challenge
price_range: 1490 kr/100 miles, 990 kr/50 miles, 590 kr/50 km
description: Öland Lighthouse Challenge is an ultramarathon on Öland starting at the Långe Erik lighthouse. The race is offered in three distances - 50 km, 50 miles, and 100 miles - and runs along coastal areas, meadows, and forested regions with views of the alvar and the Baltic Sea. The race is well-organized with water stations and energy depots along the course; medals and shirts are awarded to all finishers. The organizer is Högby IF, and the event is suitable for both experienced ultrarunners and long-distance trained recreational runners.
course_highlights: Start at Långe Erik lighthouse with coastal running along Kalmarsund to Sandvik (finish for 50 km)
Route through meadows and forests to Lindby (finish for 50 miles) and further to Långe Jan for 100 miles
Views of the alvar and the Baltic Sea; water stations/energy depots approximately every 20 km
additional: Number bib pickup on Friday from 13:30; race info, course maps, and GPX files (updated) available on the race website; labels for drop bags provided; medals and shirts for all finishers; 15% discount on accommodation at Böda Sand (mention Lighthouse Challenge when booking); payment at late registration/number bib pickup: cash, card, or Swish. Training and running routes info available; energy depots approximately every 20 km; 15% discount on accommodation at Böda Sand during the weekend (mention Lighthouse Challenge when booking); start at Långe Erik and finish at Långe Jan; medals and T-shirts included in the registration fee; late registration possible until May 27 according to the race info.

name: Highland Charity Backyard Ultra
organizer: Highland Trail Club and Höglandskyrkan i Sävsjö
description: Welcome to Highland Charity Backyard Ultra in Sävsjö - a charitable and challenging backyard ultra race where Höglandskyrkan in Sävsjö and Highland Trail Club collaborate. The race is run as hourly lap starts with a common start at 09:00 and a new start every full hour; anyone who does not complete the lap within 60 minutes is out. Participants can choose between a easy 3.7 km loop around the lake or the tougher 6.7 km Bäckaskogsrundan, and the proceeds from the race go to charitable causes.
course_highlights: 3.7 km around the lake (gravel road, trail, asphalt) - easy course with good surface
6.7 km Bäckaskogsrundan (gravel road, forest trail) - technical and hilly forest running
Lap format: new start every full hour; 15 laps approximately 55 km or 100 km
additional: Parking at Slottsruinen parking lot (toilets available); bib, water bottle, food, and coffee/cake included in the registration fee. Food is served for participants at 11:30, 15:30, and 19:30. Bibs can be collected from 07:30 to 08:30 on race morning. Late registration is open from May 24 to May 30 at 08:30 (late registration fee 350 SEK). The winner is the last person to complete a lap or the first to finish at lap 15 if multiple remain. Participants choose the distance before each full hour; prizes are only awarded to those running the long course. The Backyard Ultra format includes two distances; maximum 15 laps; start at 09:00 and finish by 00:00; registration in advance and late registration until race day; start and finish area at Slottsruinen parking in Sävsjö.

description: Welcome to Blodomloppet Örebro - a community race celebrating the vital importance of blood donation. The event offers competitions and festivities for both 5 km and 10 km (women/men), a short Special Race, and the Little Blood Race for children. Registration can be done individually or in teams of five people, and the race is suitable for both walking and running of all ages. The organizer also encourages community spirit and often concludes with a large picnic.
additional: Registrations can be made individually or in teams (team = 5 participants, 1 - 2 spots may be vacant). Team fee and the option to mix classes apply; an Excel template for mass registration is available. The Little Blood Race is for ages 1 - 12 years (adults can accompany) and the first 200 children to register by 2026-04-30 will participate for free according to the organizer’s offer. Discounts: blood donors, ICA members, and campaigns via Nerikes Allehanda (40 SEK, some restrictions - not valid during late registration). The last day for team registration is 2026-05-26; individual registrations can be made up until the race (about 30 minutes before start) but usually at a higher fee. Contact for registration/assistance: orebro@blodomloppet.se or kansli@blodomloppet.se.

name: Blodomloppet Stockholm
description: Blodomloppet Stockholm is a community race organized to raise awareness of the need for blood donation. The event offers 5 km and 10 km options for runners and walkers, as well as the Little Blood Run for children, and traditionally concludes with a picnic. There are competitive categories with timing and prizes for the three fastest runners. Everyone is welcome - run, jog, or walk for an important cause.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km - options to walk, jog, or run
Walking category 5 km where dogs are allowed
Little Blood Run for children: 1.1 km (7 - 12 years) and 800 m (1 - 6 years)
additional: A team consists of 5 people (at least 3 names required upon registration) and team registration must be completed by May 28; team registration includes a picnic basket. Extra picnic baskets cost 250 SEK and can be added until May 28. Blood donors receive a 40 SEK discount (to be stated at registration) and a blood donor gift is distributed at GeBlod's tent; participants remotely can receive a 250 SEK ICA gift card instead of a picnic basket. Invoice payment is only available for orders over 1500 SEK. Poles are only allowed in walking categories; strollers are not permitted during the race but are welcome at the event area. Venue at Djurgårdsbrunn; start area opens approximately 20 minutes before the start; walking category without timing; no access to changing rooms or showers; blood donors receive a discount on registration (40 SEK).

description: Gladsheim Finspång City Run is an annual recreational race that takes place through the beautiful town of Finspång, starting and finishing in Bruksparken. The race offers a 7-kilometer course suitable for all recreational runners, whether walking, jogging, or running. For those seeking a shorter challenge, there is the AktivRundan of 3.8 kilometers and the XL Bygg Lilla Slottsrundan of 1.7 kilometers for children. The event celebrates its 10th anniversary in 2026 and promises a lively fitness festival with music, prizes, and community. After the race, there is an official After Run for recovery and mingling.
course_highlights: 7 km city course through central Finspång
AktivRundan of 3.8 km for a shorter distance
XL Bygg Lilla Slottsrundan of 1.7 km for children
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Stora Coop Finspång/Viberga on Tuesday, May 26th between 15:00 and 19:00. Late registration is possible on-site at the start and finish area from 15:00 on race day. All participants receive a medal sponsored by Curt Nicolin Gymnasiet, energy products from COOP Finspång, and a water bottle from Finspångs Brunnsborrning. Timing is done with a chip on the race bib. There are no shower facilities. After the race, an official After Run is organized at Joan´s by Promotionhuset. DigFab-Spurten is a voluntary sprint of about 100 meters with its own prizes. Prize money and special awards are given to elite runners and age categories. Cross-country and city races, registration via the website, race bib distribution at Coop, various distances including Lilla Slottsrundan, 2026 anniversary celebration.

name: Stora Sköndalsvarvet
description: Beautiful 5-kilometer course (5,100 meters) on roads and trails, from Stora Sköndal, via Orhem's colony area and through Flatens Nature Reserve. Partially hilly.
additional: Changing rooms and pickup of race bib from 16:30, warm-up at 17:15. No start groups.
