For children, there is the Little Blood Race (approximately 700 meters) which has a common start and medal. The race gathers participants in teams and traditionally ends with a picnic.
course_highlights: Selectable distances: 5 km and 10 km (with timing) as well as a 5 km walk (without timing)
Little Blood Race: approximately 700 meters for children up to 12 years, common start and medal; start from Knektaparken
Event area at Knektaparken with a traditional common picnic after the finish line
additional: Team registration consists of 3 - 5 participants; registered blood donors receive a 40 SEK discount if indicated at registration. Changes (e.g., from 10 km to 5 km) cost 50 SEK upon modification and presenting the order ID during pickup; on the day of the race (August 11), only Swish or cash payment are accepted. Payment terms are otherwise 30 days with multiple options (Swish, card via Swedbank Pay, postal giro, invoice). Team registration and individual registrations have different prices; discounts for blood donors and a fee for invoice. Bib numbers are collected at Hovslätts IK's clubhouse or at the start, and the award ceremony takes place at 19:30.

name: Vetlanda Citylopp

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Dam-, herr- och motionsklassen (10 km och 5 km) 180 kr

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Kids F8/P8 - F12/P12 (1 km till 1,7 km) 100 kr

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Föreningar (max 15st per anmälan) 900 kr (Föreningar kan anmäla i F/P8-F/P12 samt Junior 5km)

description: Vetlanda Citylopp is an open and spectator-friendly city race scheduled for August 14, 2026, with start and finish on Storgatan in Vetlanda. Runners can choose between 5 km and 10 km on an easy-to-run loop course, and there are several children and youth categories as well as a Funktionsklass (disability class). Number bibs can be collected and late registration is available at Stortorget from 12:00 on race day, and the event is combined with activities and light food service at the square. We photograph and film during the race, and images may be used in future marketing.
course_highlights: Start and finish on Storgatan in the center of Vetlanda
Easy-to-run, spectator-friendly loop course (5 km or 10 km)
Children and youth distances from 400 m up to 1.7 km as well as a 1 km Funktionsklass
additional: Number bibs can be collected and late registration is available at Stortorget from 12:00 on race day. Late registration can be done no later than 30 minutes before the respective start time, with on-site payment possible via Swish (additional fee applies for late registration). Timing is done with a chip in the bib by Racetimer, and results are published live on Racetimer's website as well as on OK Njudung's website. The event includes activities and light food service at the square; the organizer photographs and films during the race. Participants can walk/jog/run at their own pace; late registration on site for a fee; photography/filming during the race that may be used in marketing.

name: Midnattsloppet Stockholm
description: Midnattsloppet Stockholm is a festive evening race on Södermalm held on August 15, 2026, offering 21 km, 10 km, and 5 km distances, as well as several children’s and disability-friendly races. The race is characterized by late start times, music, spectators, and activities along the course, creating a unique and lively atmosphere. The 21 km class runs two laps of the Midnattsloppet 10 km course around Södermalm, which is described as relatively hilly. The organizer emphasizes community, running joy, and that the event suits both competitive runners and recreational athletes.
course_highlights: 21 km = two laps of the Midnattsloppet 10 km course around Södermalm
Relatively hilly course - inclines and the character of the district
Music, samba rhythms, and spectators along the course create a festival atmosphere
additional: Start/ warm-up location: Ringvägen 26. Finish line: Hornsgatan 57. The registration fee includes a t-shirt from Björn Borg (this year's color/print), precise timing, sports drinks and water along the course, as well as a cold Vitamin Well, fruit, and energy bar at the finish; medals can be purchased during registration and a digital diploma is offered. There is an option to use wellness providers (Benifex, Epassi, Benefits) and instructions for redemption codes are available; group registration grants a 50 SEK discount per person. Information about start groups, shirts, race kits, and dedicated pages for companies can be found on the organizer’s website. The digital Midnattsloppet runs from September 12 to September 20.

name: 6 sjöar
location: Fjällnora friluftsgård, Uppsala Municipality, Uppsala County, Sweden
description: Six Lakes is a volunteer-organized running event held on August 15, 2026, starting and finishing at Fjällnora Outdoor Recreation Area outside Uppsala. You can choose between a marathon (42 km around six lakes), half marathon (21 km around four lakes), 10.3 km, or a shorter 5.5 km course around Ramsen – all routes are well marked and feature varied forest trails and gravel roads. The race is environmentally friendly (few disposable cups, option to get a reusable cup or Hydrapouch) and offers free direct buses from Uppsala Central Station; the organizers work voluntarily. It is a nature-oriented race where swimming along the course may be possible in warm weather, and the start times are scheduled so that different distances can be run simultaneously by families and friends.
course_highlights: Marathon around six lakes; half marathon around four lakes – scenic views by several waters
Easy-to-run courses mostly on small gravel roads and shorter trails, with some technical sections (5 km has tricky trails and bridges)
Opportunity to take a dip along the course in warm weather and water stations on the routes
additional: Start and finish at Fjällnora Outdoor Recreation Area. Start times: Marathon 10:00, Half Marathon 10:30, 10 km 11:00, 5 km 11:30. Bibs can be collected at Uppsala Central Station Thursday – Friday before the race from 11:00 to 19:00 or on site no later than 30 minutes before the start. Free direct buses from Uppsala Central Station (fossil fuel-free) and information/timetable are published by the organizer. The race avoids disposable cups – bring your own bottle or get a free reusable cup/Hydrapouch; no free T-shirts but the option to purchase one after finishing. The event is organized voluntarily; questions can be directed to info@6sjoar.se, and contact details for registration are provided on the contact page. The race offers detailed maps and GPX files via the 'Choose Race' page; fewer disposable cups and a reminder to bring your own bottle or use Hydrapouch. Registration is online, and bibs are collected at Uppsala Central Station or before the start.

name: Convinistafetten
location: Stora Skuggan, Norra Djurgården, Stockholm, Sweden
description: Welcome to the Convinistafetten in Stockholm - a festive and team-building relay race at Stora Skuggan, Norra Djurgården. The event takes place over two late summer evenings (August 19-20, 2026), and each team consists of five people, with each participant running 5 km. There is also a walk category for those who prefer to walk together. As an extra highlight, title sponsor Convini offers all teams a picnic after crossing the finish line.
course_highlights: Five legs of 5 km each - each team member runs 5 km
Start and finish area at the exchange zone in Stora Skuggan, Norra Djurgården
Picnic on the grass after crossing the finish line (Convini provides all teams)
additional: Registration is per team (5 persons). The walk team starts separately, and everyone in the walk team walks 5 km together. The team leader registers the team and receives information as well as all five bib numbers by mail; the runner of the last leg picks up the picnic box at the picnic tent. The picnic is included in the registration (details announced in May), and extra picnic boxes can be booked for 495 SEK each. Tents (Basic or Premium) can be booked as optional add-ons; orders are confirmed and tent placement communicated before the event. The age limit for running 5 km is 13 years. A walk category is available; start times are according to bib number (e.g., first team at 17:30, later at 17:33, 17:36); chip timing on the bib; changing rooms at Frescati Sports Center for 40 SEK; RSIF offers a subsidized member price with a deadline of August 16 at 18:00 for discount code; parking and public transport information is available.

name: BAUHAUS-galan Youth & Masters
location: Stockholms stadion, Stockholm, Stockholm Municipality, Stockholm County, Sweden
description: BAUHAUS-galan Youth & Masters is a prestigious athletics competition held at Stockholm Stadium, one of the world's most iconic athletics venues. The event welcomes youth aged 12 to 19 as well as veterans aged 35 and older, including para-athletics. With an atmosphere characterized by a gala feel and camaraderie, the event offers excellent competition conditions on Sweden's fastest running tracks. Participants have the chance to compete in an environment where world elite athletes also meet during the BAUHAUS-galan Diamond League.
course_highlights: Competition at Stockholm Stadium, the world's oldest active Olympic arena
High-tech VMAX running tracks from Conica for a fast and even surface
Competition disciplines for youth, veterans, and para-athletics
additional: The spectator area opens preliminarily at 14:00 with preliminary competitions from 16:30 and main events from 17:00. The event includes a family festival with activities and food service. It is recommended to reach the stadium by public transport, walking, or cycling. Safety measures are well planned with staff and medical teams on site. Includes live results, live streaming, and social events such as After Track.

name: Hagbloms Nattloppet
description: Hagbloms Night Run in Kalmar is a night race of 5.0 km that offers a atmospheric running experience along the streets of Kalmar with music, lighting, and surprises along the course. Start and finish are at Stortorget, and the race is open to walkers, joggers, and competitive runners. Everyone who completes the race receives the Night Run medal, and those who register by August 16th also receive the race's unique shirt. The organizer is Högby IF (athletics).
course_highlights: Start, lap, and finish at Stortorget in Kalmar
5.0 km in city environment along Kalmar's streets with music, lighting, and surprises
Walking class 5 km without timing offered
additional: Number bib and late registration can be collected at the Högby tent on Stortorget Thursday, August 20th from 15:00 to 17:00 and Friday, August 21st from 18:00; on-site late registration is accepted until 1 hour before the start. All participants receive a medal, drink, fruit, and a chocolate bar from ICA MAXI. Payment can be made by card, cash, or Swish. Contact information: Högby IF / friidrott@hogbyif.se, Jonne Svensson 070-693 87 44, Calle Nilsson 070-444 31 02. Walking class 5 km without timing; number bib and late registration at the Högby tent on Stortorget August 20th from 15:00 to 17:00 and August 21st from 18:00; a unique night race shirt for pre-registrants until August 16th; drinks, fruit, and chocolate for all participants.

name: Karlskronaspelen
description: Karlskronaspelen is a popular athletics competition held in Karlskrona. The event welcomes both members and non-members and offers a fun and action-packed weekend with athletics training, play, and competition. The event is characterized by volunteer engagement where participants and parents are expected to contribute as officials. It is a great opportunity for youth to develop in athletics and participate in a well-organized competition weekend.
course_highlights: Held in Karlskrona, a beautiful coastal city
Includes various competition categories for runners and athletes
The event takes place on August 21, 2026
additional: The competition takes place in a volunteer-driven club environment where all active participants and parents are expected to help as officials. In 2026, a new format will be tested where different groups are responsible for different disciplines. There is also an official schedule for the competition days. Scandic Karlskrona offers discounted accommodation during the competition weekend. The event is open to participants of various ages and levels, and provides an inspiring competitive environment in a scenic setting.

name: Stockholm Trail
location: Hammarbyhöjdens IP, Stockholm Municipality, Stockholm County, Sweden
description: Do you dream of winding trails, sunlit rocky outcrops, and lovely slopes? Stockholm Trail offers several well-marked trail runs in the beautiful Nacka Nature Reserve with start and finish at Hammarbyhöjden's sports field, near Stockholm city. The course is suitable for both experienced trail runners and recreational runners who want to try trail running. Welcome to a challenging, sweaty, and memorable trail event with encouraging staff and good service.
course_highlights: Technical forest trails and beautiful rocky outcrops with fantastic views in Nacka Nature Reserve
Start and finish at Hammarbyhöjden's sports field, about a 5-minute walk from Hammarbyhöjden subway station
Multiple hydration stations (Umara sports drink) and bib with your name
additional: Start and finish at Hammarbyhöjden's sports field; bibs can be collected on Friday 21/8 at Best Western Park City Hammarby Sjöstad from 16:00 to 19:00 or at the venue from 09:00 on race day. Wooden medal from Raw Cut Studio for finishers. Bag drop (supervised, free); possibility to shower and change indoors. Name change and course transfer free of charge until August 8 (contact sekretariat@stockholmtrail.se). Age limit 18 years for the 21K; maximum times: 4 hours for 21K and 3 hours for 10K. Hydration stations with water and Umara sports drink: 21K passes 5 stations, 10K 3 stations, 5K 1 station. Premium package with T-shirt and training sessions available; T-shirt can be purchased separately (349 SEK). Results published online immediately after finish; announcer, music, and refreshments at the venue. Distances include 21K, 10K, 5K, 5K Fun Run, and 2.5K Minitrail; start/finish at Hammarbyhöjden's sports field; hydration and energy stations along the course; baggage drop and bib pickup; finish area offers drinks, coffee, refreshments, as well as indoor shower and changing facilities; no T-shirt sales at the venue this year (purchase in Bagheeras shop).

name: Hjorthagen Ultra Trail 100
description: Hjorthagen Ultra Trail 100 is an ultramarathon in Lill‑Jansskogen in Stockholm with selectable distances of 50 or 100 miles. The race emphasizes endurance, nature experiences, and community, and is organized by Nisse and Anna Larsson through the association Hjorthagen Ultra SC. The start and finish are located at Stora Skuggans väg 22, with ample parking and proximity to subway and buses. The start times are 09:00 for 100 miles and 14:00 for 50 miles.
course_highlights: Magical forest sections in Lill‑Jansskogen
Steep hills and many elevation meters
Start/finish at Stora Skuggans väg 22 with good access to parking and public transport
additional: Maximum times are 32 hours for 100 miles and 16 hours for 50 miles. Max 100 participants. Start times: 100 miles at 09:00 and 50 miles at 14:00. Surplus proceeds to Suicide Zero.

name: Sandviken Halvmaraton
description: The first edition of Sandviken Half Marathon, be part of making history! 21.1 km around Sandviken, along meadows, lakes, and beautiful residential areas. The course has an elevation change of only 74 meters, with start and finish in Stadsparken Sandviken where there will be activities for the whole family.
course_highlights: 21.1 km around Sandviken
Runs along meadows, lakes, and residential areas
Elevation change of only 74 meters
Start and finish in Stadsparken Sandviken
Activities for the whole family
additional: The first edition of Sandviken Half Marathon, be part of making history! 21.1 km around Sandviken, along meadows, lakes, and beautiful residential areas. The course has an elevation change of only 74 meters, with start and finish in Stadsparken Sandviken where there will be activities for the whole family.

images.alt_text: Sandviken Halvmaraton logotyp med texten "GÄSTRIKELAND 2026 SANDVIKEN HALV-MARATHON"

name: Kvarnsvedenspelen
description: Kvarnsvedenspelen is an athletics competition held at Kvarnsvedens IP in Borlänge. The event is part of Mittsvenska's series and primarily targets youth aged 7-11 and 13-17 years. The event offers a welcoming and community-focused atmosphere where both participants and officials gather to promote athletics and joy in sports. Registration is done via EasyRecord, and the competition has a long tradition with results and records documented since 2016.
course_highlights: The competition is held at Kvarnsvedens IP, an established athletics venue in Borlänge
Part of Mittsvenska's series for youth aged 7-11 and 13-17
Focus on youth athletics development and community
additional: Registration is via EasyRecord. The event is part of a series for youth and is organized with the help of officials who register through the Favvos platform. Results and records from previous years are available. The event emphasizes the importance of community and official engagement. Invitations and registration are through EasyRecord, and the competition is part of Mittsvenska's series for youth.

name: Viking Line Spelen
description: Viking Line Race is organized by Huddinge AIS Athletics and is held at Källbrinks IP in Huddinge. The event is part of the club's broad activities that include youth from 6 years old up to veteran level. The event offers a welcoming atmosphere for athletes of various ages and levels, focusing on development and community. Huddinge AIS is an engaged club that also invests in para-athletics and veteran athletics.
course_highlights: The race is held at Källbrinks IP, a well-equipped athletics arena in Huddinge
The event includes multiple age groups from children to veterans
The club has a strong tradition in athletics and also focuses on para-athletics
additional: The event takes place at Källbrinks IP with access to clubhouse and gym facilities. The club also offers training and try-out activities for children and youth with intellectual disabilities. Policies for officials and other participation policies apply. The contact person for the race is Per Öhrland. The event will be held on August 24, 2026, and is part of Huddinge AIS's annual athletics program.

name: Blodomloppet Västerås
description: Welcome to the Blood Race in Västerås at Rocklunda IP on August 26, 2026 - a recreational race for everyone where you can walk, jog, or run 5 km or 10 km. The Little Blood Race offers two children's races (approximately 1400 m and approximately 500 m) with warm-up and finish under the finish arch. The race is organized to raise awareness of the need for blood donation and traditionally ends with a picnic for teams and participants. Registration can be done individually or in teams (3 - 5 people) and information as well as the race pack are available on the race website.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Rocklunda area (football fields north of the riding hall)
The routes for 5 km and 10 km are marked and have flag marshals placed along the course
Little Blood Race: two children's distances (~1400 m start at 17:15 and ~500 m start at 17:25), finish under the finish arch
additional: Registration can be done individually or in teams (a team of 3 - 5 participants, the cost always covers 5 participants and a picnic for 5 is included). Teams can be filled up to a maximum of 5 people until Monday 24/8 and the last day to register a team is indicated as 19/8; for larger companies, there is an option for customer side/rabatt code. Children in the Little Blood Race receive a medal and a goody bag from ICA Maxi Hälla; warm-up in front of the stage around 17:00 and children choose their distance on site. Registration is binding, no cancellations are accepted, and registration is possible until 26/8 at 17:30. Course and map materials are available on the race website (link to map). Registration via the website or on-site at Rocklunda IP from 15:00 on August 25 according to the information page; includes a functional T-shirt, bib number, and medal; team registration is allowed for 3 - 5 participants with the last regular registration date on August 20; course layout and start times will be announced by the organizer.

name: Norrköpings Stadslopp (Nkpg City)
description: The NKPG City Norrköping City Run is organized by Tjalve Friidrott Norrköping and takes place with start and finish at Olai Kyrkogata in the heart of Norrköping. The race offers distances of 5 km and 10 km (10 km is 2 x 5 km) as well as the free children's race Lilla Lundbergsloppet. The course runs through classic Norrköping environments with well-filled spectator areas, several music stations, and a mix of elite runners and recreational runners. The event provides medals and sponsored products at the finish line, as well as options for team registration and timing or untimed participation.
course_highlights: City course through classic Norrköping environments with well-filled spectator areas
More than ten music stations along the route for extra encouragement
10 km = 2 x 5 km; start and finish at Olai Kyrkogata
additional: Start and finish at Olai Kyrkogata near Hötorget. Start times: Lilla Lundbergsloppet from 17:00 (four starts with 15-minute intervals), 10 km start at 18:30, 5 km start at 19:30. Optional timing or untimed participation for 5 km and 10 km. Lilla Lundbergsloppet (approximately 1,000 m) is free and limited to a maximum of 1,100 children; all children receive a medal and goodie bag. Bib distribution: XXL Ingelsta Tuesday, August 26 from 11:00 to 18:00 and at the partner village near the start and finish area on Wednesday, August 27 from 15:00 (late registration for 5 km and 10 km possible at bib distribution). Start lists and information about your start number will be published from the afternoon of Monday, August 25. Distance options: 5 km and 10 km; Lilla Lundbergsloppet is 1 km free for children; start and finish at Olai Kyrkogata; the course passes Lindens shopping center and includes music stations along the way; Lilla Lundbergsloppet has a maximum of 1,100 children; medals for all participants and a goodie bag; official results page available online.

name: Finnkampsloppet
location: Stockholms Stadion, Stockholm, Stockholm County, Sweden
description: Finnkampen Run is a recreational race held in connection with Finnkampen at Stockholm Stadium. The race offers a 5-kilometer course for recreational runners, where participants have the chance to run in the yellow Sweden jersey and finish at the historic arena. There is also a children and youth race of 2 kilometers for age groups 10 - 12 years and 13 - 16 years. After the race, an After Run is organized at the Stadium where participants and spectators can enjoy the competitions and the atmosphere. The race is part of Finnkampshelgen and provides a unique opportunity to experience the athletics atmosphere up close.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Stockholm Stadium
5 km recreational race with laps inside the arena
Children and youth race of 2 km for ages 10 - 16
additional: After the recreational race, an After Run is organized at the Stadium simultaneously with the first events of Finnkampen. The elite runners start at the Stadium and run a 2-kilometer course with laps inside the arena, providing the audience several opportunities to see them pass. The finish line is inside Stockholm Stadium. The event includes a 5 km recreational race, youth races, an elite race of 10 km, and is held at Stockholm Stadium during Finnkampshelgen. The event is open to all levels and offers a festive atmosphere for participants and spectators.

name: Stockholm Halvmarathon
location: Kungliga slottet, Stockholm, Stockholm County, Sweden
description: adidas Stockholm Half Marathon is a half marathon of 21,098 meters that in 2026 will run for the 25th time through Stockholm's city center. The course is unique with both start and finish in the area between the Royal Palace, the Parliament House, and the Opera House, offering easily runnable streets through Norrmalm, Vasastan, Kungsholmen, Gamla Stan, and Södermalm. The first start is at 15:30, and the event includes an Expo and bib number distribution in Kungsträdgården from August 27 to 29, as well as an after run in Kungsträdgården. The race is open from the year you turn 17, and registration is binding.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the area near the Royal Palace/Norrbro (city center)
Easily runnable course through Norrmalm, Vasastan, Kungsholmen, Gamla Stan, and Södermalm
Passes, among others, Hornsbergstrand, Rålambshovsparken, and Söder Mälarstrand; detailed km‑passage available on the course
additional: Bib number distribution and Expo in Kungsträdgården from August 27 to 29; after run in Kungsträdgården at the finish line; registration is binding and the fee is non-refundable without a valid race insurance via Folksam; payment methods: internet banking, Visa, MasterCard, Swish, or invoice via Klarna; last day to report results for seeding: August 2, 2026; late registration (subject to availability) from August 24 to 29 until 1 hour before the first start. 21,098 km course; start at 15:30; expo in Kungsträdgården August 27-29; start/finish at the Royal Palace; after run in Kungsträdgården.

name: Jönköping Marathon & Half Marathon
description: Jönköping Marathon & Half Marathon is a welcoming city race taking place in 2026 on August 29th, offering beautiful views along Lake Vättern, through Jönköping and Huskvarna. The course has been redesigned for fewer elevation changes but maintains a varied profile with natural sections, crowd support, and several power zones; the marathon segment concludes with an impressive finish on the Munksjö Bridge. The event attracts international participants and also features shorter races, a MINI children's race, as well as offers for companies and tent packages at the start/finish area.
course_highlights: Impressive finish on the Munksjö Bridge
Beautiful views along Lake Vättern, Jönköping, and Huskvarna with a redesigned course and fewer elevation changes
Marathon: 42,195 m with 12 hydration stations along the course + 1 at Start/Finish, an interactive map, and power zones
additional: Practical information from the website: registration can be done for up to five runners simultaneously; start certificates are not sent out; the marathon course has an interactive map and a downloadable PDF, power zones, and over 12 hydration stations; the organizer offers tent packages for companies at the start/finish and the possibility to use wellness vouchers. Distances: 21K (21,097.5 m) and 42K (42,195 m); includes relay race and MINI Jönköping Marathon for children. Energy and hydration stations along the course, chip timing, group registration for up to 5 runners, and a corporate village with tents at the start/finish.

name: Rynningeviken Längre 2026

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 24 augusti - 29 augusti (10.00/13.00) 625 SEK. Begränsat antal platser.

description: Rynningeviken Longer is a timed race in the Rynningeviken nature reserve outside Örebro where participants run as far as they can in either three or six hours. The course follows scenic trails along Lake Hjälmaren and the Svartån river, is relatively technical but fast, and is just a stone's throw from the city center. The event is open to all running styles and levels - from walking to ultramarathon - and offers a community-filled day with support and energy stations. A separate KidsRun for the youngest is also included in the event.
course_highlights: Lap course 2412.5 meters, mostly gravel paths
Two bridges providing the few elevation meters; start/finish on cobblestones
Final 508-meter loop for finish measurement (reduces waiting time at the finish)
additional: Start times and mandatory briefings: 6-hour start at 11:00 (briefing at 10:45), 3-hour start at 14:00 (briefing at 13:45), KidsRun start at 11:30 (briefing at 11:15); Location: Old Oil Harbor below Nature House, parking along Oljevägen; Measurement is done with a transponder loaned at bib pickup (lost transponder charged at 800 SEK) and final measurement verified with a measuring wheel; No individual timing - results are distance covered at the time limit; Drinks/sports drinks from Umara and a well-stocked energy table (bars, fruit, chips, pickles, Tosca cake, etc.); No changing/shower facilities, public toilets at the start and about 1 km away; Registration only via partner AnmälMigNu (group and corporate registration via info@epictrail.se); Youth (born 2008 or later) receive 50% discount; KidsRun participants receive medal, Fanta, and ice cream. Course laps approx. 2412.5 meters with two bridges and a final 508-meter loop; energy/drinks provided (Umara); no changing/shower facilities; toilets near the start and after about 1 km. Registration window August 24-29; youth discount 50% for those born 2008 or later; includes place, bib, timing, unique medal, sports drink, and energy along the course; registration via AnmälMigNu; group/corporate registration via info@epictrail.se; cancellation and insurance options at own risk.

name: Vikingatrailen
location: Årsunda IP, Årsunda, Sandviken Municipality, Gävleborg County, Sweden
description: Årsunda IF invites you to the Vikingatrailen on Sunday, August 30, 2026 - a trail run starting at Årsunda IP and finishing at Vikingabyn (Årsjö gård). The courses include 21 km, 10 km, 5 km, and a mini race of 1 km, with information, invitation, and course materials published on the event's page. Participant information, event briefings, and start lists are updated on the website before the race, and results and photos from previous years are also available. GPX files and maps (including elevation profiles via Garmin Connect) are provided for all courses.
course_highlights: Start at Årsunda IP, finish at Vikingabyn (Årsjö gård).
Courses of various lengths: 21 km, 10 km, 5 km, and a 1 km mini race (mini race starts 1 km from the finish with bus transport to the start).
Maps, GPX files, and elevation profiles are published; courses are uploaded as public routes in Garmin Connect.
additional: Event brief (version 2) updated with information about, among other things, football matches at IP, bib numbers for the 1 km race, award ceremony, and results. Registered participants and preliminary start lists are published continuously, approximately one month before the event. GPX files, maps, and elevation profiles are available for download; courses are also uploaded as public routes in Garmin Connect. GPX files and maps are accessible; elevation profiles are planned; start lists, results, and photos are updated regularly; bus transportation to the start for the 1 km race is available.

name: Blodomloppet

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Anmälningsavgift Blodomloppet (5 eller 10 km): 350 kr  t.o.m 12 augusti.

description: Join us in highlighting the vital blood donation at the Blood Race Växjö on September 2, 2026. The race offers 5 km and 10 km (10 km = two laps of a certified 5 km course) as well as the Little Blood Race for the youngest participants. Start and finish are in Linné Park, and the course is described as flat and fast with plenty of crowd support along the way. The event welcomes both individual participants and teams, and traditionally concludes with a picnic and activities in the event area.
course_highlights: Start and finish in beautiful Linné Park in front of the main stage
Flat, fast, and certified 5 km course (10 km = two laps)
Separate walking route for the 5 km walk and a dedicated loop for the Little Blood Race (~600 m)
additional: Registration can be done individually or in teams (maximum 5 participants per team). Team members within the same team can participate in different distances. The last date to register a team is August 26, 2026. There is an Excel template for mass registrations, and the organizer can assist with customer pages/discount codes for companies registering more than 20 participants. Name changes and class/distance changes cost 50 SEK. Registration is open until the day of the event, and late registration on site in Linné Park is possible (the tent for late registration and bib distribution). The Little Blood Race runs on a separate loop in Linné Park with the same start/finish. Course details: start and finish in Linné Park; the 5 km course is used for the 10 km race; on-site registration and team registration available; includes T-shirt, bib, medal, and goodie bag; water stations and storage are mentioned.

name: Blodomloppet (Östersund)
description: Blood Donation Run in Västerås is a fitness race that highlights the vital importance of blood donation and welcomes participants to walk, jog, or run 5 km or 10 km. The race also offers the Little Blood Donation Run for children in two different distances. Start and finish are at Rocklundaområdet with clearly marked courses and flag marshals. After the race, participants gather for a communal picnic, strengthening the social community around an important cause.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Rocklundaområdet, the football fields north of the riding hall
Marked courses with flag marshals at strategic locations
Little Blood Donation Run for children with two distances of approximately 1400 m and 500 m around Rocklunda IP
additional: The race can be entered individually or in teams of 3-5 people, where the team fee includes a picnic for the entire team. The Little Blood Donation Run has two start times for children aged 1-12, 17:15 for approximately 1400 m and 17:25 for approximately 500 m. Warm-up takes place in front of the stage around 17:00. All participants receive a medal and a goody bag from ICA Maxi Hälla. The courses are marked and flag marshals are positioned. Registration is binding and no cancellations are accepted. The event includes blood donor activities, the possibility to participate with a dog, as well as information about parking and storage. Participants can register individually or in teams, and there is an option to rent tents and flags for the event.

name: Falu Sommarspel
description: Falu Summer Games is an athletics competition held at Lugnets athletics arena in Falun. The event gathers athletes to compete in various disciplines and is part of Falu IK Athletics' activities. The event has a long tradition and is an important competition in the region. Please note that the 2025 Falu Summer Games were canceled, but the competition is planned to be held again in 2026.
course_highlights: The competition is held at Lugnets athletics arena
Athletics competition with multiple disciplines
Organized by Falu IK Athletics
additional: The event is part of Falu IK Athletics' activities and is open to participants of different ages. It is a popular opportunity to measure one's performance and participate in a community around athletics.

name: Tjejmilen
description: Tjejmilen is an iconic 10 km race for women that will take place in 2026 in Södra Djurgården and through Stockholm city on September 5th. The race suits all levels - from walking to fast running - and is divided into start groups for smooth race flow. It offers a spectator-friendly course with both scenic natural sections and urban environments, as well as optional timing and prize money for the top 3.
course_highlights: 10 km course through Södra Djurgården and Stockholm city’s beautiful environments
Strong spectator support along the course and an energetic atmosphere
Option to shorten the race to approximately 6 km (start group 12) for those who wish
additional: Timing is included but can be opted out; registration is binding. Late registration is possible (subject to availability) digitally up to 1 hour before the first start. Payment options: internet banking, Visa/MasterCard, Swish, or invoice via Klarna. Age limit for Tjejmilen Stockholm: from the year you turn 15 (13 years with adult accompaniment). The start is divided into 12 start groups and prize money is awarded to the top 3. Two 10 km races for women (Sälen-trail and Stockholm City race); start groups; age 15+; late registration possible; dogs are not allowed; planning information is available on the official website.

name: Skördeloppet Hedemora
description: The Harvest Race in Hedemora is a festive and family-friendly running event held in conjunction with the Late Summer Day, a late summer festival with many activities in the town. The race includes, among other things, the Little Harvest Race for children with various distances without timing and medal distribution immediately at the finish line. The event offers a wonderful atmosphere with warm-up, mingling performance, and the possibility of late registration and bib pickup on site. It is a nice tradition that ends the summer with joy and community in Hedemora.
course_highlights: Little Harvest Race with child-friendly distances at Vasaliden
Medal distribution immediately at the finish line for children
Festive atmosphere with mingling performance and warm-up
additional: On-site late registration and bib pickup open. No timing for the children's race. Warm-up for Knattar & Kids before start. Medal distribution occurs immediately at the finish line. The Little Harvest Race starts at 10:00 AM at Vasaliden. Association day and volunteer opportunities take place on August 31, 2026, at Vasaliden in Hedemora; no specific terrain details for the race are available.

name: Blodomloppet Eskilstuna
description: The Blood Run in Eskilstuna takes place on September 7, 2026, and is organized by Eskilstuna Athletics. The race offers men's and women's classes for 5 km and 10 km, as well as the Little Blood Run and the Special Race, with courses described as fast and flat. The event is held in the City Park and combines a recreational run with the purpose of raising awareness about blood donation, including a blood donor gift and picnic tradition. Information and event details are published on the event page, and registration can be done individually or in teams.
course_highlights: A fast, flat course with very little elevation change
5 km and 10 km courses are measured
Start and event area in the City Park
additional: Registration is done individually or in teams (up to 5 people per team); team members can participate in different distances within the same team. For larger registrations, an Excel template is available for download from the registration page, and the organizer can assist with customer side/rabatt code for companies with more than 20 participants. A blood donor gift is handed out at the Unilabs blood donation center tent at the event area. Storage/collection of bags is offered (drop-off/pick-up times are 17:00 - 20:00). Course routes: 5 km and 10 km. The Little Blood Run is 800 meters. The event area includes a bag drop and picnic basket; participation can be individual or in teams (up to 5 persons per team).

name: Skärblackaloppet 2026
location: Folkets Hus i Skärblacka, Skärblacka, Östergötland, Sweden

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Early Bird, 250 kr, fram till och med 30 april 23:59.

description: Skärblackaloppet is an annual recreational race in Skärblacka that offers a folk festival for runners and spectators. The main race is 6 km through the town with start and finish at the Folkets Hus, and there is also a 4 km walk class as well as a Little Children's Race of 900 meters. The race is open to all levels and features a generous prize table, lotteries, and goodie bags for participants. Organizers Frida Södermark and Stefan Fransson warmly welcome you to the starting line on September 9, 2026.
course_highlights: 6 km through Skärblacka with start and finish at Folkets Hus
The course runs on asphalt, bike paths, gravel, and partly on trails
Walk class 4 km (shortened) and Little Children's Race 900 m near Parkskolan
additional: Start and finish at Folkets Hus in Skärblacka. Bib numbers can be picked up at ICA Supermarket in Skärblacka on Tuesday, September 8 from 11:00 to 18:00; remaining bibs will be handed out at Folkets Hus no later than one hour before the start. Late registration can be done in connection with the bib number distribution. All participants receive a goodie bag; prize table, sprint prizes, and lotteries will be held (including tire prizes, course record bonuses). The walk class was introduced in 2024; bib numbers are picked up at ICA Supermarket in Skärblacka; registration is via RaceID; late registration is available on race day from 15:30; payment only by Swish or cash; chip records the time on the bib; medical services, food, and drinks are available on site.

name: Blodomloppet (Växjö)
price_range: 350 kr till 400 kr för vuxna, 50 kr för Lilla Blodomloppet
description: Blood Race in Växjö is a fun run that highlights the vital importance of blood donation. The race offers distances of 5 km and 10 km running, as well as a 5 km walking class, all starting and finishing in the beautiful Linné Park. The courses are flat and fast with lots of crowd support, making it a perfect race for both competitive runners and recreational participants who want to enjoy an energetic atmosphere. There is also a Little Blood Race for children, which runs in a loop in the park. Registration can be done individually or in teams, and late registration is available on-site on the same day.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Linné Park, Växjö
Flat and fast 5 km course, officially measured
The 10 km race consists of two laps of the 5 km course
additional: Registration can be done individually or in teams (up to 5 participants per team). Team members can participate in different distances. Late registration is possible on-site in Linné Park on race day. There is a special dog class (ICA Pälskling). Changing rooms and toilets are available at the event area. Bibs and T-shirts are distributed on-site. There are water stations along the course and medical services on-site. The race concludes with a large picnic for participants. The event promotes blood donation and health, with registration available until the day of the event and on-site in Linné Park.

name: Sörmlands 100 Trail Run
location: Gripholms Slott, Mariefred, Strängnäs Municipality, Södermanland County, Sweden
distance_verbose: 100 miles, 100 km, 50 km, Halvmarathon, 8 km, 8 km, 2 km
description: Sörmlands 100 Trail Run is a multi-day race (September 11-13, 2026) through the scenic and biologically rich landscapes of Sörmland, with distances ranging from approximately 8 km up to 100 miles. The races take place on technical singletracks, coastal paths, and faster sections, suitable for both experienced ultrarunners and recreational runners depending on the chosen distance. The event focuses on the trail experience with local food offerings, lectures, and a friendly, inclusive atmosphere. Organizers provide GPS tracking, GPX files, and support at water stations for a memorable weekend in Sörmland.
course_highlights: Trail with forest paths and coastal cliffs along Sörmlandsleden
Approximately 300 meters of elevation gain (22 km) and technical singletrack
Surface: about 85% trail, 10% gravel, 5% asphalt
additional: GPX files are available for download; live GPS tracking and intermediate/final results are offered. The event is cupless – bring your own cup. Longer distances include a buff, live tracking, GPX, window decal, and a handcrafted wooden finisher's medal/belt buckle depending on the distance. Detailed mandatory kit lists are provided (including 1 liter of fluids, mobile phone, navigation tools, first aid kit, map, GPS tracker, emergency blanket, rain jacket, headlamp) for 100 km and 100 miles. Early cut-offs and water station locations are published; the organizer plans shuttle buses from Nävekvarn Camping to Nyköping (fee approx. 100 SEK, paid via Swish on-site). Night Trail and 2 km children’s race are included; start/finish locations include Gripholms Slott in Mariefred and Nävekvarns Folkets Park; bus transfers and GPX tracks are included in the information for different distances.

name: Rosvallaspelen

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Early-Bird pris fram tills 31 mars 2026: 200 kronor

description: Rosvallaloppet is a recreational race organized with start and finish at Rosvalla Arena in Nyköping. The race offers distances of five and ten kilometers that run on trails at Brandholmen, with start and lap inside the arena. It is a day filled with activity, socializing, and exercise, with medals for all participants and prize giving for the top finishers in the women's and men's categories. During the race, there are water stations with sports drinks and a simple kiosk on site. Changing rooms and toilets are available at the arena.
course_highlights: Start and finish inside Rosvalla Arena
5 km and 10 km on trails at Brandholmen
The 10 km race consists of two laps on the same course
additional: Number bibs are to be collected on race day no later than 60 minutes before start. Late registration is possible from April 30 to May 7 via the website and on race day with Swish payment. Timing is done with a transponder loaned out at the bib distribution and must be returned after the race. Lost transponders will be charged at 800 SEK. Prizes are awarded to the top three in the women's and men's categories, as well as raffle prizes from sponsors. Sports drinks are available at the start/finish and on the 10 km lap. A simple kiosk is available on site. Changing rooms and toilets are available at the arena. The race requires pre-registration via anmalmig.nu; the event also includes family activities and is open to all levels.

name: Bysjöloppet
description: Bysjöloppet is a popular race at Bysjön in Åtvidaberg, organized by Åtvidabergs IF since 1983. The courses are varied with asphalt, gravel roads, and forest trails, starting and finishing at Edbergavallen, and offer distances for both children and adults. The race is traditionally held on the second Saturday in September and welcomes both recreational and competitive runners and teams.
course_highlights: Mixed terrain: asphalt, gravel roads, and forest trails along Bysjön
Start and finish at Edbergavallen
10 km includes hilly terrain trail (Humpa illuminated trail) and is more challenging
additional: Registration is done via the link to the registration system; payment by Swish or bank transfer (discount codes available online). Bibs can be collected from 10:00 on race day at Edbergavallen; late registration on site from 10:00 (Swish or cash). Distance info: 700 m (children, no timing), 1.3 km (children, with timing), 5 km (measured 5.0 km, mixed asphalt/gravel), and 10 km (measured 10.0 km, mixed asphalt/trail/gravel, hilly). All finishers receive a medal; a special commemorative medal is awarded upon completing the 10th or 20th race (adult categories). Team registration (4 - 6 participants) includes a picnic basket for 5 people; team registration may close on September 7 if baskets are sold out. A kiosk is available at the race area. Award ceremony around 12:00 for the 1.3 km and around 14:00 for the 5 km and 10 km. Distances: 1.3 km, 5 km, and 10 km; all finishers receive a medal; additional commemorative medal available at the 10th or 20th race for adults; team registration for 4 - 6 participants; bib pickup at Edbergavallen; ICA picnic basket after finish; kiosks at the race area; prize distribution according to the prize table. Preparatory activities include a running workshop and open group interval training before the race.

name: Norasjön Runt
description: Norasjön Runt is a scenic half marathon around Lake Norasjön in Nora, organized by IFK Nora since 1929. The race is held annually in early September and has historically been an important race in the Southern Svealand district, with DM/VDM status according to the invitation for the district. The route passes through varied nature around the lake, with open fields, forests, and streams, offering a course that caters to both competitive runners and recreational athletes. The race has a long tradition and is a valued part of the region's running events.
course_highlights: Norasjön Runt - half marathon around the lake
Varied nature along the course with open fields, forests, and streams
DM/VDM status in the Southern Svealand district and part of Södra Svealands Löparie
additional: 71st edition (2025) and 96 years since the start; the distance is a half marathon and the event is associated with the DM/VDM district of Southern Svealand.

name: Gränna StadsTrail
description: Gränna City Trail is a welcoming trail run offered at 5, 10, and 21 km, starting and finishing at Gränna Square. The courses combine fast asphalt sections with winding trails through beech and pine forests, offering magnificent views over Lake Vättern and Grännaberget. The race is designed for both the experience and performance, suitable for both recreational runners and more experienced athletes. All participants receive timing and a unique medal at the finish line.
course_highlights: 5 km: mostly asphalt, ending with a downhill run from Grännaberget on winding trail
10 km: a mix of asphalt and trail with views along Lake Vättern and Grännaberget
21 km: winding trail through beech forest, gravel roads, and challenging hills with magnificent views
additional: Joint start from the square through Gränna to the harbor where timing begins; timing on all distances; unique medal for all participants; arena and finish area in the center of Gränna with proximity to cafes, eateries, and accommodations; the courses may be changed depending on conditions and permits. Timing on all distances. Start and finish at Gränna Square. Distances of 5, 10, and 21 km. The courses may be altered depending on conditions and permits.

name: USWE Paradiset STHLM
description: USWE Paradiset STHLM is a 26 km trail run in the Paradiset Nature Reserve south of Stockholm. The race offers technical, winding trails over rocky outcrops, boardwalks over marshes, and through open pine forests - a demanding but scenic trail event. The distance is part of the Outnorth Trailtour and the race emphasizes community, personal challenge, and a festive atmosphere after the finish. The organizer is Trailrunning Sweden AB and the event is aimed at trail runners who want to experience the wilderness south of Stockholm.
course_highlights: Technical singletrack trails with ascents and descents over rocky outcrops
Boardwalks over marshes and small ponds, as well as open pine forest sections
26 km through Paradiset Nature Reserve - part of the Outnorth Trailtour
additional: Date of the race is set for September 12, 2026. The event highlights after-party/finish line atmosphere and that the race is part of the Outnorth Trailtour. The organizer is listed as Trailrunning Sweden AB (Hästtorget 6, 312 30 Laholm). The terrain is described as challenging with winding trails, rocky outcrops, boardwalks, and marshes. The courses are marked with ribbons and start groups are organized by distance; start times and aid stations are listed; dogs are not allowed; there will be a hydration station and afterparty at Oasen.

name: Nybro Backyard 12h
organizer: Nybro Skidklubb & Topp och Dröm HB
description: Topp & Dröm organizes the Nybro Backyard 12h as part of their annual competition program in Nybro. The race is a 12-hour Backyard format welcoming runners seeking an ultra challenge in a social and inclusive event. The organizer emphasizes movement, community, and joy in nature and also offers rental and personal training in Nybro. For questions, contact details for Topp & Dröm are available on their website.
course_highlights: 12-hour Backyard format
Organized in Nybro by Topp & Dröm
Organizer's focus: movement, community, and joy in nature
additional: Organizer: Topp och Dröm HB, Sommargatan 17, 382 38 Nybro. Organization number: 969796-6407. Contact email: info@toppochdrom.se. Swish for payment is 123 698 89 01. Topp & Dröm also offers ski rental (roller and cross-country ski packages) and personal training in Nybro. The race offers a 6,706 m lap, starts every full hour, and changing rooms/showers are available nearby; parking at the stadium and camping/parking space via Nybro Camping. Registration is via Mittlopp and bibs are collected from 06:30 to 07:45 on race day.

name: Duvnäsloppet
description: Duvnäsloppet is a family-friendly race and recreational run in Saltsjö-Duvnäs that winds through a beautiful and hilly villa community. The event is organized by Saltsjö-Duvnäs Sports Club and features races for children and adults with start and finish at Ringparken. Everyone can participate, whether you are a recreational runner or more competitive, and the event emphasizes community and enjoyment. Registration opens June 1, 2026, and the race takes place on September 12, 2026.
course_highlights: Hilly residential area with several steep climbs (including Fogdevägen, Vargungevägen)
5 km and 10 km have the same route; 10 km is run as two laps
Shorter race (1.7 km) and kids' race with start/finish at Ringparken
additional: Registration opens June 1, 2026. The final regular pre-registration usually closes around September 11; registrations after that are accepted until race day with a higher fee. Bibs can be collected at Ringparksstugan on Friday evening from 18:00 to 20:00 or on race day from 10:00 (no later than one hour before start). The timing chip is attached to the bib; the 10 km races use two bibs (front and back). Registration is binding. Registration opens June 1, 2026; distances are 5 km and 10 km (10 km as two laps); children's race at 11:00 and adult race around 12:30; bibs can be collected at Ringparksstugan on race day or the evening before; pre-registration until September 11; the race is seeking volunteers.

name: Närkespelen
description: Närkespelen in Hallsberg is a traditional athletics competition organized by Åsbro GoIF. The event is held annually and brings together athletes for a day of various disciplines and competition elements. The event is well-organized with a clear schedule and has a long history with result lists from many years back. It is a welcome opportunity for both active participants and spectators to experience athletics in a pleasant environment.
course_highlights: Includes several athletics disciplines
Organized by local sports club Åsbro GOIF
District championships in pole vault for youth and adults
additional: The event takes place in Hallsberg and is part of the regional athletics calendar. It is an occasion for both competitive athletes and recreational participants to engage in a friendly and inspiring environment.

name: HIK-Kampen
description: HIK-Kampen is an athletics competition organized by the Hovslätts IK Athletics Section in Jönköping. The event gathers athletes of various ages and levels to compete in a welcoming and engaging environment. The event is part of the club's tradition to promote athletics and community in the region. Participants can follow the club's website for updates and information.
course_highlights: Different distances for various age groups
Held in Jönköping
Includes sprints and longer runs
additional: Results from previous years include categories such as P15 80m, women 800m, and P13 600m, demonstrating a wide range of participants.

name: Mälarömilen
description: After more than ten years of hiatus, Mälarömilen is back on Ekerö – a welcoming race for runners of all levels. The event includes four races in one day: Mälarö Knattelopp, Lilla Mälarömilen, Mälaröfemman, and the classic main race Mälarömilen (10 km). Start and finish are at Träkvista sports field, and the event emphasizes community, joy of movement, and fast courses for those who want to compete. There is also an option to register entire teams or companies through a convenient group registration.
course_highlights: Asphalted walkways and park trails
Signage at each kilometer mark
Start and finish at Träkvista sports field; looping on the walkway north of the sports field
additional: Online registration closes 7 days before the race; late registration is possible on race day with an increased fee. The number of starting places is limited, and registration is valid only after payment is completed. Timing and bibs are used in all categories (exceptions: Mälarö Knattelopp without timing; Lilla Mälarömilen girls/boys 9 - 11 years timing without placement). The event area is located at Träkvista sports field with medical services, a water station just after the start/loop, as well as toilets, showers, and changing rooms in the KOM building. Recommended public transport options: buses 177 and 301 - 311 (stop Träkvista Idrottsplats). A total cap of 1,000 runners, and all surplus funds go back to Mälarö SOK's sports activities. The race offers corporate and team registration and support for teams.

name: Mjärdevistafetten
price_range: 700-1000 kr/lag (student/under 18 100 kr/lag; priser varierar efter anmälningsdatum)
description: Mjärdevistafetten is a lively and popular relay race in Collegiumparken in Linköping Science Park. The competition is a team event for teams of four people, where each runner runs a distance of approximately 3 km. The starting shot is at 17:00, and there are activities, food sales, and an award ceremony with a raffle after the finish. The event welcomes everything from elite teams to recreational groups and encourages colorful and imaginative elements along the course.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Collegiumparken, Linköping Science Park
Team event: 4 people per team, each segment approximately 3 km
Prize ceremony around 18:15 and raffle on race numbers
additional: Number bibs are distributed at Mjärdevi Center / DoSpace on Wednesday, September 11 from 11:00 to 13:30 and Thursday, September 12 from 11:00 to 13:30 (then at the start and finish area). Food sales are available on site and a Post-Run package is offered for the entire team (price 140 SEK). The event encourages companies to create activities along the course (hydration stations, performances, etc.) and features attractive prize sponsors and raffles. Teams pick up bibs at Mjärdevi Center/DoSpace before the event (usually between 11:00 and 13:30 on the days prior) and there is a Post-Run package for the team (e.g., 140 SEK according to the 2024 version). The event follows COVID-19 safety guidelines according to authorities and promotes sustainability with thematic elements.
